programme.title: A Small and Deadly War
programme.desc: The team investigates when a SWAT officer suspects his squad of crimes; guests Jack Ging, Dean Stockwell.

programme.title: Black Day at Bad Rock
programme.desc: The A-Team helps a small-town sheriff fend off a vengeful motorcycle gang. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

programme.title: The Rabbit Who Ate Las Vegas
programme.desc: The kidnapping of a gambler leads to a mobster (Charles Cioffi) and then to a $100,000 price on Hannibal's head.

programme.title: Broken Image
programme.desc: Mistaken for a hoodlum, Banner is the target of a gang and police.

programme.title: Lottery
programme.desc: Banner must send a friend to collect lottery winnings, with dangerous results.

programme.title: Babalao
programme.desc: A New Orleans doctor enlists Banner's aid to battle her patients' faith in voodoo.

programme.title: Long Run Home
programme.desc: Banner is tarred with the same brush as a motorcyclist who gives him a lift.

programme.title: Proof Positive
programme.desc: McGee's new publisher orders him off the Hulk story; guest Caroline Smith.

programme.title: Deathmask
programme.desc: A mob wants Banner, mistaken for a serial killer of girls; guest Gerald McRaney.

programme.title: Killer KITT
programme.desc: An electronics genius seeking recognition for his work at the Foundation reprograms KITT.

programme.title: Out of the Woods
programme.desc: A Foundation supporter's illegal logging is exposed when he asks Devon's help.

programme.title: Honest
programme.desc: Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.

programme.title: Seance
programme.desc: A woman believes her dead sister is the cause of accidents in her home; a man is trapped underwater in his car with the doors jammed.

programme.title: Boot
programme.desc: Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.

programme.title: Rip-Off
programme.desc: The paramedics conduct several rescues under a shadow of guilt after being accused of stealing from a patient; guest Jo Anne Worley.

programme.title: Audit
programme.desc: DeSoto must decide whether to amputate the leg of a trapped construction worker (James McEachin); nervous Gage faces an IRS tax audit.

programme.title: The Wedworth Townsend Act
programme.desc: An assembly bill to create a paramedic program meets opposition from doctors and firefighters; pilot for the series.

programme.title: The Wedworth Townsend Act
programme.desc: An assembly bill to create a paramedic program meets opposition from doctors and firefighters; pilot for the series.

programme.title: Mascot
programme.desc: Gage promises to care for an injured woman's dog; the paramedics save five lives including a diabetic and a man trapped on a ledge.

programme.title: Botulism
programme.desc: An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

programme.title: Cook's Tour
programme.desc: DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

programme.title: The Out-of-Towners
programme.desc: The team aids Manhattan shopkeepers victimized by mobsters extorting protection money; guest Yaphet Kotto.

programme.title: Holiday in the Hills
programme.desc: Fanatical mountain men attack after the team crash-lands deep in the Appalachians; guests Edward Winter, Bill McKinney.

programme.title: West Coast Turnaround
programme.desc: A rancher (Stuart Whitman) tries to ruin a Vietnam veteran's (Robert Sampson) struggling farm; guest Tim Rossovich.

programme.title: One More Time
programme.desc: Guerrilla terrorists capture an Army general and his daughter. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The team rescues Amy's college chum from being forced to marry a tycoon who may have killed her father.

programme.title: The Beast From the Belly of a Boeing
programme.desc: Hannibal poses as an airline executive to get aboard a jumbo jet hijacked by terrorists; guest Andy Robinson.

programme.title: A Nice Place to Visit
programme.desc: While attending a friend's funeral, the A-Team encounters a crazed mountain clan. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

programme.title: Diamonds 'n' Dust
programme.desc: A mysterious woman (Kristen Meadows) wants her slain father's South African diamond mine freed from unscrupulous businessmen.

programme.title: Recipe for Heavy Bread
programme.desc: The team members aid their former POW cook (Mako), an unwitting participant in drug smuggling; guest Marjoe Gortner.

programme.title: A Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Banner is stuck between criminals wanting his help, and police wanting information; guest Jeanette Nolan.

programme.title: Goodbye Eddie Cain
programme.desc: A private detective (Cameron Mitchell) pegs Banner as an extortion suspect.

programme.title: Equinox
programme.desc: McGee trails Banner to a private island, where Banner must attend a masquerade.

programme.title: Nine Hours
programme.desc: Hit men kidnap a child to force Banner to cooperate in their killing of a hospitalized mob witness.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Firefighters suspect Banner of starting a forest blaze; guest Kathleen Lloyd.

programme.title: Deadly Knightshade
programme.desc: Michael and KITT chase an elusive magician (Lance Burton) who may be after Devon; with Hurd Hatfield.

programme.title: Redemption of a Champion
programme.desc: A deaf sportswriter is murdered after calling Devon with his concerns over the welfare of a contender in an upcoming prizefight.

programme.title: Brushfire
programme.desc: A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

programme.title: Dealer's Wild
programme.desc: DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

programme.title: Nurses Wild
programme.desc: The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

programme.title: Publicity Hound
programme.desc: Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

programme.title: Weird Wednesday
programme.desc: The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

programme.title: Dilemma
programme.desc: Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

programme.title: Hangup
programme.desc: Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

programme.title: Problem
programme.desc: DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

programme.title: Kids
programme.desc: Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

programme.title: The Only Church in Town
programme.desc: Face's former girlfriend (Markie Post), now a nun, hires the team to rescue nuns and orphans held in an Ecuadorean monastery.

programme.title: Bad Time on the Border
programme.desc: A lost Mexican girl leads B.A. to a smuggling ring responsible for illegally transporting aliens across the border.

programme.title: When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
programme.desc: An Indian boy wants to stop a wealthy rancher (Morgan Woodward) rustling mustangs on an Arizona reservation.

programme.title: When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
programme.desc: The team attacks a trainload of mustangs headed for Mexico, only to have Hannibal and B.A. taken prisoner.

programme.title: The Private Life of Deer
programme.desc: White-tailed deer in the U.S.

programme.title: Hummingbirds: Magic in the Air
programme.desc: Hummingbirds, the tiniest of birds, qualify as some of the toughest and most energetic creatures in the world.

programme.title: Super Hummingbirds
programme.desc: High-speed cameras capture hummingbirds as they mate, fight and raise families.

programme.title: The Real Macaw
programme.desc: The future of the macaw, whose survival may depend on the poachers who brought them to the brink of extinction.

programme.title: Parrots in the Land of Oz
programme.desc: The colors, behaviors and habitats of the parrots occupying Australia.

programme.title: Parrot Confidential
programme.desc: Owners and rescuers discuss the pros and cons of caring for parrots; conservation efforts in the wild.

programme.title: Bonebreakers' Mountain
programme.desc: A bearded vulture, the bonebreaker, feeds atop the harsh Pyrenees separating Spain and France.

programme.title: Hunters of the Sky
programme.desc: Hugh Miles films Europe's great birds of prey and notes how man's actions endanger them and their habitats.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Lizards
programme.desc: The world of lizards.

programme.title: Snakes
programme.desc: The snake is either vilified or revered.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Turtles and Tortoises
programme.desc: The diversity and abilities of turtles.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Lizards
programme.desc: The world of lizards.

programme.title: Invasion of the Giant Pythons
programme.desc: Florida's Everglades National Park is a protected wilderness where predatory pythons thrive.

programme.title: Bloody Suckers
programme.desc: Fleas, flies, ticks, leeches, mosquitoes, birds and bats drink blood for survival.

programme.title: Superfish
programme.desc: Marlin, sailfish, spearfish and swordfish are the largest and most highly prized of all game fish.

programme.title: Smart and Smarter
programme.desc: Animals, big or small, must remain smart to survive as they navigate without a map, build homes out of living bodies and catch prey in their unforgiving surroundings.

programme.title: The Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Takes a look at how various species in the animal kingdom utilize the art of seduction in finding a mate.

programme.title: Masters of Disguise
programme.desc: The filmmakers explore how animals disguise themselves with their skin, fur and feathers to hunt their prey and fend off their predators.

programme.title: The Power of the Velvet Paw
programme.desc: A look at the big cats of the jungle and how they embody the attributes of power, elegance and being imposing.

programme.title: Freaky Feathers
programme.desc: Focus on exotic species of birds and take a look at their prominent calls, iridescent colors and acrobatic flying skills.

programme.title: Planet of the Primates
programme.desc: A closer look at primates, the closest relatives of human beings in terms of biology, behavior and evolution.

programme.title: Katabatic
programme.desc: The Katabatic shapes Antarctica.

programme.title: Iceberg
programme.desc: Icebergs are the source of life for seals, krill, penguins and petrels.

programme.title: The Eternal Frontier
programme.desc: A look at Canada's beautiful scenery and wildlife; see humpback whales feeding on schools of capelin and learn about the world's biggest intact rainforest.

programme.title: The Wild West
programme.desc: Traveling from the Pacific temperate forests to the snow-dusted peaks of the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: The Heartland
programme.desc: Meeting a pronghorn antelope, wolverines and beavers in the boreal forest and prairies.

programme.title: Ice Edge
programme.desc: A look at Canada's beautiful scenery and wildlife, including polar bear cubs, a young caribou and eider ducks diving for mussels.

programme.title: Grasslands: North America's Hidden Wilderness
programme.desc: An evocative exploration of a wild and little-known landscape in the heartland of North America; featuring new animal behavior, the film pairs blue-chip wildlife sequences with human characters working together to save remaining wild grasslands.

programme.title: Crown of the Continent: Waterton/Glacier National Park
programme.desc: Grizzlies, wolves and cougars roam Montana's rugged, pristine Glacier National Park.

programme.title: Yosemite
programme.desc: Global changes affect the wilderness of the Yosemite Valley in the Sierra Nevada mountains of Northern California.

programme.title: The Colorado
programme.desc: Eagles, pumas, sandhill cranes and other creatures seek sustenance from the Colorado River and its environs.

programme.title: Kalahari: Wilderness Without Water
programme.desc: An examination of the diverse plants and animals that have adapted to the harsh environment of the Kalahari Desert in South Africa.

programme.title: Kalahari: The Great Thirstland
programme.desc: Life in the Kalahari Desert includes butterflies, termites, locusts, quelea birds and bullfrogs.

programme.title: Kalahari: The Flooded Desert
programme.desc: The Kalahari Desert's Okavango Delta from the point of view of crocodiles and eagles.

programme.title: Saguaro: Sentinel of the Desert
programme.desc: Undisturbed the saguaro cactus can grow to 60 feet, weigh 10 tons and live 150 years.

programme.title: Deep Jungle: Monsters of the Forest
programme.desc: The history of a giant Brazil nut tree in a Peruvian jungle; British tarantula expert; rainfall generated by the trees.

programme.title: Deep Jungle: The Beast Within
programme.desc: Expeditions to the Central African Republic, Guatemala and Cambodia to explore primates of the rain forests.

programme.title: Great Wood of Caledon
programme.desc: Emmy-winning filmmaker Hugh Miles presents a lyrical portrait of Scotland's Caledonian Forest.

programme.title: Ireland
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, the advance and retreat of ice shaped the mountains, coastlines, gorges and inland waterways of Ireland.

programme.title: Wild Way of the Vikings
programme.desc: Traveling from Norway to Newfoundland just as seafarers did in A.D. 1,000 to get a sense of how the Vikings lived in the Americas; narrator Ewan McGregor.

programme.title: In the Beginning
programme.desc: The origins of the solar system and life on Earth; how life is affected by the forces of nature. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Perpetual Motion
programme.desc: The importance of the atmosphere and the oceans both in creating and destroying life. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Heavenly Partners
programme.desc: The influence the sun and moon have on the seasons and the tides. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Living Volcanoes
programme.desc: The varied activity, both human and natural, that occurs on the slopes of active volcanoes.

programme.title: Living Volcanoes
programme.desc: The varied activity, both human and natural, that occurs on the slopes of active volcanoes.

programme.title: The Kalahari: The Great Thirstland
programme.desc: Struggle on the African plains.

programme.title: Nature
programme.desc: Consistently stunning documentaries transport viewers to far-flung locations ranging from the torrid African plains to the chilly splendors of icy Antarctica. The show's primary focus is on animals and ecosystems around the world. A comic book based on the show, meant to be used an as educational tool for kids, was briefly distributed to museums and schools at no cost in the mid-2000s.

programme.title: Take Back
programme.desc: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

programme.title: Knight of Cups
programme.desc: A Los Angeles screenwriter (Christian Bale) indulges his wild side with a stripper (Teresa Palmer), a model (Freida Pinto) and a married woman (Natalie Portman).

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: Chaplin's first full-length feature is a silent masterpiece about a little tramp who discovers a little orphan and brings him up but is left desolate when the orphanage reclaims him. Chaplin directed, produced and starred in the film, as well as composed the score.

programme.title: The Decline of Western Civilization
programme.desc: Director Penelope Spheeris surveys the late-1970s Los Angeles punk scene: X, Black Flag, Fear, Germs, Catholic Discipline, Alice Bag Band.

programme.title: The Getaway
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
programme.desc: For many years, Heather Mason (Adelaide Clemens) and her father, Harry (Sean Bean), have been on the run from dangerous forces she does not understand. Heather continues to be plagued by terrifying nightmares and frightened by her father's disappearance, and on the eve of her 18th birthday, she discovers that she is not who she thinks she is. The revelation leads her deep into the demonic world of Silent Hill, where she may become trapped forever.

programme.title: The Ticket
programme.desc: After James, a blind man, inexplicably regains his vision, he becomes possessed by a drive to make a better life for himself. However, his new improvements -- a nicer home, a higher paying job, tailored suits, luxury car -- leave little room for the people who were part of his old, simpler life. As his relationships buckle under the strain of his snowballing ambition, it becomes uncertain if James can ever return from darkness.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: Jesus' teachings draw large crowds.

programme.title: The Man With the Golden Arm
programme.desc: When illegal card dealer and recovering heroin addict Frankie Machine gets out of prison, he decides to straighten up. Armed with nothing but an old drum set, Frankie tries to get honest work as a drummer. But when his former employer, small-time con man Schwiefka, and Frankie's old drug dealer, Louie, re-enter his life, Frankie finds it hard to stay clean and eventually finds himself succumbing to his old habits.

programme.title: An Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A San Francisco policeman (Chuck Norris) quits the force to avenge his partner's murder by Asian drug dealers.

programme.title: Chopper
programme.desc: America had Al Capone; England, the Kray brothers and Australia - proving once and for all its antipodean sense of humor - has Mark "Chopper" Read. "Chopper" is inspired by the books of Mark Brandon "Chopper" Read, arguably Australia's most infamous former criminal. "Chopper" draws on police records, court transcripts, news coverage and interviews with people who knew Chopper Read.

programme.title: The Gambler III: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: An Old West poker player, his partner and a schoolmarm help Dakota Indians thwart a senator's land-grab.

programme.title: The Little Hours
programme.desc: Medieval nuns Alessandra, Fernanda, and Ginevra lead a simple life in their convent. Their days are spent chafing at monastic routine, spying on one another, and berating the estate's day laborer. After a particularly vicious insult session drives the peasant away, Father Tommasso brings on newly hired hand Massetto, a virile young servant forced into hiding by his angry lord. Introduced to the sisters as a deaf-mute to discourage temptation, Massetto struggles to maintain his cover.

programme.title: Filly Brown
programme.desc: Majo Tonorio (Gina Rodriguez), a talented hip-hop artist, is offered a record deal from a sleazy producer. She faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself and her music.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Starcrash
programme.desc: A space explorer and his girlfriend try to protect Earth from devastation.

programme.title: The Kill Room
programme.desc: A hit man teams up with an art dealer for a money-laundering scheme that unwittingly turns him into an avant-garde sensation.

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Black
programme.desc: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: Rich oddball Frederick Loren has a proposal for five guests at a possibly haunted mansion: show up, survive a night filled with scares and receive $10,000 each. The guest of honor is Loren's estranged wife, Annabelle, who, with her secret lover, Dr. Trent, has concocted her own scheme to scare Loren's associate, Nora Manning, into shooting the potentially crazy millionaire. However, more spooks and shocks throw a wrench into the plan.

programme.title: Suburbia
programme.desc: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

programme.title: The Pledge
programme.desc: On the day of his retirement, detective Jerry Black (Jack Nicholson) accepts a gift -- an airline ticket to Mexico. But when the body of a murdered eight-year-old girl is discovered in the mountains, Jerry offers his expertise at the crime scene. When an ambitious younger cop wrenches a dubious confession from a simple-minded suspect, the case is closed... but not for Jerry.

programme.title: Stay Cool
programme.desc: A successful author (Mark Polish) reunites with a high-school beauty (Winona Ryder) when he returns to his hometown.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: After Joseph and Mary's betrothal, Mary is visited by the angel Gabriel, who tells her she will bear the Son of God; Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem to take part in Herod's census, where Jesus is born.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

programme.title: The Tai Chi Master
programme.desc: Two Shaolin Temple pupils (Jet Li, Chin Siu-hou) take different life paths, leading to an ultimate battle between them.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: For four years, Emily Taylor (Rooney Mara) has awaited the release of her husband, Martin (Channing Tatum), from being imprisoned for insider trading. Finally, Martin comes home, but Emily feels just as bad as she did when he was incarcerated, and she sinks into a deep depression. After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When those don't work, he gives Emily a new medication -- but the drug leads to ruined lives and death.

programme.title: Guns of Redemption
programme.desc: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel.

programme.title: Homeboy
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: The Commitments
programme.desc: Jimmy Rabbitte, a self-proclaimed promoter, decides to organize an R&B group to fill the musical void in his hometown of Dublin, Ireland. The band comes together but ends up consisting entirely of white musicians who have little experience with the genre. Even though their raw talent and lofty aspirations gain the group notoriety, the pitfalls of fame begin to tear at their newfound friendships as they prepare for their big show. Based on the novel by Roddy Doyle.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers (Bela Lugosi) is frustrated because he thinks his employers, Mary Heath (Suzanne Kaaren) and Henry Morton (Guy Usher), have cheated him out of the company's profits. He decides to get revenge by altering bats to grow twice their normal size and training them to attack when they smell a perfume of his own making. He mixes the perfume into a lotion, which he offers as a gift to Mary and Henry. When they turn up dead, a newspaper reporter (Dave O'Brien) decides to investigate.

programme.title: This Is One Strange Town

programme.title: The Accomplice
programme.desc: A woman (Bette Davis) identifies Trampas as a bank robber in order to extort $10,000 from the actual thief; guests Lin McCarthy, Harold Gould.

programme.title: The Money Cage
programme.desc: A con man (Steve Forrest) and his accomplices (Ronald Foster, Joanna Moore) attempt to pull a swindle in Medicine Bow, but fail to account for their leader's love for a banker's daughter (Bethel Leslie).

programme.title: Say Goodbye to All That
programme.desc: A vengeful man convinces his son to prove himself by killing Trampas; guests Royal Dano, Katherine Crawford, Meg Wyllie.

programme.title: Vengeance Is the Spur
programme.desc: Garth is deceived into agreeing to help a woman (Nina Foch) find her outlaw husband, then discovers the true motive behind her search; guests Michael Rennie, Denver Pyle.

programme.title: The Exiles
programme.desc: The Virginian asks a dance-hall singer (Tammy Grimes) to trick a shady character (Ed Nelson) into revealing information that could clear Garth of a trumped-up murder charge.

programme.title: The Man Who Couldn't Die
programme.desc: In San Francisco trailing a missing woman (Vera Miles), Garth kills in self-defense, then learns the man didn't die; guest James Doohan.

programme.title: Duel at Shiloh
programme.desc: Steve's friend (Brian Keith), an itinerant cowboy, incites a rancher (Geraldine Brooks) to wage war if Garth and his neighbors erect fences; guest DeForest Kelley.

programme.title: The Judgment
programme.desc: Asked to be a candidate for district judge, Garth recalls a murder trial in which the defendant's brother (Clu Gulager) attempted to intimidate an entire town to prevent his sibling's execution.

programme.title: Run Away Home
programme.desc: An angry farmer (Karl Swenson) who has lost his savings in a bank closure sets out to get revenge on the Virginian, who withdrew $40,000 minutes before it failed.

programme.title: Mountain of the Sun
programme.desc: The Virginian encounters three women (Jeanette Nolan, Dolores Hart, Amzie Strickland) who are determined to carry on the missionary work of their husbands, killed by Indians a year before.

programme.title: Echo From Another Day
programme.desc: Trampas joins in a search for $50,000 in stolen gold to help his ex-convict friend (Bradford Dillman) escape a vengeful former accomplice (John Dehner); guest Edward Asner.

programme.title: The Golden Door
programme.desc: Garth and Betsy care for a pregnant woman while trying to defend her immigrant husband (Karl Boehm) on a murder charge, unaware the victim's son (Robert Duvall) has his own plans for justice.

programme.title: The Final Hour
programme.desc: Local residents are up in arms when Garth allows a group of Polish immigrants to begin mining operations on the Shiloh Ranch; guests Don Galloway, Jacques Aubuchon.

programme.title: A Distant Fury
programme.desc: A greedy woman (Ida Lupino) wants Steve to execute a recently released robber (Howard Duff) so she won't have to share the loot with him.

programme.title: Strangers at Sundown
programme.desc: Outlaws hold stage passengers, including Garth and Betsy, and will kill them all if one doesn't become a sacrifice by sundown; guests Skip Homeier, Richard Anderson.

programme.title: Ride a Dark Trail
programme.desc: Trampas recalls how he came to the Shiloh Ranch as an angry young ranch hand bent on avenging the death of his father (Sonny Tufts), a shiftless gambler killed by Garth in self-defense.

programme.title: Run Quiet
programme.desc: The Virginian urges a deaf ranch hand (Clu Gulager) to ignore the taunts of his co-workers and make a life for himself at Shiloh, which the man begins to do until being unjustly accused of murder.

programme.title: A Matter of Destiny
programme.desc: Trampas makes a decision to defend an Eastern financier who steals his girlfriend and cheats cattlemen.

programme.title: The Invaders
programme.desc: Garth's friend (Ed Begley) attempts to force ranchers out, and turns violent after his daughter (Beverly Owen) disappears with Trampas.

programme.title: Roar From the Mountain
programme.desc: Tracking a man-killing cougar, Steve rests at a couple's (Jack Klugman, Joyce Bulifant) cabin, where the wife pursues him and the husband threatens.

programme.title: The Evil That Men Do
programme.desc: Betsy discovers love when she meets an ex-convict at Shiloh, but his short temper could send him back to prison.

programme.title: Brother Thaddeus
programme.desc: An outlaw (Albert Salmi) turned Franciscan monk has a difficult time convincing the people of Medicine Bow of his commitment to religion, particularly when his visit coincides with a train robbery.

programme.title: To Make This Place Remember
programme.desc: An aging dance-hall performer (Joan Blondell) asks Garth to hold a trial to clear her son of a murder charge, although the boy has already been killed by vigilantes; guest John Dehner.

programme.title: The Drifter
programme.desc: In his first days at Shiloh, the Virginian fights an ambitious foreman (Michael Forest) who is rekindling a range war; guests Mariette Hartley, Rex Holman.

programme.title: A Killer in Town
programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Broderick Crawford) fingers Trampas as a homicide suspect, forcing the ranch hand to confess to Garth that he once fell in with a group wanted for murder and robbery.

programme.title: It Takes a Big Man
programme.desc: A rancher (Lloyd Nolan) forces a rebellious son (Chris Robinson) to Shiloh and another (Ryan O'Neal) into a gunfight.

programme.title: No Tears for Savannah
programme.desc: The Virginian must stall the execution of an old flame (Gena Rowlands) convicted of murder, so Garth has time to prove his theory of conspiracy; guests Everett Sloane, Vaughn Taylor, Joanna Moore.

programme.title: Portrait: Marie Valonne
programme.desc: The Virginian finds true love with a Louisiana beauty (Madlyn Rhue), only to be threatened by a political boss (Mark Richmond) who considers the woman to be private property; guest Skip Homeier.

programme.title: A Time Remembered
programme.desc: Garth's plans to wed an opera singer shatter when she fatally shoots a man breaking into her hotel room.

programme.title: Siege
programme.desc: Returning to his hometown, Trampas finds it under the control of an outlaw (Joseph Campanella) in cahoots with the local sheriff.

programme.title: Stopover in a Western Town
programme.desc: A bored young woman (Joan Freeman), stranded in Medicine Bow with her mother, decides to pass the time by seducing the Virginian.

programme.title: Another's Footsteps
programme.desc: The Virginian stumbles into a trap when he agrees to protect a frontierswoman (Sheree North) and her son from marauding Indians during her husband's (John Agar) supposed absence on business.

programme.title: The Fatal Journey
programme.desc: The Virginian poses as an ex-convict to infiltrate an outlaw gang guilty of a woman's murder, but finds his cover threatened by the arrival of another new member (David McLean); guest Robert Lansing.

programme.title: Man of Violence
programme.desc: Trampas acquires unwanted help (Peggy McCay, DeForest Kelley, Michael Pate) when he helps a woman seek her missing husband, an outlaw who has killed Trampas' friend; guest Leonard Nimoy.

programme.title: Fortunes of J. Jimerson Jones
programme.desc: Garth, Betsy and a hotel maid (Ann Doran) try to protect a suddenly wealthy prospector (Pat O'Brien) from a blonde's (Jeanne Cooper) schemes.

programme.title: The Thirty Days of Gavin Heath
programme.desc: After a bite from a rabid dog leaves him with little time to live, a Britisher (Leo Genn) embarks on a rescue mission to relieve his guilt over wartime cowardice.

programme.title: Smile of the Dragon
programme.desc: Trampas' wallet winds up on a dead man after a stagecoach robbery, leaving the ranch hand to be mistaken for one of the outlaws and accused of his own murder; guests Miyoshi Umeki, Richard Carlson.

programme.title: The Intruders
programme.desc: An outlaw (Darrin McGavin) and his men seize Shiloh and lie in wait for a chief (Iron Eyes Cody) and a general coming to negotiate a treaty; guest David Carradine.

programme.title: First to Thine Own Self
programme.desc: A youth (Randy Boone) aids a little girl, then is accused of murdering the child's grandfather (Frank Maxwell), a gold prospector; guest Bruce Dern.

programme.title: The Long Quest
programme.desc: A widow (Patricia Breslin) may lose her adopted son when a woman (Ruta Lee) plans to sue for custody of the boy, heir to a fortune; guest Joseph Campanella.

programme.title: The Secret of Brynmar Hall
programme.desc: A woman invites Betsy and three friends for the weekend, convinced that one is responsible for her daughter's death.

programme.title: Rope of Lies
programme.desc: Steve takes a job as foreman at a ranch owned by a beautiful woman (Diana Hillary), who has plans for the unsuspecting wrangler that involve a confrontation with her violent former lover.

programme.title: A Man Called Kane
programme.desc: Randy's discovery of gold coins hidden in a cave on the Shiloh Ranch attracts visitors -- a government agent seeking Civil War loot and Randy's long-lost brother, who is wanted for murder.

programme.title: Dark Destiny
programme.desc: An outlaw's (Robert Wilke) tomboy daughter (Brenda Scott), placed in the Virginian's care, is torn between her devotion to injured Randy and her desire to help her father escape from jail.

programme.title: A Bride for Lars
programme.desc: Indians, outlaws and temptation make Trampas rue delivering a Swedish mail-order bride (Katherine Crawford) to an injured neighbor (Peter Whitney).

programme.title: Felicity's Spring
programme.desc: A new schoolteacher (Katherine Crawford) wins the heart of Medicine Bow, until her sister (Mariette Hartley) reveals her fatal flaw.

programme.title: All Nice & Legal
programme.desc: A lawyer (Anne Francis) wins the acceptance of Medicine Bow's people by helping the Virginian in a legal matter, but loses favor when she uses her skills to free three outlaws from jail.

programme.title: 344 Sq. Ft. Tiny Tech-Free Retreat
programme.desc: CJ and Christina lead successful but stressful professional lives out in Silicon Valley while also raising their boys, JJ and baby Max. They're looking to escape the tech in the valley and retreat to what they hope will be a tiny sanctuary.

programme.title: Empty Nest, Full House
programme.desc: John and Zack are confident that they can build a tiny house with country charm for two empty nesters, until they learn that the couple want room for their kids and grandkids to visit when they're on the road.

programme.title: 180 Sq. Ft. Backpack House
programme.desc: Justin and Melissa are teachers who want a home that can connect them with the outdoors and serve as a base for the business.

programme.title: 340 Sq. Ft. Pioneer House
programme.desc: The Grahams are looking for a craftsman-style tiny house which needs to both hold up against the brutal winters they will soon face, and pack enough functionality for the whole family.

programme.title: 325 Sq. Ft. Expandable Tiny Cottage
programme.desc: Jay and Jodi were spending all their time working to maintain their dream house. Now their biggest concern is creating a space that is comfortable for the whole family.

programme.title: 370 Sq. Ft. Triathlete's Tiny Abode
programme.desc: Tommy and Katie are world-class triathletes who ask John and Zack to help create their first home and make it a space that gives them both a cozy place to come back to but can still function as a space to train in between competitions.

programme.title: Dad's Tiny Homecoming
programme.desc: A Florida veteran working two full-time jobs to support his family hopes that going tiny will lower the bills so he can work less and spend more time with his children; despite going tiny, the family's wish list is huge, and includes a swimming pool.

programme.title: We are Stronger
programme.desc: We Are Stronger is a faith-based film exploring a veteran's battle with PTSD. While Vic struggles to recover from his physical injuries, reclaim his marriage, and adjust to life after combat, he discovers he can't do it alone. Made in cooperation with the Stronger Alliance, Mighty Oaks, CRU Military, Amos House of Faith, Armed Forces Mission, and more who are dedicated to trauma recovery.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: The church's greatest enemy became Christ's most prolific messenger. Beautifully shot in the Moroccan desert, Paul the Apostle is a sweeping saga of the man who brought the Gospel to the Western world.

programme.title: Esther
programme.desc: Following the conquest of Babylon, the King of Persia gives a banquet for his people, but his wife, Vashti, refuses to attend. Ahasuerus disowns Vashti and goes in search of her replacement. In his harem, he meets the young girl Esther and falls in love with her. Esther then reveals to Ahasuerus that she is Jewish and asks him to show her people mercy.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Romero Collector's Edition
programme.desc: In honor of Archbishop Oscar Romero of El Salvador, the Romero Collector's Edition film has been remastered and chronicles the amazing true transformation of an apolitical, complacent priest to a committed leader, who started a revolution without guns, without an army, without fear.

programme.title: Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is crowned King of Israel and rules the land with love, peace and respect. While visiting the city, Solomon meets the beautiful Queen of Sheba and falls in love. programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: The church's greatest enemy became Christ's most prolific messenger. Beautifully shot in the Moroccan desert, Paul the Apostle is a sweeping saga of the man who brought the Gospel to the Western world.

programme.title: Jeremiah
programme.desc: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem. Although he is persecuted and branded as a traitor for warning others of the destruction of the Holy City, he continues fearlessly with his mission. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.title: Return to the Hiding Place
programme.desc: When the Nazis begin killing Jews in Holland, a group of youth fight to save the lives of the innocent.

programme.title: Biblical Prophecies
programme.desc: Approximately 2,500 prophecies appear in the Bible and 2,000 have been fulfilled. Did biblical prophets have special abilities that allowed them to foretell the future? Has modern technology actually created the devices for these ancient predictions of impending disasters to come true? Explore the predictions of the prophets, then decide for yourself: Are ancient prophecies today's reality?

programme.title: Biblical Rapture
programme.desc: Since the dawn of the new millennium predictions of the apocalypse have reached a fever pitch. Some scholars believe the Bible tells us there will be a mysterious event called 'The Rapture'. Many believe in the 'second coming' of Christ. Will there be a 'third' coming as well? Could there be a formula hidden in the Book of Revelation? The answers are at once hopeful and frightening.

programme.title: Biblical Adam and Eve
programme.desc: The story of Adam and Eve in the book of Genesis is the most controversial story in the Bible. What are archaeologists, paleontologists, biologists and theologians saying today? Is the story fact or fiction? The evidence may shock you. Where was the Garden of Eden? What was it like? Does it still exist, if indeed it ever did? Explore the evidence and journey back to the original birthplace of man.

Has modern technology actually created the devices for these ancient predictions of impending disasters to come true? Explore the predictions of the prophets, then decide for yourself: Are ancient prophecies today's reality?

programme.title: Lost Biblical Treasures
programme.desc: The legendary Holy Grail, believed to be a relic of the Last Supper of Christ, has eluded searchers for 2,000 years and the quest continues today. Or has it actually been found as some claim and are its legendary powers real? Will scientists ever decipher the Copper Scroll found near the Dead Sea and learn the way to a 2,000 year old treasure?

programme.title: Noah's Ark and the Biblical Flood
programme.desc: Nearly 200 ancient cultures recorded an all-encompassing flood; all with astonishing parallels to the biblical flood account of Noah's Ark. Was there a deluge of such proportion that it covered the entire earth? Was the entire population of the earth wiped out but for a handful of people? Is the artifact on Mt. Ararat really Noah's Ark? Has modern technology finally answered these questions?

programme.title: Biblical Armageddon
programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? Was this one in a series of events foretelling the End Times? Stories abound of the appearance of mysterious troops and sophisticated weaponry that aided the Israelis in their victory. Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.title: Early Years of Jesus
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.desc: Two of the world's great religions, Christianity and Judaism, base many of their most important beliefs on declarations made to Moses atop Mt. Sinai. Are the miraculous stories attributed to Moses factual? Did Moses receive the Ten Commandments from God?

programme.title: Biblical End Times
programme.desc: The Bible warns of cataclysmic disasters that will fulfill the End Time prophecy. Is it possible the ancients foresaw the wars, natural disasters and strife of the 21st Century? What about the prophecies of others from Nostradamus to Father Malachi O'Morgain? Are these warnings just stories from the ancient past or will we witness the End Times in our generation?

programme.title: Biblical Authors
programme.desc: The Bible is the most widely read book in the history of the world. But does anyone know who really wrote it? What are the facts behind this immortal manuscript? New scientific research and theological insight may provide new clues. What can the Dead Sea Scrolls tell us about the origins of the Bible? Discover how modern technology may finally unravel this age-old mystery.

programme.title: Biblical Old Testament Mysteries
programme.desc: Did the legendary cities of sin Sodom and Gomorrah really exist? Were they destroyed by fire and brimstone? Did looking at the destruction turn people into pillars of salt? Archaeological discoveries include the findings of bodies encased in salt may answer these questions. Has the Tower of Babel been found? Have the modern sciences of linguistics, sociology and archaeology given us the answer?

programme.title: The Final 24 Hours of Jesus' Life
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: John
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: Scarlet Woman: The True Story of Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: Mary Magdalene is a familiar presence in modern culture. We've read about her in the Da Vinci Code. We've heard about her in Jesus Christ Superstar. We think we know the story well. Yet in actual fact we don't know it at all because it's all a fantasy. For a thousand years, the Mary Magdalene story has been one of art's most tremulous myths. In the Bible, she warrants just four actual mentions.

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: James and Jude
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: Judas
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Biblical Women: Was Mary Magdalene a Saint or Sinner?
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?

programme.title: Shroud of Turin: Fraud or Evidence of Christ's Resurrection?
programme.desc: Is it the cloth that covered Jesus in the tomb? A silent witness to the greatest event in history? What are its secrets? New evidence reveals the truth.

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: Jesus' Silent Years: Where Was Jesus All Those Years?
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: I Believe In Easter
programme.desc: Learn how the church adapted and transformed pagan tradition into the celebration of the Resurrection. See how culture, emperors, apostles and popes have influenced how we celebrate Easter today.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Prophecies of the Passion
programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: Twelve Ordinary Men
programme.desc: A look at the twelve disciples who were hand-picked by Jesus to learn from his teachings, and spread the gospel after his crucifixion. Why these men?

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible: Behind the Scenes
programme.desc: Never-before-seen documentary footage takes you on an amazing adventure behind the scenes, to see first-hand how this epic multi-national production was filmed on the very ground where it happened From the Creation to the Resurrection, Heston captures the passion of the Bible through the power of the spoken word, the way its mysteries and legends were originally passed down for generations.

programme.title: Biblical Women
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Third Day
programme.desc: On the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, eyewitnesses reported that they found an empty tomb and had an encounter with a living, breathing Jesus of Nazareth. What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.title: Peter
programme.desc: The Galilean fishmonger, Peter, emerged as pre-eminent amongst the apostles. We look at his controversial life and career ending with his martyrdom in Rome and his place in laying the foundation of the Catholic Church.

programme.title: The Temptation of Christ in the Wilderness
programme.desc: The Gospels include eight pre-resurrection accounts concerning Jesus' power over nature.

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

programme.title: RoboCop 2
programme.desc: In this thrilling sequel, Robocop returns to fight his toughest opponent yet...his replacement!

programme.title: RoboCop 3
programme.desc: When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims...

programme.title: Cherry 2000
programme.desc: In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: Over The Top
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: When a drifter falls in love with two women, he finds himself trapped in a web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: 52 Pick-Up
programme.desc: In this tense thriller, Roy Scheider has it all until a trio of pornographers shows up with a video of him in bed with his mistress. When he tries to pit one blackmailer against the other, the tension mounts - as does the possibility of murder.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

programme.title: Mulholland Falls
programme.desc: In the 1950s, an elite squad of detectives becomes embroiled in a conspiracy and faces a secret the U.S. government is determined to keep hidden.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: Warriors Of Virtue
programme.desc: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Set against the wondrous backdrop of the Great Pyramids, "Stargate" tells the story of two very different men (Kurt Russell, James Spader) who join forces to unravel the mystery of a curious artifact which could reveal the origin of civilization.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: A master safe cracker plans one last heist for the sake of a woman...and a whole new life.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg), the city's toughest cop, is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: A scuba diver washes ashore with his oxygen supply severed; Charlie dives into the Atlantic Ocean to uncover the secret he was killed to protect.

programme.title: A Murdog Mystery
programme.desc: Murdoch discovers his passion for canines while investigating the death of a championship show dog.

programme.title: The Missing
programme.desc: A man claims to be the wealthy heir of a child who was kidnapped 20 years ago.

programme.title: Mr. Murdoch's Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Murdoch and Ogden study human decomposition and find more than they can imagine.

programme.title: From Murdoch to Eternity
programme.desc: Murdoch creates a tonic which restores youth but Crabtree worries about his pursuit of a partnership.

programme.title: Silent Killer
programme.desc: When Bull handles the defense of a building owner accused of killing tenants by carbon monoxide poisoning, the case rocks Bull and the team to their core.

programme.title: Goodbye
programme.desc: Bull and the team head to court one last time to finalize a negligent homicide defense that will change the nature of their company and their lives forever.

programme.title: The Necklace
programme.desc: Dr. Jason Bull uses psychology, intuition and data to create strategies to help clients of his trial consulting firm win cases.

programme.title: The Woman in 8D
programme.desc: Dr. Bull and his team must come up with a new defense for a female pilot accused of negligence when they discover the jury has a gender bias.

programme.title: Unambiguous
programme.desc: Bull and the team tackle jury bias as their client publicly accuses a star athlete of assaulting her; Benny encounters an ex, who happens to be a fellow attorney.

programme.title: Callisto
programme.desc: While helping a young woman fight a drug patent lawsuit, the team must travel to the small Texas town where Bull experienced the only trial loss of his career.

programme.title: Just Tell the Truth
programme.desc: Bull defends the working class fiancé of a murdered socialite; Marissa, Cable and Danny ask Chunk to let them investigate a new guy he wants to date.

programme.title: Bedside Manner
programme.desc: Bull has to find a way to reverse the negative effect of a surgeon with a God complex who is being sued for malpractice; Bull hires a previous client's attorney.

programme.title: The Road Home
programme.desc: As the team searches for a vigilante killer in Cleveland, Rossi's former Marine sergeant goes missing in Los Angeles; J.J.'s secret catches up with her.
When J.J. is abducted, the team looks into her time at the State Department in hope of finding clues regarding her disappearance.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Anderson
programme.desc: The team searches for a pair of suspects responsible for several murders near Pittsburgh; Morgan and Garcia make Valentine's Day plans with their significant others.

programme.title: Gabby
programme.desc: The BAU makes startling discoveries as they search for a 4-year-old girl who went missing while staying with a relative.

programme.title: Persuasion
programme.desc: The BAU must determine the true cause and motive when several drowned people are discovered in the Las Vegas desert.

programme.title: Rabid
programme.desc: Three bodies bitten by humans and animals are found in a shallow grave; Garcia and Reid hide their preparation for a company fitness test from Morgan.

programme.title: The Edge of Winter
programme.desc: Morgan's visit with a survivor of unusual stabbings in upstate New York leads to more questions about the case.

programme.title: Blood Relations
programme.desc: The discovery of two murder victims in West Virginia uncovers a long-simmering feud between two families.

programme.title: What Happens in Mecklinburg ...
programme.desc: The team searches for a commonality when a series of target abductions take place; Savannah is frustrated with Morgan's traveling.

programme.title: Fatal
programme.desc: When people are killed by arsenic poisoning and handwritten death threats are found, the team pursues a suspect fascinated by Greek mythology; Hotch is worried about participating in a Career Day at Jack's school.

programme.title: Angels
programme.desc: When prostitutes are murdered in Texas, their deaths seem to have religious overtones; members of the team are put at risk throughout the course of the investigation.

programme.title: Demons
programme.desc: The investigation in Texas reveals a deep web of corruption; Garcia must save a friend.

programme.title: Buckle Up

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: Toby and Michelle investigate a potential conspiracy linked to a mob murder trial.

programme.title: Caged In
programme.desc: After witnessing the death of an MMA fighter, Toby looks into the business dealings of two rival leagues.

programme.title: The Illustrated Woman
programme.desc: Toby's investigation into the murder of a tattooed woman leads him to believe that corporate espionage and blackmail are behind the killing.

programme.title: Love's a Bitch
programme.desc: The murder of a British spy may be linked to an adulterous dating site.

programme.title: The Long Con
programme.desc: Toby and Michelle team up with a con artist to catch a human trafficker.

programme.title: House of Horrors
programme.desc: An actor is murdered while filming an alleged cursed horror movie.

programme.title: False I.D.

programme.title: Fatal Vision
programme.desc: Toby struggles with PTSD after killing a suspect while the IIB attempts to stop an assassination.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: A serial killer imitates a past murderer; while on maternity leave, Michelle must return to the IIB in order to save her reputation.

programme.title: The Lockup
programme.desc: A former IIB colleague returns and ends up jeopardizing the team's success.

programme.title: Abduction + Memory + Time + Fireworks + Dispersal

programme.title: Metal Saw
programme.desc: MacGyver and the team attempt to rescue Jack's former CIA partner who went missing in Venezuela after finding evidence to take down an international arms dealer.
