programme.title: All You've Got To Do Is Don't
programme.desc: We all find ourselves in seasons when we feel like we don't have what it takes, and we don't know what to do. But don't be afraid or discouraged, because God isn't late - He's working according to His timing. Don't lose hope, and don't give up.

programme.title: This Is That Day
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God's provision helps you overcome a difficult day.

programme.title: Instruments Of Victory
programme.desc: In Instruments Of Victory, we're reminded that victory comes when we place our gifts and even our insecurities in God's hands.

programme.title: You Must Be Important
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals that attacks can signal something valuable on the other side of a storm.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: I Left That Out
programme.desc: Most of us have parts of our lives we'd rather keep hidden, even from God. The disappointment we haven't processed. The questions we haven't asked. The fears we don't want to admit. But what if the breakthrough you're praying for is on the other side of the thing you've been avoiding?

programme.title: It's Worth The Dirt
programme.desc: Wondering if you should give up because progress feels slow?Wisdom isn't choosing what's easiest, it's choosing what's worth it.If you're tempted to quit because it's hard, remember:God uses pressure and patience to prepare you for something greater.

programme.title: Same Lies New Loops
programme.desc: The enemy loves to trap you in the same old lies: It's not enough, and You're not loved. But God's truth breaks the cycle. When you change what you say, you change what you see, and His presence opens a new loop of peace and hope.

programme.title: This Time Around...
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how persistence and obedience help you take the next step in faith.

programme.title: Source Material
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches that your assignment requires following the Holy Spirit's lead.

programme.title: It's Hard To Hear God
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick explains how to recognize, trust and obey God's voice amid noise and uncertainty.

programme.title: Faith to Stay
programme.desc: When we're going through a season that's uncomfortable or uncertain, we often look for a way out. But Jesus demonstrates another way that leads to lasting transformation and fulfillment if we have the faith to follow His example.

programme.title: Why Am I Anxious?
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick explains seven sources of anxiety and ways to lean on God through them.

programme.title: It's Going To Happen Here
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how God makes you fruitful where suffering could have ruined you.

programme.title: What If I Got It Wrong?
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches you to take doubts to Jesus and trust God's purpose over your expectations.

programme.title: Death By Echo (Run It Back)
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shares how to replay God's faithfulness instead of the enemy's empty threats.

programme.title: It Had To Happen
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches why a faithful response to crisis matters more than knowing its cause.

programme.title: It Works In Reverse
programme.desc: God chose you. In It Works In Reverse, Pastor Steven Furtick explains that God shows us what we're chosen for as we move forward in faith.

programme.title: I'm Not Stuck Unless I Stop
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how praise before victory keeps you moving instead of stuck.

programme.title: The Blessing Of Letting Go
programme.desc: In The Blessing Of Letting Go, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that when we worship God in the middle of our situation, it relieves the pressure we feel when we try to handle it on our own.

programme.title: Hold On To Your Song
programme.desc: Jonathan Josephs shows how worship helps you remember God's faithfulness through hardship.

programme.title: Reverse Your Worry
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how tracing worry to its source helps you reverse it.

programme.title: Embrace Your Place
programme.desc: What if where you are right now is exactly where God wants you? He hasn't overlooked you; He's set you apart. Learn how to stop comparing your position to someone else's platform and start embracing the purpose God has for your life.

programme.title: Reverse The Ripple
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how tracing pain to its source can help you write a new story.

programme.title: When God Says Let Go
programme.desc: Is your faith being tested? If you've been waiting on the details of what God has next, remember that God doesn't give a test without a lesson first, so if He's calling you to let go of something, you can trust He's already provided you with what you'll need to take that step.

programme.title: Keep It In Context
programme.desc: When you feel surrounded by pressure and fear, it's easy to lose perspective. But what if God's already provided the help you've been praying for? Keep it in context: the battle isn't proof you're losing, it's evidence that you're carrying something worth fighting for.

programme.title: The Thirst Trap
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how Jesus satisfies desires that would otherwise control you.

programme.title: Where You Meet With God
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how inviting God's presence into your goals guides every step.

programme.title: God Chose You... Will You?
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God's choice moves you beyond limitations into your true identity.

programme.title: See It Differently
programme.desc: Larry Brey shows how shifting focus to God and purpose brings joy beyond difficult circumstances.

programme.title: This Is Bigger Than Them
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches through Caleb how to trust God's promises despite battles and opposition.

programme.title: Sinking In The Storm
programme.desc: When you feel like you're starting to sink in the storm, call on the name of Jesus. He's near, and He won't let you go down. Don't panic and obsess over the problem, because when you sync up with Jesus, things can change just that quick.

programme.title: All Those Times You Didn't See
programme.desc: The efforts you make when no one's watching are the ones God uses to shape you. Just because you don't see the outcome yet doesn't mean He's ignoring you; He's positioning you. Keep showing up while you wait.

programme.title: Now Turn North
programme.desc: God didn't intend for you to live in this struggle; He meant for you to pass through it. This sermon will encourage you to head in the direction of your future and not turn back.

programme.title: Your Next Messy Step
programme.desc: This message is for when life feels uncertain, and you're not sure what God wants you to do next. We often look for strategy or certainty, but God's looking for surrender. Pastor Steven teaches from the life of Jacob how to take the next messy step.

programme.title: It's Not Fair
programme.desc: Are you disappointed because of what happened or because of what you expected would happen? When life feels unfair, it's easy to compare your story to someone else's and wonder why things worked out differently; peace comes when you stop.

programme.title: A Steady Hand For A Sudden Blessing
programme.desc: In A Steady Hand For A Sudden Blessing, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that even when we don't see God moving, His hand still holds us steadily.

programme.title: This Is Then
programme.desc: Some things look stupid to the world… until God uses them to change everything. If you've been holding back because you need everything to make sense, this will call you to trust what God promised and practice gratitude in the hard place.

programme.title: The Prison of Offense
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how to escape offense by treating it as a decision, not an identity.

programme.title: When God Gets Ready
programme.desc: People label, but God names. You don't have to chase identity or earn worth, because you've always been called, loved, and set apart for something more.

programme.title: Not Here
programme.desc: Do you ever feel like your prayers are going unanswered? The enemy wants you to believe God's not listening, but the truth is He hears you. His presence is with you in the mountains and the valleys, and He's working one moment at a time.

programme.title: SO BE IT [Full Album]
programme.desc: The official live video for SO BE IT by Elevation Worship featuring Tiffany Hudson & Chris Brown.

programme.title: God's Up To Something Upstream
programme.desc: In God's Up To Something Upstream!, Pastor Steven reminds us that wherever we have a problem, God already has a plan.

programme.title: Found Fishing
programme.desc: In Found Fishing, we're reminded that Jesus is waiting to meet us right where we're at - all we have to do is come to Him.

programme.title: Hold On To Your Song
programme.desc: Jonathan Josephs shows how worship helps you remember God's faithfulness through hardship.

programme.title: When Jesus Is Your Jury
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals freedom from human opinion and performance through Jesus' verdict.

programme.title: What Are You Doing
programme.desc: Ever find yourself asking God, What are You doing?Some seasons only make sense after you've gone through them. If you're dealing with confusion, frustration,or unmet expectations, remember:God's still working, even when you can't see what He's doing.

programme.title: Don't Waste Your Angel
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how walking in God's promises brings protection, position, and preparation.

programme.title: This Time Around...
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how persistence and obedience help you take the next step in faith.

programme.title: When You Just Can't Win
programme.desc: If you're feeling stuck in a cycle of defeat, remember that God's promises are guaranteed but not automatic. Keep consistently showing up and praising Him for the victories He's given you, because more are on the way.

programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: The God Of A Way
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals that God always provides a way through the season you face.

programme.title: Make Peace With Your Strength

programme.title: The God Of After

programme.title: Your Label Is Lying
programme.desc: This sermon is for someone who has been hearing the same lies from the enemy for so long that you've started to believe them. But you are not your issue. You are not your bad decision. It's time to interrupt your story with truth and leave the lies behind, because the Word says otherwise.

programme.title: I Thought It Was Through

programme.title: God Prompts

programme.title: Hand Him The Plan

programme.title: My Joy Is My Job

programme.desc: The DEA's elite special operations division uses an unprecedented and risky sting operation to infiltrate Monzer Al-Kassar's inner circle.

programme.desc: Superstars Afrika Bambaataa, Melle Mel, and Baron Ambrosia help guide Anthony through the music, food and art of the often misunderstood, most northern part of NYC.

programme.desc: Anthony is thrust into Paraguay by investigating his great, great, great, grandfather, Paraguayan émigré Jean Bourdain, while sampling savory local dishes that include Bife Koygua, Bori Bori, and Sopa Paraguaya.

programme.title: Vietnam
programme.desc: Anthony travels to his first love, Hue in central Vietnam, as he visits the Dong Ba market, Vinh Moc tunnels, the Duyen Anh restaurant and the Citadel.

programme.desc: Bourdain comes face to face with lions, elephants, and the great migration in Zanzibar, Tanzania, a one-time slave trade hub, and samples mandazi, grilled seafood and the famous Zanzibari pizza.

programme.title: Iran
programme.desc: Bourdain and his crew take their long-awaited first trip to Iran, sampling Dizi, Fesenjan, Biryani, and Tahdig; tour guides include Washington Post reporter Jason Rezaian and his wife Yeganeh Salehi, who were detainees of the Iranian government.

programme.title: Crack 99: Defense Secrets for Sale

programme.title: Fidel's Personal Spies: The Myers
programme.desc: After arresting Fidel, the intelligence community learns that classified information still reaches Cuba.

programme.title: Heroin's Godfather: Haji Bagcho
programme.desc: DEA agents hunt down the world's biggest heroin trafficker in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Spy and Son: The Nicholsons
programme.desc: The FBI and CIA embark on a decade-long effort to catch the highest-ranking CIA officer to ever commit espionage and his son who also joined the spy game.

programme.title: Medusa Deluxe
programme.desc: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

programme.title: The Trap
programme.desc: A man returns home to Atlanta to save his family's struggling restaurant with the help of a new chicken recipe.

programme.title: Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
programme.desc: Follows actor Samuel L. Jackson and his six-decade journey to becoming one of Hollywood's highest-grossing film actors.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: The Cotton Club
programme.desc: The lives of various characters intersect at Harlem's renowned Cotton Club. Handsome horn player Dix Dwyer falls for Vera Cicero, the stunning girlfriend of famous gangster Dutch Schultz. Meanwhile, Dix's brother, Vincent, falls in with Schultz's crew, while Owney Madden, the jazz venue's proprietor, has his own mob ties. Although Dix goes on to become a Hollywood actor, his life doesn't get any less complicated or dangerous.

programme.title: Greyson Family Christmas
programme.desc: An ambitious African-American law student returns home for Christmas with her boyfriend. The family is unsettled because the boyfriend is white.

programme.title: A Snowy Day in Oakland
programme.desc: A beautiful psychologist from San Francisco decides to end a stalled romance with her high-profile psychiatrist boyfriend and business partner. She moves on with her life by opening her own practice in a vacant office space in the middle of a small commercial block located across the bay in Oakland, turning the predominately African American and psychologically ignored neighborhood on its emotional ear.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, a high-school basketball player, his sister and their older brother face life-changing decisions as they struggle to make something of themselves.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
programme.desc: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Crossover
programme.desc: The lives of a gifted athlete (Wesley Jonathan) and his best friend (Anthony Mackie) change when they take a fateful trip to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: A recently released convict takes murderous revenge against his childhood friends who let him take the fall for their crimes.

programme.title: Snipes
programme.desc: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: Blue Hill Avenue
programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.title: Christmas in Carolina
programme.desc: Career-driven investment banker Elle has given up on love until she meets Wesley, who invites her to his hometown in South Carolina, where she rediscovers the spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
programme.desc: Framed for a homicide by his fellow officers, a detective (Dean Ambrose) tries to expose the conspiracy to clear his good name.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: After the senseless murder of her son (Aml Ameen), a grief-stricken mother (Viola Davis) joins forces with another woman (Jennifer Lopez) for vigilante justice.

programme.title: Caught in the Crossfire
programme.desc: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: Traffik
programme.desc: Brea and John embark on a romantic weekend getaway to an isolated estate in the mountains. They are pleasantly surprised when two of their friends, Darren and Malia, also show up unexpectedly. Their plans for fun soon give way to terror when members of a violent biker gang invade the peaceful countryside. Banded together, they now find themselves in a fight for their lives as their assailants will stop at nothing to protect their secrets from the outside world.

programme.title: April Fools
programme.desc: A cruel prank on April Fool's Day has deadly consequences for a group of Chicago teenagers.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: Black Harvest: From Embryom Chronicles
programme.desc: A lone Raider embarks on a cursed journey across a landscape of industrial decay and living horror. In search of a rare substance harvested within these poisoned lands, every step drags him deeper into the true cost of survival. Includes BTS footage.

programme.title: Elcano: Primus Circumdedisti Me
programme.desc: The untold story of Juan Sebastián Elcano, the man who finished Magellan's impossible voyage and became the first to sail around the world. A raw, violent, and intimate short film about survival, ambition, and the price of glory at sea.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: The burgers are wrong. The play area is infinite. There's something in the brine. MidBurger wishes you happy holidays and reminds you: we tried. That's enough.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: After years of war, Elijah Kelly returns home to Mill Ford - but the town is not empty, it is waiting. What he uncovers doesn't end with his homecoming; it's only the start of a fight to survive something far worse.

programme.title: Volume 2
programme.desc: All Donnie ever wanted was for someone to see him. For the first time, he experiences unconditional love and acceptance, but begins to wonder why.

programme.title: Drama volume 1
programme.desc: A creator contemplates how he fits into the future. An astronaut faces infinite solitude. A boy finds peace in difference. A bear reveals hidden love. A girl transforms grief into wonder. Six films about what it means to be human.

programme.title: Best of the Wonder Film Festival
programme.desc: The Best of Wonder Studios presents five visionary AI-generated films exploring memory, purpose, and the stories we tell. The Granniest Grandma follows Eleanor, pulled back into work she thought abandoned, discovering purpose isn't dead -- just dormant. The Cinema That Never Was mourns films lost to never existing, imagining what could have been. Pinkington: Owlvolution chronicles Trisha and Tonya's intergalactic adventures after stealing a UFO and signing a 500-year sponsorship deal.

programme.title: Experimental
programme.desc: An anthology of five experimental short films proving that AI can be used to create affecting art.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Mick and Lind struggle to survive after losing their dockyard jobs.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Commander Nino Kuro and her crew must find the legendary Noctari to save their world from extinction.

programme.title: Documentaries & Mockumentaries volume 2
programme.desc: Four short films exploring diverse themes: a world overflowing with uncollected trash, AI characters attempting to fulfill a vague human prompt, the history of Rhodiola Rosea, and the harsh realities of modeling.

programme.title: surRIHL Showcase volume 3
programme.desc: A curated playlist of AI-created music videos by surRIHL.

programme.title: surRIHL Presents: The Future Is Surreal
programme.desc: Reality bends as human imagination meets advanced AI. surRIHL presents a breathtaking cinematic descent into dreamcore worlds and high-impact visual poetry. The future isn't automated-it's beautifully, unpredictably surreal.

programme.title: Small Town Mysteries
programme.desc: True Crime Stories: Small Town Mysteries explores crimes hidden in tight-knit communities where everyone knows everyone. From shocking disappearances to murders exposing buried secrets, each story reveals how intimacy, isolation, and loyalty can conceal deadly truths.

programme.title: Mike Mitch
programme.desc: BLVCKL!GHT AI welcomes Mike Mitch of Phantom X for a candid conversation about his latest work, the creative process behind it and where he sees AI filmmaking heading next.

programme.title: Episode One
programme.desc: Made On Fairground kicks off with a countdown of the ten top-performing titles on Fairground AI TV, then sits down for an exclusive interview with the filmmaker behind the film that claimed the No. 1 spot.

programme.title: Volume 2
programme.desc: Explore the depths of Greek mythology through the stories of the Fates, Orpheus, the Sirens, Circe, Atlantis, and Hades. These stories reveal how ancient legends mirror the human mind and the inevitable truths of existence.

programme.title: Mike Mitch
programme.desc: BLVCKL!GHT AI welcomes Mike Mitch of Phantom X for a candid conversation about his latest work, the creative process behind it and where he sees AI filmmaking heading next.

programme.title: Drama volume 3
programme.desc: A series of vignettes exploring human connection: a lodge owner seeks rest, a man reflects on fleeting love, and a mother nervously prepares to reunite with her daughter after 20 years apart.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Ancient stories of gods and monsters, reinterpreting myths like Medusa, the Minotaur, and Prometheus as mirrors of the human mind, explaining fear, power, and fate.

programme.title: Bones of Yew
programme.desc: Bones of Yew tells the untold story of peasant archers during the Hundred Years' War, whose longbow skill reshaped nations. Includes behind-the-scenes showing how the filmmaker used real-world data capture alongside generative AI filmmaking tools.

programme.title: Mob Bosses
programme.desc: True Crime Stories: Mob Bosses chronicles history's ruthless kingpins from Prohibition to post-war America. These real figures built empires from blood and loyalty, shaping cities through power, silence, and brutal ambition. Every empire eventually falls.

programme.title: surRIHL Showcase volume 4
programme.desc: A curated playlist of AI-created music videos by surRIHL.

programme.title: Volume 2
programme.desc: Explore the depths of Greek mythology through the stories of the Fates, Orpheus, the Sirens, Circe, Atlantis, and Hades. These stories reveal how ancient legends mirror the human mind and the inevitable truths of existence.

programme.title: Beyond the Loop: The Hill
programme.desc: Born silent, a young man walks through strangers' dreams until fragments bleed into his own life. This haunting fantasy explores empathy and identity through visual poetry. Includes a behind-the-scenes documentary on the film's creation.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Explore a "Mysterious Planet" with Barnabas Deepcraft. From oceanic "financial advice" barnacles to 6,000,000-count stones and colonial superorganisms, discover surreal creatures thriving in bogs, clifftops, and thermal shelves.

programme.title: The Mean Orange Cat vs The Lost City of Atlantis
programme.desc: Mean Orange Cat discovers the advanced, hidden civilization of Atlantis while investigating a UFO crash.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Mary, a caretaker at The Drakewood Shelter, attempts to rescue a bat-like creature from an angry mob, a girl comes to Monster Town with a dangerous secret, and a man must venture into the sewers of Monster Town to save his sick daughter.

programme.title: NYC & Croatia
programme.desc: The book takes the team to New York City and Croatia.

programme.title: Uncanny Harry
programme.desc: Five films by Uncanny Harry. A delivery driver is sent on a dangerous dispatch, found footage shows how two cavers went missing, two lovers converge on a doomed ocean liner, a man seeks revenge on a wolf, and Harry Mental shares his story.

programme.title: Uncanny Harry
programme.desc: Five films by Uncanny Harry. A delivery driver is sent on a dangerous dispatch, found footage shows how two cavers went missing, two lovers converge on a doomed ocean liner, a man seeks revenge on a wolf, and Harry Mental shares his story.

programme.title: Volume 1

programme.title: Volume 2
programme.desc: Heists, hover-bike chases, an army of Elite police androids, and a secret buried in Max's own body. Welcome back to the trench.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Sox short films. Five things we may lose to progress. The Last asks whether humanity can survive its own optimization.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: In episodes 1-3, Wendy and Whitsby steal a UFO and accidentally make it home, but it's not as empty as they thought. For the first time, they get to choose where it takes them next.

programme.title: Small Town Noir
programme.desc: Three grim stories: a lifelong thief, a self-proclaimed satanist convicted of a double murder, and the many exploits of a miner and tavern owner.

programme.title: Small Town Mysteries
programme.desc: True Crime Stories: Small Town Mysteries explores crimes hidden in tight-knit communities where everyone knows everyone. From shocking disappearances to murders exposing buried secrets, each story reveals how intimacy, isolation, and loyalty can conceal deadly truths.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: In 2375, a world that has catalogued every living thing wakes the one thing it can't explain. Anya opens her eyes under a sky that already knows her name - and the Origin is watching. Includes "making of" behind-the-scenes footage.

programme.title: The Noctuary
programme.desc: The Noctuary brings horror home: a lonely midnight dig that ends in a desperate escape, a boy who realizes his mother isn't his mother, sisters whose hide-and-seek wakes the Shadow Man, and a bedtime routine where something waits.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Porch Stories counts one trick-or-treater too many. Holloway sets a family table for something unseen. Taotie unleashes a soul-hungry beast of Chinese myth. The Sister follows a survivor who returns to the ruin where her brother vanished.

programme.title: Horror
programme.desc: Some roads lead nowhere good. Some rooms should stay empty. Some windows reveal too much. Some caves keep what enters. Five dark films where the real horror was always waiting just out of sight.

programme.title: Horror volume 2

programme.title: Volume 3

programme.title: Volume 1

programme.title: Volume 3
programme.desc: Being the most famous person on the planet comes with a cost.

programme.title: Prologue

programme.title: The Miracle

programme.title: Leatherface
programme.desc: A teenage Leatherface escapes from a mental hospital with three other inmates, kidnapping a young nurse and taking her on a road trip from hell, while being pursued by a lawman out for revenge.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw 3D
programme.desc: Decades ago, residents of Newt, Texas, long suspected that the Sawyer family was responsible for the disappearances of many people. When their suspicions finally were confirmed, vigilantes torched the Sawyer compound and killed every member of the family -- or so they thought. Much later, a young woman named Heather (Alexandra Daddario) learns that she has inherited Texas property from an unknown relative, and she is unaware of horrors that await in the mansion's dank cellar.

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons, an upper-class family, are extremely wealthy -- but also estranged. In an attempt to mend their broken family ties, Aubrey and Paul Davison decide to celebrate their wedding anniversary by inviting their four children and their children's significant others to their weekend estate. The celebration gets off to a rocky start, but when crossbow-wielding assailants in animal masks suddenly attack, the Davisons must pull together or die.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: Sorry to Bother You
programme.desc: In an alternate reality of present-day Oakland, Calif., telemarketer Cassius Green finds himself in a macabre universe after he discovers a magical key that leads to material glory. As Green's career begins to take off, his friends and co-workers organize a protest against corporate oppression. Cassius soon falls under the spell of Steve Lift, a cocaine-snorting CEO who offers him a salary beyond his wildest dreams.

programme.title: Lesbian Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Two best buddies (James Corden, Mathew Horne) encounter a nest of beautiful Sapphic bloodsuckers.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes."

programme.title: Highlander: The Source
programme.desc: Duncan MacLeod and a group of companions embark on a quest to discover the origin of their immortality.

programme.title: Highlander II: Renegade Version
programme.desc: In this sci-fi/fantasy sequel, Connor MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) has become an elderly man after losing his immortality. Living in a bleak future where the world is protected from solar radiation by a massive shield, MacLeod regains his youth when he kills two assassins from his home planet. This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: While battling a trio of rampaging giants, the legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters Nimue the Blood Queen, an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

programme.title: Hirokin
programme.desc: A warrior (Wes Bentley) leads an uprising against the ruler (Julian Sands) of a planet.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: While battling a trio of rampaging giants, the legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters Nimue the Blood Queen, an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

programme.title: Hirokin
programme.desc: A warrior (Wes Bentley) leads an uprising against the ruler (Julian Sands) of a planet.

programme.title: Iron Mask
programme.desc: To save his homeland from certain doom, a kung fu master must escape from the maniacal James Hook in order to send his daughter a secret talisman that will allow her to control a massive and mythical dragon.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Nurse
programme.desc: A young nurse (Katrina Bowden) begins to suspect that a sexy colleague (Paz de la Huerta) is responsible for murdering a string of unfaithful men.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Separated from their father (Michael Kelly), two teenage sisters (Sofia Black-D'Elia, Analiegh Tipton) try to survive an apocalyptic viral outbreak that leads to a quarantine.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Contestants will be laying on their back bound at their ankles, waist, and one wrist to a plexiglass platform that is hung from a helicopter. Contestants will play a game to determine how much skunk, possum, rattlesnake and armadillo they will have to eat. Contestants will have to cross 4, 20-foot rotating beams placing flags along the way.

programme.title: Episode 27
programme.desc: Players must wedge themselves between two walls to avoid falling, eat live snails, and jump cars into trucks.

programme.title: Traverse Dam/Bee Headed/Water Coffin
programme.desc: Are you worth a Dam? Suspended high over a dam is a 350-foot long tightrope with flags attached. Contestants would have to cross the tightrope and collect flags while holding on to a higher tightrope for support. The two men and the two women to collect the most flags in 5 minutes would advance to the next round. Stunt 2 is a real Bee. The ones left are covered with over 200,000 honeybees.

programme.title: Burning Building/Scorpion Pit/Rotating Climbing WallF
programme.desc: It's hot for the first stunt as contestants climb a ladder, enter the fourth floor, follow a hose line to a room they put out a fire, rescue a dummy, and get out of the building. The two slowest are eliminated. In the second stunt, they lie in pit with over 3,000 scorpions.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants brave a gross dunk tank and slalom to grab flags from a speeding helicopter

programme.title: Spin Cycle/Breakfast of Champions/Stilt Walking
programme.desc: Contestants climb a rope ladder hanging from a spinning girder and cross monkey bars from one end of the girder to the other and release a flag and drop into the water below. programme.desc: Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.

programme.title: The Valentine's Day Episode
programme.desc: Nick lends a hand to Kevin for his Valentine's Day at school, but things take a turn as Kevin ends up being sent home.

programme.title: The Take Your Kids to Work Day Episode
programme.desc: When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's, a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother.

programme.title: The Test Taker Episode
programme.desc: Kevin assists Frankie in preparing for an exam, but Frankie offers a bribe to persuade Kevin to take the test on his behalf.

programme.title: The Play Date Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, but the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.

programme.title: The Nick's Kid Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne suspects that Nick may have fathered his ex-flame's son. Ice Cube and Kandi Burruss guest star.

programme.title: The Sex Symbol Episode
programme.desc: After a website votes Nick Sexiest Seattle Sportscaster, he tries to embrace his new image; Nick soon learns being a sex symbol isn't all it's cracked up to be.

programme.title: The Bucket List Episode
programme.desc: Nick worries about his mortality and creates a bucket list featuring overly dangerous activities. Meanwhile, Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy ring at school.

programme.title: The Boy Has Style Episode
programme.desc: When Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay, Nick sets out to prove that he isn't.

programme.title: The Cyrano Episode
programme.desc: Nick helps out a coworker by ghostwriting him love letters for a woman on a dating website who turns out to be Gigi.

programme.title: The Day Off Episode
programme.desc: Nick tries to help his mother forge bonds with Kevin and Lindsey. Meanwhile, Suzanne gets the day off.

programme.title: The Expensive Purse Episode
programme.desc: Against Nick's wishes, Suzanne buys an expensive purse and Nick becomes suspicious about it, so he uses her guilt to his advantage.

programme.title: The Bad Dream Episode
programme.desc: After Kevin watches the horror film "The Sixth Sense," he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.

programme.title: The Mr. Himdependent Episode
programme.desc: When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance to get rid of Frank's financial support, while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank.

programme.title: The Master of Ceremonies Episode
programme.desc: While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.

programme.title: The Hand on a House Episode
programme.desc: Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.

programme.title: The Nick Gets an Assistant Episode
programme.desc: Nick is coerced into hiring an assistant, but the newbie gets too close to Nick's family and friends.

programme.title: The Rat inThe House Episode
programme.desc: When a rat gets lost in the home, Kevin scurries to care for it. Meanwhile, an ex-flame creates surging tension between Lindsey and Gigi.

programme.title: The Man and the Bragging Snafu Episode
programme.desc: When Nick's colleague at the station encourages him to send Lindsey and Kevin to a private school, Nick and Suzanne look into it, only to be misled about the process.

programme.title: The No Nah Nah Episode
programme.desc: An exhausted Nick resists Suzanne's romantic advances, leading her to worry about the health of their relationship.

programme.title: The Pole Dance Episode
programme.desc: When Suzanne catches Nick spying a racy rap video featuring a pole dancer, she sets out to show him her own pole-dancing prowess.

programme.title: The Regift Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne is upset when Marilyn gives her an ugly bracelet as a present, but things get even uglier when Nick sees it and realizes he bought it for Marilyn and that she's re-gifted.

programme.title: The Good Cop, Bad Cop Episode
programme.desc: When Suzanne gets tired of playing the role of bad cop to Nick's good cop, she makes it Nick's job to say "No" to the kids for an entire week.

programme.title: The Long Con Episode
programme.desc: Nick attempts to make a profit off an expensive set of African masks that Kevin bought at a yard sale, but instead, he becomes the victim of a larger scam.

programme.title: The Bigg Box Klub Episode
programme.desc: Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk that the family doesn't need at the The Big Box Club, discount super store.

programme.title: The Blackout Episode
programme.desc: A guys' night out goes awry, resulting in lost recollections due to alcohol-fueled blackouts and the disappearance of Nick's wedding ring.

programme.title: The Kleptomaniac Episode
programme.desc: Nick is enlisted to host a charity walkathon. Meanwhile, Marilyn's bracelet goes missing, and the children train for their participation in the charity walk.

programme.title: The Suzanne Gets One-Upped Episode
programme.desc: Nick plans a belated surprise honeymoon for Suzanne, but keeping it a secret causes complications. Elsewhere, Lindsey helps Kevin with his homework.

programme.title: The My First Job Episode
programme.desc: Lindsey gets her first job at a fast food restaurant, but soon gets fired when she gives out free food.

programme.title: The Quarantine Episode
programme.desc: When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must stay inside their house under quarantine.

programme.title: The Pocket Dial Episode
programme.desc: After Nick gets pocket-dialed by Suzanne and overhears her telling Gigi something personal, he gets back at Suzanne by fake pocketing dialling her.

programme.title: The Hyphenated Name Episode
programme.desc: A newlywed couple (Terry Crews, Essence Atkins) with two children face various blended-family obstacles in this sitcom based on the 2005 film of the same name. First up

programme.title: The Thanksgiving Episode
programme.desc: The entire Kingston-Persons clan is at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, but Suzanne's forgotten one thing, the turkey.

programme.title: The Fight Party Episode
programme.desc: Suzanne's book group and Nick's boxing-match party collide in the family room on the same night, resulting in knock-out clashing.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: The Sea Lion King
programme.desc: From Australia's southwest coast comes the tale of a sea lion pup and the unique animals that share its rugged home.

programme.title: Lizards of Oz
programme.desc: Australia is the driest inhabited continent on the planet with much of the inland being a virtual desert and home to many kinds of lizards.

programme.title: Band of Bears - In the Forests of Scandinavia
programme.desc: Colin Solman follows the journey of a brown mama bear and her three playful cubs in a Scandinavian forest where sustenance and safety often become a challenge amid changing seasons.

programme.title: Band of Bears - In the Forests of Scandinavia
programme.desc: Colin Solman follows the journey of a brown mama bear and her three playful cubs in a Scandinavian forest where sustenance and safety often become a challenge amid changing seasons.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: Learning about four different regions of Switzerland. From the rugged mountains of the Ticino High Alps to the lovely Muggio Valley in the southernmost corner of Ticino, hardly any other canton is so full of contrasts.

programme.title: Water and Ice
programme.desc: The river called Aare is the only body of water that runs through Switzerland. It rises from a source in the Bernese Alps and finally flows into the Rhine. The Aare offers important habitat for flora and fauna.

programme.title: Our Nature
programme.desc: An exploration of the many species of birds, wildcats, fish, elephants, whales and more living on the seven continents.

programme.title: Saliega's Lineage
programme.desc: The Iberian lynx is the most endangered feline on the planet. At the beginning of this century, the lynx was on the brink of its final extinction. Then Saliega arrived, the first of her species to raise a litter of Iberian lynxes in captivity.

programme.title: The Underdogs
programme.desc: Portraying small, wild dogs that use adaptability to win their battles and achieve their goals.

programme.title: Beach Jackals
programme.desc: Threatened by Southern Africa's farmers, black-backed jackals find new shelter in the restricted and arid area of Namibia's Skeleton Coast. They adapt to a new lifestyle and learn to cooperate to hunt bigger prey, like fur seals.

programme.title: Nature's Survivors
programme.desc: Exploring how mountain goats know a volcano is about to erupt, what happens to birds trapped in the eye of a cyclone, and a range of other topics concerning how animals cope with natural disasters.

programme.title: Chicken Planet
programme.desc: The love story between chickens and humans has lasted for over 5000 years. Today, there are over 19 billion chickens on Earth, three times more than human beings and more than any other bird species.

programme.title: Volcano Doctors
programme.desc: Everything you always wanted to know about volcanoes! Here, we meet the volcanologists who lead us into the heart of the abyss and allow us to see the invisible.

programme.title: Phoenix Temple
programme.desc: A close-up look at volcanoes, exploring how these startling eruptions affect the surrounding environment. Featuring a visit to the volcano Messiah, in Nicaragua.

programme.title: The Surprise Salmon
programme.desc: Jeremy Irons narrates the earth-shattering series. Almost 2,000 years ago, a volcanic eruption forced the Sockeye Salmon to flee its native North American river.

programme.title: Life on Fire: Icelandic Volcanoes
programme.desc: A volcanic eruption strikes fear in people, as there are more that could erupt at any moment.

programme.title: Pioneers of the Deep
programme.desc: The series that takes us inside volcanoes. This episode tells the story, spread over millions of years, of volcanic activity in the tropical Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Ash Runners
programme.desc: Earth-shattering series offering a close-up look at volcanoes. On the island of New Britain, some animals manage to cope with the volcanic ash that invades their habitat.

programme.title: Lake Como
programme.desc: Lake Como is distinguished by its fauna and flora. The Pian di Spagna Nature Reserve is a haven for migratory birds, and Giardino della Valle di Cernobbio, an ancient landfill transformed into a garden, reveals its natural treasures.

programme.title: Lake Lugano
programme.desc: Around 250 million years ago, Lake Lugano was a coral reef populated by marine dinosaurs. Today, this place is populated by great crested grebes and aquatic birds with dark plumage.

programme.title: Lago Maggiore
programme.desc: At Lake Maggiore, the inhabitants are working to preserve its wild nature. Professional fisherman Marco Rodella explains why most of the fish on the restaurant menu do not come from the lake.

programme.title: Lake Como
programme.desc: Lake Como is distinguished by its fauna and flora. The Pian di Spagna Nature Reserve is a haven for migratory birds, and Giardino della Valle di Cernobbio, an ancient landfill transformed into a garden, reveals its natural treasures.

programme.title: Lake Garda
programme.desc: Lake Garda is home to countless water birds, Mediterranean plants, and exotic insects, which coexist near the remains of ancient civilisations.

programme.title: Lake Iseo
programme.desc: Between Lake Como and Lake Garda lies the smaller Lake Iseo. Less well known than its big brothers, it is considerably quieter. People here live on fish, olives, and even saffron.
