programme.title: Trials & Tribulations
programme.desc: Jessica is accused of false testimony and bribery in the death of an escaping murderer, and the man's daughter (Carrie Hamilton) takes Jessica to court.

programme.title: Deadly Misunderstanding
programme.desc: When Jessica suffers a broken arm, she hires a typist to meet her deadline, but she must clear the woman of a murder charge.

programme.title: See You in Court, Baby
programme.desc: Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell) tries to clear a man of charges he murdered an unscrupulous divorce attorney.

programme.title: Hannigan's Wake
programme.desc: Jessica reopens a 16-year-old murder case at the urging of a dying author (Van Johnson) who felt injustice was done.

programme.title: Family Jewels
programme.desc: Jessica attends a political fundraiser with her friend Drew (Mike Farrell), but the focus turns to murder when another guest's chauffeur is murdered.

programme.title: A Body to Die For
programme.desc: A physical-fitness instructor (Jason Beghe) who has captivated Cabot Cove's female population is linked to the murder of a con artist.

programme.title: The Return of Preston Giles
programme.desc: Jessica's first publisher (Arthur Hill), imprisoned for murder, is paroled and requires her help when he is suspected of a similar crime.

programme.title: The Great Twain Robbery
programme.desc: Jessica's friend Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell) is called to investigate when a purported Mark Twain manuscript leads to murder.

programme.title: Ballad for a Blue Lady
programme.desc: Jessica becomes enmeshed in feuds, infidelity and murder in Nashville when visiting her friend, blues singer Patti Sue Diamond (Florence Henderson), whose country-singer husband, Bobby (Jimmy Dean) is having trouble with his manager.

programme.title: Murder in F Sharp
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Dennis Stanton confronts murder and arson while on a case involving a famous pianist (Ricardo Montalban).

programme.title: Family Doctor
programme.desc: Jessica and Seth inadvertently get entangled in a crime family's power struggle after a sniper attack in Boston wounds a mob boss.

programme.title: Suspicion of Murder
programme.desc: Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell) investigates when he is accused of murdering his girlfriend's estranged husband.

programme.title: Moving Violation
programme.desc: Sheriff Metzger (Ron Masak) defies political pressure and arrests an ambassador's son for murder, then is accused of the crime.

programme.title: Who Killed J.B. Fletcher?
programme.desc: A member of Jessica's fan club mysteriously dies while impersonating her to investigate cheating at a dog show.

programme.title: The Taxman Cometh
programme.desc: Jessica's old friend (Phyllis Newman) is accused of murder when $2 million in tax payments disappears and her ex-husband is found dead.

programme.title: From the Horse's Mouth
programme.desc: Jessica and detective Harry McGraw (Jerry Orbach) investigate the murder of a Thoroughbred owner whose prize horse has sired two unplanned foals.

programme.title: The Prodigal Father
programme.desc: The presumed-dead perpetrator (Donnelly Rhodes) of a 20-year-old bank robbery resurfaces, then is murdered.

programme.title: Where Have You Gone, Billy Boy?
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Dennis Stanton becomes involved in a murder case while delving into the disappearance of a shy ventriloquist's (Grant Shaud) dummy.

programme.title: Thursday's Child
programme.desc: Jessica is pulled into a murder investigation by a woman (Vera Miles) who claims Jessica's husband fathered her son.

programme.title: Murder, Plain and Simple
programme.desc: While traveling with her publisher's assistant in Amish country, Jessica's involvement in a traffic mishap leads her to a murder.

programme.title: Tainted Lady
programme.desc: Jessica comes to the aid of a small-town diner's owner (Dee Wallace Stone), who becomes an outcast when she is blamed for three arsenic poisoning deaths.

programme.title: The Skinny According to Nick Cullhane
programme.desc: A writer is murdered after sending Jessica a manuscript exposing a kidnapping scam, and Jessica's friend, private investigator Harry McGraw (Jerry Orbach) is caught near the body.

programme.title: Bite the Big Apple
programme.desc: Jessica takes a teaching position in New York, gets an apartment and finds its previous tenant murdered.

programme.title: Night Fears
programme.desc: A policeman-turned-professor challenges Jessica to solve a series of campus muggings that soon escalates to murder.

programme.title: Unauthorized Obituary
programme.desc: A friend (Bradford Dillman) is suspected of killing the author (Jessica Walter) who was writing an unauthorized biography of his wife.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Sheriff Metzger assumes his younger brother, the black sheep of the family, is guilty of murder, as charged.

programme.title: Lines of Excellence
programme.desc: New computer owner Jessica discovers hackers gathering information for blackmail, a crime that leads to murder.

programme.title: Judge Not
programme.desc: Jessica probes a 20-year-old unsolved murder after attending the funeral of a New Orleans jazz great.

programme.title: Terminal Connection
programme.desc: Jessica attempts to prove a battered wife innocent of killing her husband after failing to convince the woman to defend herself.

programme.title: A Killing in Vegas
programme.desc: Jessica tries to disprove charges against her friend's boyfriend, suspected of murdering a Las Vegas casino manager.

programme.title: The Committee
programme.desc: After Jessica speaks at an exclusive men's club, they ask her to investigate when one of their members is murdered, and they are all suspects.

programme.title: The List of Uri Lermentov
programme.desc: Jessica finds herself amid international espionage while attending a trade reception in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Danse Diabolique
programme.desc: Jessica is convinced that a ballerina who died during her premiere performance in a new ballet was actually murdered.

programme.title: The Witch's Curse
programme.desc: Cabot Cove suspects a woman (Mary Crosby) playing a witch in a community play is the real thing; guest Robert Vaughn.

programme.title: Incident in Lot No. 7
programme.desc: The would-be producer (Ron Leibman) of the movie adaptation of Jessica's latest book dies, leaving Jessica to identify possible suspects.

programme.title: The Monte Carlo Murders
programme.desc: While visiting an old friend (Dina Merrill) who runs a Monte Carlo hotel, Jessica investigates the murder of a ruthless businessman with numerous enemies.

programme.title: New Challenges: October-December 1943
programme.desc: While Hitler faced frustrations on all fronts, and the Japanese were kept at bay by the Americans, despite heavy US casualties, the Allied leaders faced a new challenge. Although Churchill and Roosevelt had always been comfortable working together, the Russian leader Joseph Stalin had in the past been regarded more as a foe than a friend.

programme.title: Dwight D. Eisenhower, Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.

programme.title: The Allies Forge On
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: Big Picture: Truth is Our Defense
programme.desc: This is the story of the Army's Psychological Warfare activities in the Far East Command, primarily as a tactical weapon in Korea. We augment the effectiveness of our combat forces with the potent weapon of words. Through leaflets, shot by artillery shells or dropped from planes; through radio news and through loudspeakers mounted on tanks and jeeps, we send our messages of truth to the enemy.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: To Adolf Hitler in 1940, Britain was no more than an irritant on his periphery to his rapidly expanding Third Reich. He was correct in his assumption that Britain had been almost fatally weakened by the fight of Dunkirk. If Britain were to be subdued, there seemed to be no more auspicious time than 1940. The Luftwaffe had proven themselves invincible, which filled them with pride and enthusiasm.

programme.title: Big Picture: The United Nations Line Is Stabilized While Truce Talks Continue
programme.desc: Our patrols in probing actions... The attack on Hill 1179... The return of Seoul refugees... and more of the ceasefire negotiations. Two combat cameramen of the Army Signal Corps are interviewed, Corporal John Romanowski of Chicago, Illinois, and Sergeant Lee Marks of Providence, Rhode Island. They tell a dramatic story of filming our troops for the newsreels and for 'The Big Picture.'

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: The downed 'Messer' crashes in a forest but doesn't explode. Both Germans and Soviet scouts race to recover its night-vision device. Its creator, German scientist Holts, also seeks it, tracking Soviet moves and anticipating the Swallows' aerial reconnaissance. The wreck lies in a swamp, making recovery far more difficult.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft - WWI
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry discusses the fighters of WWI, like the Nieuport 17, Albatross, Sopwith Camel, Fokker, and many more.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: To Adolf Hitler in 1940, Britain was no more than an irritant on his periphery to his rapidly expanding Third Reich. He was correct in his assumption that Britain had been almost fatally weakened by the fight of Dunkirk. If Britain were to be subdued, there seemed to be no more auspicious time than 1940. The Luftwaffe had proven themselves invincible, which filled them with pride and enthusiasm.

programme.title: Hitler's Junkies
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. Developed in 1938, this 'miracle pill' boosted soldiers' endurance and morale, becoming a weapon of war. Declassified files, including Hitler's medical records, uncover Project D-IX and reveal how meth shaped Nazi power and altered the course of history.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: The downed 'Messer' crashes in a forest but doesn't explode. Both Germans and Soviet scouts race to recover its night-vision device. Its creator, German scientist Holts, also seeks it, tracking Soviet moves and anticipating the Swallows' aerial reconnaissance. The wreck lies in a swamp, making recovery far more difficult.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Sir David searches out Britain's eccentric amateur inventors and backyard boffins, who played a key role in the defeat of Hitler and created the machinery of 21st-century surveillance.

programme.title: Rattling The Saber
programme.desc: During this hour, witness the World shaking events that took place of the years immediately preceding WW2. You'll also see the Nazi subjugation of France and England's heroic defense in the Battle of Britain. Pearl Harbor is also discussed.

programme.title: The Means to Victory
programme.desc: The Blitz shook Britain, but the Allies struck back harder with strategic bombing. Technology advanced-radar, gun turrets, and bomb sights changed everything. Civil defenses rose. After Pearl Harbor, the US joined in, bringing more bombers, more power, and a new level of destruction to the war.

programme.title: Women of Ravensbrück: Inside Nazi Horrors
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.

programme.title: Big Picture: Truth is Our Defense
programme.desc: This is the story of the Army's Psychological Warfare activities in the Far East Command, primarily as a tactical weapon in Korea. We augment the effectiveness of our combat forces with the potent weapon of words. Through leaflets, shot by artillery shells or dropped from planes; through radio news and through loudspeakers mounted on tanks and jeeps, we send our messages of truth to the enemy.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: During WWII, a squadron faces a treacherous airdrome mission. Bordeaux loses film, compromising the op. They celebrate a victory but face danger later. A pilot reveals fatigue and refuses duty. Charged as a coward, he returns home to a different life. War impacts loved ones, and exemptions stir emotions.

programme.title: The Nazi Machine
programme.desc: By June 1940, Nazi Germany had occupied Paris. France was cut in two. North of the demarcation line was the German-occupied zone and to the south was a zone headed by Marshal Pétain, whose seat of government was in the central spa town of Vichy. The Vichy regime very quickly, and without pressure from the Germans, passed the first Jewish laws.

programme.title: Monty's Gamble for Glory
programme.desc: Germany's retreat continues as the Allies liberate France and Belgium. Montgomery's ambition to end the war risks more than his reputation as the push toward the Netherlands begins.

programme.title: Big Slim
programme.desc: Big Slim is an aviation legend. During a nail-biting engagement in the skies over Europe, Sgt Fred 'Big Slim' Richardson's tall frame was struck by thirty-six pieces of shrapnel. To any other man, such wounds would have been fatal, but Big Slim was different, toughing it out to lead his unit to victory. Such courage sees the Sergeant remembered even all these years later. Stars Jim Hutton.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft - WWI
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry discusses the fighters of WWI, like the Nieuport 17, Albatross, Sopwith Camel, Fokker, and many more.

programme.title: The Airmobile Division
programme.desc: History, organization, and capability of the cavalry division (airmobile) with focus on deployment in South Vietnam.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: D-Day at Last: April-June 1944
programme.desc: One of the reasons for the success of the D-Day landings was the element of surprise, the huge invasion force, congregating along the south coast of England went undetected by German Intelligence.

programme.title: Liberty Equality and Fraternity: July-September 1944
programme.desc: As the liberation of France got underway, the citizens of a nation oppressed since 1940 celebrated the Allied arrival with rapture. There was still much to be achieved, on both the Western and Eastern Fronts. For Hitler the writing was on the wall.

programme.title: The Normandy Campaign
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: Up the Solomons Ladder: Bougainville
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at the campaign in the Solomon Islands directed at the Japanese stronghold on Bougainville. Allied troops eventually secure the beach and slowly fight their way across the island. The Japanese launch a counter-attack, but they are defeated in the Battle of Empress Augusta Bay. After brutal fighting, the island is secured.

programme.title: Rommel Routed
programme.desc: Eisenhower describes how the Allies squeezed Rommel's forces in Tunisia. The Afrika Korps attacks to the Kasserine Pass but is pushed back thanks to Patton. Allied air power helps win the day, the U.S. and British 8th Armies meet, and Tunis falls.

programme.title: War and Men of God
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.title: Gateway to Victory
programme.desc: The aerial and amphibious assault on the beaches of Normandy and the allied convoys landing on the Normandy beaches. Shows Gens. Eisenhower and Montgomery and Adm. Sir Bertram Ramsey.

programme.title: Invasion of Southern France
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries: 1939
programme.desc: In this first film of the series, '1939', follow the prelude to war and consider how the Treaty of Versailles, drawn up after the First World War, failed to keep the peace. Watch the rise of Adolf Hitler and Nazi Germany and learn of those who attempted to stop his bid for global domination. See for yourself the preparations made by the people of Britain as war became inevitable.

programme.title: Mark Rylance
programme.desc: Actor and peace campaigner, Mark Rylance explores the extraordinary story of his grandfather, Osmond Skinner, who spent almost four years as a Japanese Prisoner of War. Mark uncovers how Osmond, a banker for HSBC, bravely joined the Hong Kong Volunteer Defence Force and was thrown into a deadly battle to defend the island, then was shot on Christmas day and taken as a POW.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: This story underscores the harsh realities of war and the profound impact it has on young soldiers like Lt. Kravtsov. It raises questions about sacrifice, the fragility of life, and the emotional toll of warfare. Will Lt. Kravtsov defy the odds and survive his assigned three days? The answer remains uncertain in this poignant narrative of youth and the cost of war.

programme.title: Unmasking the Killers of the Third Reich
programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.

programme.title: Snuffies
programme.desc: Hill 881 was one of the bloodiest battles of the war. During April-May 1967, two Marine battalions faced a large NVA force intent on destroying the Khe Sanh compound. The Marines stormed and took the hills overlooking Khe Sahn. Included are accounts by Dale Dye (whose films include Platoon, Finding Private Ryan, Band of Brothers) who fought as a Marine in Vietnam.

programme.title: The War in Korea
programme.desc: Tensions begin to rise in Korea.

programme.title: War Without Boundaries
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

programme.title: Dwight D. Eisenhower, Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.

programme.title: Extermination
programme.desc: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

programme.title: At Japan's Doorstep: Okinawa
programme.desc: American Army and Marine forces land unopposed and meet little resistance as they split Okinawa in half. Later, as armies move north and south, fighting grows more fierce. In the southern half, stiff Japanese resistance and rain bog down offensive operations. In the end, the Battle of Okinawa proves costly for both sides.

programme.title: Bomber Operations: Target For Tonight
programme.desc: 1941 Film - The planning and implementation of an RAF night raid on Germany in World War II, concentrating on a low level mission by a Wellington bomber on an oil storage facility by the Rhine.

programme.title: TRIED BY FIRE
programme.desc: Story of the three-day attack on St. Vith and retreat of American troops when the town was lost to the Germans. Fighting by 84th infantry division in Battle of the Bulge, crossing of the Roer and Rhine, and the desperate race to the Elbe.

programme.title: Fury in the Pacific
programme.desc: Fury in the Pacific is a documentary about a pair of World War II battles in the Pacific: the Battle of Peleliu and the Battle of Angaur. It was co-produced by the U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, and the U.S. Marines, and directed by a series of combat cameraman. The film is noteworthy for its praise of the fighting abilities of Japanese soldiers, and its fast-paced editing.

programme.title: The Tiger Files
programme.desc: An in detail look at the Tiger Tank from drawing board to the battlefield.

programme.title: War in the North: The Aleutians
programme.desc: When the Japanese navy bombs Alaska and occupies islands off its shores, the U.S. responds by air and by sea and forces them out.

programme.title: The River Crossing
programme.desc: The great rivers of the Rhineland along Germany's western border must be crossed to take the fight to the enemy's home turf. A series of interlocking ground and air operations begin in the North with Montgomery commanding a cooperative of American, British and Canadian forces. The soldiers of the Third Reich are dug in deep, however, and the going will be tough, and price of success will be high.

programme.title: Grey Wolves Part 1: The Killing Begins
programme.desc: Kaiser Wilhelm the 2nd of Germany had long desired to rule an empire. He thought that Germany needed a powerful Navy to protect it - especially against Britain. The Germany Navy was set to the ultimate test - war against Great Britain, putting their mighty fleet to good use. They began a naval blockade of Germany during the first days of the war and deployed their naval units.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. In the New Terminal, the volunteer fighters argue, laugh, violate the commander's orders while defending the airport. The team is given an important task - to hold the first floor of the New Terminal and prepare for the pro-Russian separatist offensive.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Jungles of Death
programme.desc: The story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. A group of Ukrainian Army fighters heads to Donetsk airport for its defense. After being shelled by artillery on the way, a team of four volunteer fighters makes it to the airport to help reinforce. The name Cyborgs, Defenders of the Donetsk Airport, is given to the Ukrainian fighters for their grit, bravery and heroics.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler the Drifter
programme.desc: Drawing upon the often overlooked memoirs of his erstwhile friend Reinhardt Hanisch and revisiting the key sites on his journey, this powerful film traces Hitler's wilderness years in Vienna and Munich. Using rare archive film and new footage of his boyhood home we follow Hitler's descent from aspiring art student to homeless drifter living in a men's shelter in Vienna.

programme.title: Guadalcanal
programme.desc: After training in Australia and New Zealand, the U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal. The U.S. Navy suffers defeats by the Japanese Navy around the island-in an area called Ironbottom Sound.

programme.title: Onwards Ever Onwards: October-December 1944
programme.desc: Hitler's position was worsening by the day, the Nazis were still capable of inflicting terrible damage. When the Germans attempted a breakthrough in the Ardennes region of France, the Battle of the Bulge resulted in large US casualties.

programme.title: The Race for Berlin: January-March 1945
programme.desc: While the Russians moved towards Germany from the East, and the allies attacked from the west, the Japanese continued their battle in the Pacific, fighting American Marines on Iwo Jima.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: For nearly five years, Hitler's Third Reich has dominated Europe. Germany braces for an Allied invasion, fortifying the Atlantic Wall with steel, concrete, and advanced weaponry. Led by the USA, a global alliance faces overwhelming odds, launching a massive military assault to break Germany's grip on Western Europe and reclaim freedom from Nazi control.

programme.title: Episode 2: The 1960s
programme.desc: The 1966 Palomares B-52 crash occurred on 17 January 1966, when a B-52G bomber and a KC-135 tanker collided. The damage and radiation still exists to this day. In 1968 a B-52 bomber near Thule Air Base in Greenland crashed onto sea ice in North Star Bay. The explosives aboard to detonated and the nuclear payload to rupture and dispersed, resulting in radioactive contamination.

programme.title: Aid Man
programme.desc: Pee Wee Donovan became a first aid man after promising his mother he wouldn't hurt anyone. Amidst the chaos of mortar and machine gun fire during the 1944 Battle of Hurtgen Forest, he and another aid carried a severely injured soldier through enemy territory. Faced with danger, Pee Wee forgot his promise and fought bravely, leading to heroic moments that create a thrilling and heartwarming story.

programme.title: The Turning Point
programme.desc: It took Hitler half a war to gain an empire But it would also take him half a war to lose one Japan also wound up growing and growing only to start to fall about halfway through the war.

programme.title: The War at Sea
programme.desc: Hours before the start of Operation Barbarossa, the Germans, along with their Finnish allies, begin mining the Gulf of Finland to prevent any naval evacuation of Soviet troops and ships. When Operation Barbarossa begins, Axis U-boats begin pounding the grand Soviet Navy, primarily based at Leningrad.

programme.title: A Thousand Suns
programme.desc: After years of war, the defeat of Hitler and the Third Reich is inevitable. Peace in Asia will follow peace in Europe after the detonation of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Dancing on a Volcano 1929 - 1931
programme.desc: What had seemed to be an economic recovery is revealed to have been at best fragile and the world enters a global depression of unprecedented and unmeasurable savagery. Unemployment, hyperinflation and despair are everywhere and dictators arise. Old empires - Britain and France - come under pressure throughout the extended territories that they can barely afford to police.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Army Combat Team
programme.desc: The Big Picture shows you what happens in one day of war. 'The Army Combat Team,' which has proved itself in the Korean fighting, is shown in action. Infantry, Artillery Armor and Army Aviation form a powerful offensive and defensive team of the 8th Army in Korea. The Big Picture focuses on the man and the machines of this team in the rugged terrain of the Korean peninsula.

programme.title: WWII - The Secret Race to the Atomic Bomb
programme.desc: In 1945, the U.S. ended WWII with atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, killing over 180,000. But the bomb's story began in Nazi Germany, prompting Roosevelt's $26B Manhattan Project to beat Hitler-and the Soviets-in a race for the A-bomb. Through archives and eyewitnesses, this film reveals the fierce arms race that shaped the fate of the world.

programme.title: Big Picture: Why Vietnam?
programme.desc: This film documents the buildup to the Vietnam War, from the withdrawal of French troops to the bombings of the U.S. Embassy and the intense fighting our troops engaged in to combat Ho Chi Minh and the Viet Cong. The footage features President Lyndon Johnson, Secretary of State Dean Rusk and Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara.

programme.title: Shifting Tides in the Orient
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific examines the growth of independence movements in Asia in the wake of World War II. In the Dutch East Indies, Sukarno declares Indonesian independence and defeat Dutch efforts to retake their colony. In India, the British hands over control to Jawaharlal Nehru. The two new nations soon come to conflict in the region of Kashmir.

programme.title: Eagles
programme.desc: This is the story of the Second World War in the air over Europe and the 'Greatest Air Battles in History' from the Blitz to the daylight bombing raids over Germany. It is the story of the great aces on all sides. It also tells the story of the American Red Tail Devils who never lost an escorted bomber to enemy fire.

programme.title: Battle For The Atlantic: Greyhound vs Wolfpack - Western Approaches
programme.desc: Western Approaches is a vast area of ocean control covering thousands of square miles of the Atlantic. In these waters is set this single incident in the fiercest and longest sea battle in history. The players are not professional actors but serving officers and men of Allied Navies and Merchant Fleets. This film is dedicated to them and their comrades who made the Allied victory possible.

programme.title: A Justice of Terror - Part I: Perverted Law of Terror
programme.desc: At Nuremberg, Hitler's closest allies faced judgment for crimes against humanity. Yet under Nazi law, these acts were legal. This episode examines how Hitler reshaped the justice system, exposing the pivotal role jurists played in transforming law into an instrument of terror.

programme.title: Part 11 - The Final Days
programme.desc: In August 1945, the world witnesses the devastating impact of atomic warfare as Hiroshima and Nagasaki are obliterated. This episode chronicles Japan's last stand, the internal debates within its leadership, and the toll of civilian suffering. The stage is set for the end of the war, as Emperor Hirohito faces the inevitable.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz. Lawyer and historian Serge Klarsfeld, whose father was deported and murdered, has devoted his life to searching for Nazi leaders still at large. For the first time a film recounts the story of the long pursuit of Nazis in hiding, from 1945 to the present day.

programme.title: Line of Fire: Stalingrad
programme.desc: This documentary traces the battle for Stalingrad, which proved to be the turning point for the Allies on the eastern front during the Second World War. Included is expert analysis by Dr Duncan Anderson and Dr Aryk Nusbacher. The bitter, bloody and inhuman struggle for Stalingrad was the turning point of the war on the eastern front and a pivotal moment of World War Two.

programme.title: The Allied Blitz
programme.desc: The leaders of the world's future superpowers hold a conference in the Crimea to agree a post-war framework for Europe, and must overcome deep political division to do so. Meanwhile, in order to hasten the defeat of Germany and save millions of lives, the allies conduct an area bombing mission against a German city that will spark controversy for decades.

programme.desc: We'll show you the step-by-step inner workings of an Allison transmission when our guys build the gearbox for a Sierra HD Duramax.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 2 Chassis Chaos

In the rear we'll address frame issues before we can add a c-notch to get our rear suspension in place before our chassis heads out to poweder coat.

programme.title: Ford Fix it Show

We'll tackle the suspension, steering, brakes, and clutch and address the alternator. We may even throw in a couple of goodies if you promise to put up all your tools when you're done.

programme.title: High Tech Slant Six Gets Boosted

programme.title: Custom Race Inspired Fuel System for a Buick Regal

Once it's completed, we prove it's race-ready on the Dyno and look for big gains over their previous powerplants.

programme.title: Project Bullseye - Suspension, Fuel System, & Custom Dash

From getting the rear suspension bolted in, to plumbing the fuel system, wiring up the dash with some old-school toggle switches, and even spraying paint on some custom parts - it's one of those "do what you can, when you can" kind of days. It's the grunt work of the project, but it's real progress, and that's what counts.

programme.desc: The '69 Road Runner gets an exterior upgrade. We'll show you some unorthodox methods for enhancing a patina paint look.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 4: Making The Bed
programme.desc: The MCT Crew have the frame shortened on Project Cream Puff and it's ready for its new bed. The guys give you a couple of options on how to tackle a short bed conversion, then start assembling their new one. Plus, get a little help with choosing what kind of floor we want for our custom C-10.

programme.title: Modern 410ci Stroker Windsor with Custom EFI & Coil-Near-Plug Conversion - Part 1
programme.desc: This Small Block Ford receives big power upgrades, including a forged rotating assembly, competition-ported cylinder heads, and a supremely accurate crank trigger system.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 6 - The Art of Darkness
programme.desc: Steel meets style - Today the boys finally lay down some paint on their '69 GTO. Peyton and Tommy then wrestle the body back onto the frame and slap on all new weather stripping to lock out the elements and preserve this poised piece of Pontiac perfection.

programme.title: Crusin' Caprice Wagon Drivetrain Upgrade
programme.desc: The Caprice Wagon is back in the shop for the rest of its upgrades. Jimmy and Jeremy add a new drivetrain to give our cruiser a boost in horsepower and then we add a few custom touches before taking the whole tribe on a cross town adventure in the Carcass family truckster.

programme.title: Ultimate Ford 300 Turbo Build - Part 2
programme.desc: Our famous Turbo Ford 300 makes its return in Part 2 of our ultimate dream build. We continue this one-of-a-kind project with assembling a fully forged short block, our CNC ported cylinder head, and a trick valvetrain. A custom front accessory drive and EFI system follow as we get this engine ready for big power on the engine dyno.

programme.title: 1980s Mustang Cobra Transformation Part 2
programme.desc: This hissing Cobra gets dialed in with final touches, taking it from concept to coiled and ready to strike! Strap in for Project Sydewinder's first track day!

programme.title: Mustang Cobra 600+HP 427 Windsor Track Beast
programme.desc: Our Mustang Cobra project "Sydewinder" hits the track at the Mid America Ford and Shelby Nationals! 600+Horsepower and set up for the track, the Foxbody beast is loose!

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 4 - Prison Tats
programme.desc: Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look on this episode of Detroit Muscle. Tommy and Peyton begin rust repair and a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

programme.title: Salvage Yard Superstar
programme.desc: We start with a Gen IV Iron Block 5.3L from the junkyard, get it running, and then add a selection of budget-friendly upgrades to turn it into a solid street swap engine. Afterward, we test our upgrades on the dyno and get a special visit from a high horsepower, big boost drag car.

programme.title: Dropping A Fire-Breathing 5-Speed In Our Turbo-Charged Police Interceptor
programme.desc: Marc and Tommy rip into the automatic transmission tearing it out of our turbo charged Police Interceptor and swapping it for a head jerking manual 5 speed. Then they take to the track in hot pursuit of some quick times.

programme.title: Turn Back Time and Prep for the Future
programme.desc: Recap and Forecast on the projects we have in the shop. Install new drivetrain and chassis on Buick Project Street Regal.

programme.title: 1965 Chevy C10 292 Straight Six Turbo
programme.desc: This week we configure a turbo setup on our '65 C10's 292 straight six.

programme.title: Putting A 2020 Ford F-150 To The Test
programme.desc: We kick off a new Ford F150 build! We're at the Nashville Superspeedway for baseline tests, then we'll begin the transformation with a lowering kit, and we'll dress it up with new wheels and tires. By the way we're going to give this truck away!

programme.title: Dodge Challenger Tears It Up At NCM Motorsports Park
programme.desc: The Challenger tears it up at NCM Motorsports Park! Plus we'll help a viewer perk up her pickup in this week's Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Salvage to Savage 5.3 LS
programme.desc: Engine Power digs their low-buck boosted junkyard 5.3 LS out of mothballs for a round of improvements ... including a set of forged pistons, new rod bolts, a cam/lifter/spring combo, and topping it off with a fresh new induction setup that is all controlled by a high tech EFI system. Pat and Frankie will dyno it both naturally aspirated and with the boost to see what this budget-minded street bullet will crank out on 93 octane pump gas.

programme.title: How To Set Up A Rear End To Meet Factory Tolerances On A Chevy Tahoe
programme.desc: While freshening up the old drum brakes on our '96 Chevy Tahoe, we noticed that we have a sloppy rear end. We'll tear down the ring and pinion and show you how to put it all back together, making sure our Tahoe's rear end is nice and tight.

programme.title: Reviving a High Mileage '69 Camaro
programme.desc: Destination "fun-town," Marc and Tommy are taking a '69 Chevy Camaro RS/SS to the next level! With performance, handling, and appearance upgrades, it's time to revive this ultra-cool muscle car giveaway ride.

programme.title: Tune & Tone
programme.desc: Is custom exhaust worth it on a budget build? The age-old question - does tone matter when dollars do? Will our custom exhaust take our Lexus IS250 up a notch, or will we have to cut back to finish our build.

programme.title: Driveway Rescue: Everyday Charger
programme.desc: We meet a guy who turned his vintage Dodge into a daily driver... and help him fix it!

programme.title: Stripping Down a 2006 Trailblazer SS to Make It Drift-Worthy
programme.desc: Jeremy and Jimmy wear out a pair of tires testing their Trailblazer SS in a drift like fashion. Upgrades are already on their minds as they shed some pounds for a better drifting truck.

programme.title: Caddy Hearse Hits The Drag Strip To Prove Its Power
programme.desc: We take our hefty hearse down the eighth mile with a little help from some throttle in the bottle ... Plus, some old school tech that may hit home.

programme.title: Super Street 427ci SBC Part 2
programme.desc: We continue with our aftermarket pump gas 427ci Small Block Chevy engine, with plans on getting it into the Dyno Cell. It's getting finished off with a high flowing, off the shelf induction and rock solid valvetrain before we run some 93-octane fuel thru it and see what it puts out on the Dyno.

programme.title: SEMA Trucks 2019: Joey Logano's 850 Horsepower NASCAR/Street Rod Fusion Truck
programme.desc: PowerNation invites you for the lifted, lowered, overlanders, Jeeps and SUVs, plus drifting with Joey Logano at the 2019 SEMA show in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Off-Road Wheeling in West Virginia
programme.desc: The XOR team and a group of off-road enthusiasts hit the trails on the XOR Adventure Ride 4. This year the team heads to the heart of coal country in West Virginia! Everything from the XOR JL Rubicon to the General Tire Tacoma to ATVs hit the trails.

programme.title: How Does a Stock Jeep JL Rubicon Perform?
programme.desc: Our Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon Hits the trails. We find out what the JL needs to survive on the 2019 XOR Adventure.

programme.title: Tension Prevention With New Suspension For The '71 Caprice -Fat Stack Part 3
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit the powder room to freshen up the frame on Fat Stack, a 1971 Chevy Caprice, while upgrading their suspension in disbelief.

programme.title: Carcass In England
programme.desc: The guys from Carcass head across the pond to the UK to tour EBC Brakes and their Center of Excellence. We also check out England's ultimate motorsports summer garden party at the Goodwood Festival of Speed.

programme.title: Top 10 American Muscle Part 2
programme.desc: Have we missed any? Here is the conclusion of our top 10 American Muscle Cars. So much muscle, so little time to get to number one!

programme.title: Modding a Mustang GT for an Aggressive Look
programme.desc: We add a body kit and a wrap to our EBC Brakes giveaway Mustang plus, Tommy and Marc bring back the Hellcat '69 Charger.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger gets a Custom Console
programme.desc: The transformation of this off-road beast continues as Eliza and Jeremy complete the interior, install a custom dash, and build a spare tire carrier.

programme.title: Installing a 5.0L Coyote Drivetrain
programme.desc: Our Pre-Runner Ranger gets a 5.0L Coyote and beefy transmission for maximum off-road action.

programme.title: G-Body Buck Regal Build, Checking Glass and Trim Off the List
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc give us some tips on painting trim and glass installation before our '85 Buick gets a new interior. Plus a Chevelle owner in need of a little rescuing.

programme.title: Bolt-On 100+ Horsepower in a Day
programme.desc: Power upgrades are great especially if you can bolt-on big performance in a day. Mike and Pat grab some wrenches to install a ProCharger supercharger on a 2019 Challenger ProCharger.

programme.title: Tired Supercharged Coyote Mustang Interior Gets an Overhaul
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew creates a custom exhaust with some TIG Tech, and they lay out a new living room for our EBC Supercharged Coyote Mustang.

programme.title: Twins for the Win
programme.desc: Engine Power brings their Super Street 427ci Small Block Chevy back into the shop for a serious boost in power! Pat and Frankie convert this 600+ HP naturally aspirated powerplant into a twin turbo monster with dual ceramic ball bearing turbochargers and stainless headers. The engine also receives a brand new EFI intake and multi-port fuel injection system to provide the ultimate control while they push ol' Baby Blue to the limit!

programme.title: Laying The Foundation To Rebuild A GM 4.3L V6
programme.desc: The first steps you take in building any engine can lay the foundation for a reliable powerplant that lives up to its potential.

programme.title: Lighting the Way Forward
programme.desc: Project Spartan, our 1969 Jeep Kaiser M715, is getting a major overhaul from the ground up. We start by upgrading the lighting system with modern headlights and some vintage C10 turn signals, then move on to the critical work of patching and reinforcing the frame; fixing all the damage left behind by years of rust and corrosion. But the real milestone comes when we reunite the engine with the transmission, build custom mounts, and drop the heart of this beast back onto the frame.

programme.title: Hear That Hemi: Bringing A 1970 Hemi Cuda Back To Life
programme.desc: HEMI Cuda', need we say more? The Detroit Muscle crew tune up a rare 1970 HEMI Barracuda for its busy owner. We wake the elephant sleeping under the hood, and take joy ride!

programme.title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.

programme.title: Cooling Down & Increasing Power On The '71 Chevy Caprice
programme.desc: Cool Running - We install the cooling system on our '71 Caprice and then put the pedal to the metal to give you the lowdown on electronic throttle vs mechanical.

programme.title: Ultimate Ford 300 Turbo Build - Part 3
programme.desc: Our famous Turbocharged Ford 300 returns for Part 3 of our dream six-cylinder build. We finish it up, then watch the numbers stack up on the SuperFlow Dyno both naturally aspirated and when we put our Big Six under boost.

programme.title: Adding Candy Color To The '71 Chevy Caprice - Fat Stack Part 5
programme.desc: We slap on a fresh coat of paint to help transform our '71 Chevy Caprice into a not-so-lean, mean, green machine! Then, we add a new vinyl top and marry the body back to the frame to bring Fat Stack one step closer to the finish line.

programme.title: Big Bore 363 Small Block Ford Part 1
programme.desc: Pat and Frankie dive into a brand new, bad to the bone, Small Block Ford that will make outstanding pump-gas power and be able to run on the track. We go through all the prep and machine work to get this powerplant ready to assemble later in Part 2.

programme.title: How Much Nitrous for 720HP in a Small Block?
programme.desc: Searching for more power, let's add Nitrous and see what happens when our Chevy small block gets on the bottle!

programme.title: Hard Charger - Rear Suspension
programme.desc: Our 1969 Dodge Charger gets an all-new rear suspension and an upgraded dash.

programme.title: Ford vs Chevy: Small Displacement Showdown
programme.desc: The TIMELESS Debate is on. Ford vs. Chevy. We start with a stock 305 Chevy and a 302 Ford. After an initial baseline, we see how they stack up against each other with the same mild upgrades. We find out, dollar for horsepower, who comes out on top.

programme.title: Bringing Back To Life '65 Chevy C10
programme.desc: LT and Austin pull a '65 C10 project off the rollback and make plans for its revival.

programme.title: High Tech Slant Six
programme.desc: Before we give our Slant Six a much-needed power boost, we'll reinforce the engine internals with a fully-forged rotating assembly.

programme.title: Turbo Tech Making 1200+ Horsepower
programme.desc: Turbo pioneer, Kenny Duttweiler steps in to lend a hand with our LME 427 ci LSX engine. Boosting this bullet with a high-tech turbo system produces a lot of excitement and big dyno numbers!

programme.title: Turbo Tahoe 383 SBC : Part 1
programme.desc: We team up with Blacktop Speed Shop to power their Tahoe project with a turbo-charged Gen 1 383 Stroker SBC. We put together a custom combination to fit their vehicle and make big progress putting together a high-powered short block.

programme.title: Restoring The Abandoned Chevy Silverado Paint Back To Its Former Glory
programme.desc: Our '96 Chevy Silverado gets new body parts. Plus we'll prep it for paint and show you how we are restoring the original color before hitting the road.

programme.title: Setting Front End Alignment for the Track on a Mustang Foxbody
programme.desc: We take Project Sydewinder to get its suspension setup for the track. Plus, Tommy and Marc get a rare look inside the Indianapolis Motor Speedway Museum Vault.

programme.title: '69 Road Runner Gets A Gen III Hemi Swap Part 2
programme.desc: Our '69 Road Runner, nicknamed Road Burner, gets a big bump in power when we perform a Gen III Hemi engine swap.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Gets 1-Ton Dana 60 Axles
programme.desc: The transformation continues on this clean '85 K-10 square body. We remove the cab and axles, then tear it down to the bare chassis. We'll unveil some exciting upgrades to give this '80s TV show knockoff a modern day appeal.

programme.title: Complete build of our Big Body Grand Marquis
programme.desc: Complete build of our Big Body Grand Marquis

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live team loves the exhilarating jumps and stunts during a show, but nothing beats the excitement we bring to those most important to us, the fans. Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live hits the road as Demo Derby visits kids at Victory Junction, a camp for children with serious or chronic medical conditions.

programme.title: OEM Ford F-100 Suspension Swap
programme.desc: Shockingly, a sixty-year-old suspension needs replacing. So, Eric and Joel kick it old school with some OEM parts for Clint Black's 1960 Ford F-100.

programme.title: Building An Exhaust To Fit The Abandoned Chevy Silverado's 5.3L LS - Part 3
programme.desc: We continue to work on our abandoned '96 Chevy Silverado truck, buttoning up underneath the hood with cooling and power steering installations. Plus we build a custom exhaust for our freshened up 5.3 liter engine.

programme.title: Hard Charger - Hellcrate Install
programme.desc: Work continues on a 1969 Dodge Charger to adapt a Hellcat drivetrain to work in it; Tommy visits OPGI.

programme.title: Lift & Shift
programme.desc: We yank out our old suspension, upgrade the underside of our Diesel Dually, Nightshift, and give it a disc brake conversion and lift kit to help uphold its Dodge signature style.

programme.title: Chevy Blazer Custom Paint
programme.desc: After months of prep, the '89 Blazer hits the paint booth for a custom mix of color. And to accompany the panels will be a color-matched bedliner.

programme.title: Giving The Overlanding Toyota 4Runner Protection On The Trails - Part 2
programme.desc: The Carcass Crew fabricates heavy duty bumpers and rock sliders to help protect their Overlanding Toyota 4Runner on the trails.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 2 - Medical Checkup
programme.desc: The warden's calling for diagnostics for Detroit Muscle's next prisoner, their 1969 Pontiac GTO. They'll have to tear down and look inside the skeleton of this old muscle car before they fix it up.

programme.title: Dirt Track Small Block
programme.desc: We team up with UNOH to build a brand-new engine for their racing program. A new car class with new engine rules makes for an educational build experience that pays off on the racetrack.

programme.title: Final 48 Hour Fixes
programme.desc: It's the final weekend push that Brian and Jason have to upgrade their 2011 Lexus IS 250, Project Budget Baller. They've only got 48 hours to install a new head unit, better speakers, and gloss black wheel and tires. Will they finish on time?

programme.title: Diagnosing Problems On A Caprice Wagon To Get It Up And Running
programme.desc: We found an old Caprice wagon and diagnosed some problems to get it back on the road. After getting it running, we head to the hills of Kentucky for the Pineville Hill Climb, a grassroots racing event that adds some local flair.

programme.title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.

programme.title: The Beach Cruiser Bronco Gets Its Colors
programme.desc: We welcome legendary custom car builder Chris Ryan and his team to help with our 1974 Bronco. We give it a professional paint job that will completely transform this build.

programme.title: Add an Extra 100HP to a Ford Windsor
programme.desc: More hi-po how-to for an extra 100 horsepower out of 408 Windsor Stroker. Plus, Engine Power attends the MATCO Tool Expo.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 8 - Power Moves
programme.desc: Wired and inspired - The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU. Then, it's out with the old and in with the new as Joel upgrades the sound deadening and Tommy puts a new shine on the original taillights.

programme.title: Tension Prevention With New Suspension For The '71 Caprice -Fat Stack Part 3
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit the powder room to freshen up the frame on Fat Stack, a 1971 Chevy Caprice, while upgrading their suspension in disbelief.

programme.title: Triple Threat Exhaust
programme.desc: Our split-bumper Camaro receives a hand-crafted exhaust, designed by one of Magnaflow's own.

programme.title: Test Sled Reincarnated Stage 2
programme.desc: Our Test Sled has been rejuvenated with a new engine & transmission. Now we'll turn some wrenches to make brake and safety upgrades so we can test it on the chassis dyno and at the race track.

programme.title: Chassis Dyno Mania
programme.desc: We put our past engine builds to the test now that they have been installed in awesome hot rods! From the Gen III Hemi of Detroit Muscle's "Road Burner" to the 496ci Big Block Chevy of Music City Trucks' "Faux Guy", we put the power down to the wheels and get final wheel horsepower numbers.

programme.title: Solid Roller 318 LA
programme.desc: Our 318 Mopar is back AGAIN, so we can take it to the next level! This already stout small block gets a solid roller camshaft and a single plane intake to crank up the RPM and turn up the horsepower.

programme.title: Running Our '69 Camaro Through the Wringer
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue

programme.title: The Faux Guy: The Series Premiere
programme.desc: We lay out our plan to rebuild our 1985 Chevy K-10. We start by tearing it down and building it back up with new sheet metal repair. What we have in mind for this truck will make you do a double-take!

programme.title: Nissan Trailgater Part 1
programme.desc: We're stepping out of our comfort zone and building the ultimate dual-purpose pickup, a 2025 Nissan Frontier that we've nicknamed Trailgater. Eric and Joel modify a brand-new Nissan and turn it into the ultimate tailgating truck that would make any sports fan or overlander envious and excited.

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 445 FE Gets Modern EFI
programme.desc: Our 445 FE is back, a modern EFI system, along with a time-tested tunnel wedge intake made for drivability.

programme.title: '65 C10 Rewind 1
programme.desc: Project Lo 'n Slo is what we called our '65 Fleetside Chevy C10. With a beautiful patina, we leave the body to mother nature, but ditch the 350 small block for a unique 292 straight-six with a turbo.

programme.title: Keeping a Coyote V8 Cool On a Ford Ranger Prerunner
programme.desc: The Prerunner Ranger's rollcage gets more tube work fabrication plus, we pick up a Tacoma for a new off-road project.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger Suspension Mods and Fiberglass Panels
programme.desc: Jeremy and Eliza finish up mounting the adjustable shocks add the Raptor-like fiberglass skin to the Prerunner Ranger.

programme.title: Tearing Down and Rebuilding a Kingpin Dana 60 Axle
programme.desc: It's fabrication time on our Chevy Suburban we're calling "Unbreakable", and with the help of Jeremy and Jimmy from Carcass the guys build an off-road-ready frame that's out of this world.

programme.title: The FJ60 Makeover Begins
programme.desc: A new project rolls into the shop-our 1987 FJ60 Land Cruiser, and the plan is simple: turn it into an affordable resto-mod daily driver with modern power, suspension, and comfort upgrades. First, we look back at how it drives now and break down the game plan. Then it's teardown time, followed by getting the axles ready for what's coming next: a refreshed third member with updated gears and lockers, plus full axle rebuilds-knuckles, inners, outers, and new brakes.

programme.title: Better Breathing for our Big Block Ford
programme.desc: Our 460 Big Block Ford is back for its final iteration, where we upgrade it with a weight saving, better flowing induction. We're looking to up the naturally aspirated horsepower before this beast finds its new home. As always, we'll test our improvement on the Engine Dyno.

programme.title: 427ci LSx Part 1
programme.desc: We kick off a brand new, ground up build for a Music City Trucks project, featuring a scratch built 427ci pump gas LSx. With awesome hot rod power and durability in mind, we start with a new Summit Racing Pro LS block and prep this beast for serious short-bed C10 service.

programme.title: First Gen Bronco Gets a Modern Suspension
programme.desc: Our '74 Bronco build is getting a suspension overhaul plus new axles, brakes, wheels and tires! And John Kramen from Mecum Auctions stops by to check on the progress.

programme.title: Pro LS on the Dyno
programme.desc: We complete our stroker LS powerplant and put it to the ultimate performance test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Building An Exhaust To Fit The Abandoned Chevy Silverado's 5.3L LS - Part 3
programme.desc: We continue to work on our abandoned '96 Chevy Silverado truck, buttoning up underneath the hood with cooling and power steering installations. Plus we build a custom exhaust for our freshened up 5.3 liter engine.

programme.title: Sleeving a 396 Big Block for a 1970 Camaro
programme.desc: The car has to be converted from automatic to manual floor pedals, and the firewall gets some factory style mods that change the car over to big-block style. Then, everything you ever wanted to know about brake lines and fuel lines.

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 8 Rear Axle and Brake Mockup
programme.desc: Our rear axle needs new mounting points for our shocks to bolt to our '72 Camaro, so we fabricate new brackets. We also mock-up our rear brake setup to our axle before giving it a fresh coat of paint.

programme.title: Repairing An Abandoned Chevy Silverado - Part 1
programme.desc: The Carcass crew gives you some tips on how to repair rusty trouble spots and remove dents on your project. Then we'll walk you through getting it ready for primer.

programme.title: '71 Chevy Caprice Gets Perfectly Polished Chrome
programme.desc: Chrome is where the heart is - Tommy and Joel update the bright work on their '71 Chevy Caprice and they'll visit the chrome plater to break down how the new bling comes into being.

programme.title: Baja Style Bug Is Ready to Take Flight
programme.desc: Jeremy and Jimmy take a left for dead VW Beetle, and a roughed up Can-Am creating a baja style bug that will take flight.

programme.title: Putting TrackHawk Power Into A 1986 Jeep Wagoneer
programme.desc: The guys visit DBR Performance and their first chance ever to drive a Jeep TrackHawk, which inspires a plan of their own...to turn an old Wagoneer into a screaming street monster.

programme.title: New Suspension Turns 2012 Jeep JK Into Dual-Purpose 4x4
programme.desc: The Carcass crew found a 2012 Jeep JK at an auction and just had to buy it. They'll tear into it and start adding some off-road suspension components, turning it into a dual-purpose wheeler that can handle some serious trails.

programme.title: The Perfect Fit For The '71 Chevy Caprice Body Panels
programme.desc: A touch of glass - We begin to piece our '71 Caprice Fat Stack back together, installing the front and rear glass as well as the hood, deck lid, and body panels showing you some how-to-hints for favorable fitment.

programme.title: 632ci EFI BBC Part 2
programme.desc: The guys in Engine Power are back on their 632ci Big Block Chevy project as they get it wrapped up and ready for the dyno! Picking up with a forged shortblock, they will continue to revamp the large displacement engine into a street slaying beast with high flowing heads set up for the new hydraulic roller cam, bulletproof valvetrain, a beautiful accessory drive, and a swap-ready standalone EFI system.

programme.title: 427 cubic inches of Naturally Aspirated HP for Javelin Trans Am Tribute Build
programme.desc: A 427 ci LSX engine goes naturally aspirated for an underappreciated muscle car.

programme.title: Supercharged Coyote
programme.desc: The students at SAM TECH build a supercharged Coyote engine to compete at the drag strip.

programme.desc: Can the Blacktop Speed Shop crew turn this rare 2014 Cadillac CTS-V Wagon from a 1 of 400 ever made into a 1 of 1 unicorn for the EBC Brakes' booth at SEMA?

programme.title: Our 1960s Jeep is a Rust Bucket
programme.desc: Project Spartan is back and it's... worse than we thought. With a little help from Eric, Chris gets hard at work on this 1969 M715 Kaizer Jeep and the truly insane levels of rust in the cab. You've never seen a truck this bad before. Stay tuned.

programme.title: Dropping A Legendary Mondello 455 Big Block Into The Retro Hurst Olds - Part 3
programme.desc: Grease and gears begin to fly as we swap out our '83 Hurst-Olds' measly 307 engine for one built in the Horsepower shop with the help of legendary engine builder Joe Mondello. This big block is truly one-of-a-kind.

programme.desc: Our 1969 Pontiac GTO, Project Henchman, needs to bulk up before breaking out, so Tommy and Peyton are using the time to modify the chassis and install new fuel lines on this tough prisoner.

He pays more attention to his car than to her, he constantly disappears and has forgotten important appointments because he's out joy riding. Charles says he's 71 years old and treated himself to a new car. He says this doesn't warrant getting divorce. He says his wife is lazy and will not leave the house for social events he'd like to attend with her. See what happens on the next Divorce Court!

programme.desc: Heather says she is the breadwinner and pays all of the bills. She would like Nicole to contribute more financially to the household. On top of that, Heather says Nicole lies about her whereabouts when she is at work. Nicole says Heather is obsessive and controlling. According to Nicole, Heather put an air tag in her purse to track her every move. Can Judge Star restore trust in this relationship? Find out on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: If You Snooze, You Lose: "Don" Tanner v "Vee" Baldwin
programme.desc: Don says he doesn't trust his girlfriend and believes she cheated. He says she has spent time with an ex, she comes home in the middle of the night and he saw text messages on her phone from random men. Vee says Don is very controlling. She admits to him paying all the bills, but says he uses that power to control and track her every move. See what Judge Star has to say on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: A Wedding Gone Wrong: Angela Howard v Antley Staten
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Angela says her fiancé is a Groomzilla! She says Antley has over spent in every area of the wedding and isn't considering her wants and needs. She was so fed up she returned her wedding dress. Antely says his fiancée isn't enjoying what should be the happiest time of their lives, planning their wedding. Can Judge Star save the marriage before it even starts? Find out on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: The Ring of Sorrow: "Matt" Lee v Olivia Dunham Pt. 1
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Matt says his fiancé refuses to give back the engagement ring his grandmother gave him, a family heirloom, after calling off their engagement. Olivia says Matt proposed on her birthday and the ring belongs to her, she's not giving it back. Find out Judge Star's solution to this dispute on the next Divorce Court!

He says she assumed he was talking to other women and she took it upon herself to reach out to his "female clients" to warn them to stay away from her fiancé. Jannelyn says her fiancée needs to be more understanding and their issues don't warrant them breaking up. She believes they can get married if they work on their communication.

programme.title: It's Either Me Or The Church: Fontella Hicklin v Vincent Hicklin Pt. 1
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Fontella says she's not made a priority in her marriage and comes 2nd to the church. programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Imani says Benjamin gave her a promise ring instead of an engagement ring. He says he wants to be financially stable before tying the knot. See what Judge Star has to say on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: Wedding Bells Or Red Flags; Anita Baylor v Keith Wylie
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Anita says her fiancé doesn't have his priorities in order. She says instead of paying the water bill, after 3 late notices, and saving for their wedding, he spent $800 at the strip club. Keith says his fiancée is making up excuses not to get married because she has cold feet. He says the lack of intimacy is the main issue in their relationship. See if Judge Star can save their relationship on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: Winter Storm: Winter Bush v Calvin Ross
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Winter says her boyfriend is a serial cheater. She discovered he was sleeping with one of his exes. Calvin says his girlfriend constantly brings up his past infidelities which makes it hard to progress in their relationship. Find out what happens next on Divorce Court!

programme.title: Her Or This Ring: Winsley Henri v "Fairy"
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Winsley says his girlfriend is actively recruiting other women to join their relationship and he's not down with that. He says Fairy's goal is to have a Throuple. Fairy says she made her intentions known from the beginning she wanted to add a 3rd party to their relationship. She says she lives an alternative lifestyle and she doesn't want to compromise. Can Judge Star get them on the same page? Find out on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: Endless Cycle Of Heartbreak: "Esmy" Valdez v Jordan Sherman
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Esmy says her fiancé is very controlling. She says Jordan prevented her from going on her friend's podcast and tracks her every move. Jordan says he is not controlling, he's very protective of his fiancée. Judge Star gets to the bottom of this issue in the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: Lazy Wife, Crazy Life: Andrea Murell-Thomas v Taja Thomas
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Andrea says for the first 2 years of their relationship, Taya didn't have a job. She carried all the financial burden. It got so bad, they were evicted from their home and lived in a van for 2 months before Andrea was able to afford a place. Taya says she hopes to save her marriage and move back in with her wife. She says she contributes in other ways to their marriage and doesn't appreciate Andrea holding money over her head.

programme.title: Downward Spiral: Shunica Ingram v James Ingram

James says he wants to save his marriage. He says his wife exaggerates about how much he drinks and he believes he is a good provider for his family. He says work is the reason why he misses family events. Can Judge Star help bring some sobering light to this relationship? Find out on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: It's A Two Way Street: Vincent Fergione v Mark Fergione
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Vincent and Mark make online content. Vincent feels he's not being compensated enough for the work he does, the editing of the videos and social media presence. Mark says he's the one spending all the money in this relationship. He says he let Vincent move into his house, rent free, and he has an established brand. He believes Vincent is compensated enough for his services. Find out how Judge Star settles this on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: Wasting The Best Years: Nikia Lucas v Christopher Pope

Christopher says he is an entrepreneur/entertainer and he has women around him depending on the event. He says Nikia is constantly accusing him of cheating. See if Judge Star can save their relationship on the next Divorce Court!

programme.desc: Re'Nae and Candice think their sister stole a wallet and expensive jewelry from them; O.J. and Jasmine are accused of stealing money from the aunt who took them in when they were desperate.

programme.title: Did You Hurt Our Daughter?
programme.desc: A man is accused of abusing his daughter; Melanie suspects Zack is molesting their daughter.

programme.title: He Said "Give Your Baby Away" -- and You Did!
programme.desc: Two men want to know which of them is Shannan's son's father; unwed parents argue over the paternity of a 1-year-old.

programme.title: Do You Even Love Him Anymore?
programme.desc: Jennifer and Matt return to the show because she thinks he cheated on her; Barbie says she thought she knew everything about her friend, but that quickly changed once he became her boyfriend; Stephanie reveals a shocking truth to her man.

programme.title: I've Been Prostituting: Is My Fiance the Father?
programme.desc: Shauna reveals that after she lost her house she turned to prostitution to support her family, and she fears that her fiancé is not her baby's father; Tenisha says her ex-boyfriend is denying her baby because he just does not want to be a dad.

programme.title: What If You Are Pregnant By Him?
programme.desc: A woman whose partner's abuse caused her to have four miscarriages thinks she may be pregnant again.

programme.title: Secrets From the Scrap...
programme.desc: A man reveals that he slept with his niece; a woman finds that her boyfriend is really a female; a man has a one-night stand after his wife miscarries; a man must choose between his stuffed animals and his girlfriend.

programme.title: Pregnant Sex Scandals!
programme.desc: Unusual love triangles.

programme.title: I Want Your Lover!
programme.desc: Fiancé unknowingly has an affair with a man; woman does more than baby-sit; woman leaves her husband for his friend; woman is bored with her girlfriend.

programme.title: Busted ... On Bended Knee
programme.desc: A woman suspects her fiancé has been cheating; a woman learns her husband has been sleeping around; a man is trapped in a mother-daughter love triangle.

programme.title: Wives Vs. Mistresses!
programme.desc: A woman suspects her husband is cheating on her; a woman confronts her husband's mistress; a man wants to call it quits with both of the women in his life.

programme.title: Two-Timers Confronted
programme.desc: Two-timers are confronted.

programme.title: Grooms Full of Bologna
programme.desc: DeShawn is engaged to his baby's mother, but it did not stop him from hooking up with his friend; Quan must reveal a secret to his fiancée; Makayla has a confession that could end her engagement.

programme.title: War Of The Homewreckers!
programme.desc: A woman loves a married man; a man cheats on his girlfriend; a woman sleeps with her boyfriend's brother.

programme.title: You Broke My Heart!
programme.desc: A man must confess to his Internet love that he was born female; a woman has been cheating with her girlfriend's daughter; a man proposes to a woman after she confesses to sleeping with his friend.

programme.title: Tomorrow Ever After
programme.desc: Shaina lives 600 years in the future. She's read about poverty, oppression, and violence in history books. When she accidentally time travels to our times, she assumes that everyone is caring and honest as she tries to recruit help to get back home.

programme.title: Alien Outbreak
programme.desc: A small rural community is under siege by an alien presence and mass suicide panic spreads. Can they be saved from extinction?

programme.title: Under My Skin
programme.desc: Denny, a free spirit and artist falls for Ryan, a strait-laced lawyer. When Denny questions gender their love is tested. Denny is played by four different actors, exploring four chapters in their story.

programme.title: Tomorrow's Today
programme.desc: Two lovable grifters rob a liquor store to pay a gambling debt to a vicious mob boss only to find out the liquor store they rob is owned by the mobster.

programme.title: Where The Rivers Flow North
programme.desc: Log driver Noel Lord defies power company boss Clayton Farnsworth, who orders Lord and his feisty American Indian mate off their soon-to-be-flooded land. Farnsworth never met a man he couldn't buy - but then, he'd never met Noel Lord.

programme.title: River Road
programme.desc: A rock musician and a free-spirited woman start an intense relationship which soon spirals into a world of drug addiction and crime.

programme.title: Iceman: Book One
programme.desc: Known as Iceman, a newly retired organized crime fixer is pulled back deeper than ever.

programme.title: All I Want Is You
programme.desc: After holding her man down on a long 4-year bid, Chloe is ready to risk it all when another woman tries to steal her man.

programme.title: The Knock Knock Man
programme.desc: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend. What was supposed to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world.

programme.title: Love Thy Nature
programme.desc: Narrated by Liam Neeson and the winner of 27 awards, Love Thy Nature points to how deeply we've lost touch with nature and takes viewers on a cinematic journey through the beauty and intimacy of our relationship with the natural world.

programme.title: Baltic Tribes
programme.desc: This docudrama overthrows the myth of the Baltic people as just peaceful farmers exploring who the last pagans of Europe really were and what they believed.

programme.title: Caroline and Jackie
programme.desc: A birthday celebration exposes the fragile bond between two sisters. Dark secrets surface, unraveling the intricacies of their relationship and the profound impact of hidden truths on their lives.

programme.title: Depth of Pyaar
programme.desc: Depth Of Pyaar is an intense blend of crime thriller and emotional family drama, brought to life through Mukesh Asopa's powerful performance and visionary storytelling. Because when fate turns cruel, only the depth of love can stand against it.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Nosferatu - A Symphony of Horror
programme.desc: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

programme.title: How to Eat Your Watermelon in White Company (and Enjoy It)
programme.desc: Melvin Van Peebles was one of the first black directors to challenge the white establishment in his films, which include "Watermelon Man" and "Sweet Sweetback's Baadasssss Song." In this documentary, the life of Van Peebles is discussed, including his work not only in film, but also as a novelist, actor, musician, stock trader and even Air Force pilot. Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.title: Dirty Dilemma
programme.desc: In today's ever-changing dating landscape, can anyone truly claim to have a pure connection devoid of lies, secrets, and trust issues? For Malika and Kyrie, their love will be pushed to the brink as they face the ultimate test.

programme.title: Decade of Fire
programme.desc: In the 1970s, fires consumed the South Bronx. Black and Puerto Rican residents were blamed, even as they fought to save their homes. Vivian Vázquez Irizarry pursues the truth around the fires, uncovering racist policies and neglect that shape our cities.

programme.title: Lynch: A History
programme.desc: Lynch: A History is a kaleidoscopic look at Marshawn Lynch's use of silence as a form of protest. Culling 700 clips and placing them in radical juxtaposition, the film is a powerful parable about American sports media and racial oppression.

programme.title: Instant Dreams
programme.desc: When Polaroid announced the end of instant film in 2008, many feared the chemical formula would be lost forever. Instant Dreams follows a number of quirky individuals who are connected to Polaroid, who work and create to keep the magic of instant film.

programme.title: Cycles
programme.desc: An apprehensive young man moves into university halls, and the sudden feeling of isolation forces him into an argument with his older brother about identity, love, and the repression of dreams.

programme.title: Molli and Max in the Future
programme.desc: A sci-fi rom-com about a man and woman whose orbits repeatedly collide over the course of 12 years, 4 planets, 3 dimensions, and 1 space-cult. Molli and Max in the Future combines character-driven romance with an eclectic sci-fi universe.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Xanadu Hellfire
programme.desc: A nine-year-old brings a warrior from the future to the present and an evil follows. An amazingly cool and funny Sci-fi comedy with kids cursing, lasers, time travel, aliens, martial arts, and more!

programme.title: Warlord
programme.desc: Warlord follows a peaceful Wood Elf Warlord, who despises violence, but is forced to take up arms when a cruel Sheriff uses brutal tactics against oppressed citizens. A rebellion grows, and all must choose between death and taxes.

programme.title: Ashens and the Polybius Heist
programme.desc: A heist like no other! A motley crew of misfits hunts down an infamous 80's arcade game that can supposedly control people's minds in this chart-topping feel-good British comedy.

programme.title: Get the Girl
programme.desc: When a strange girl appears do you help, or mind your business? A retired hitman and his trainee get pulled into the shit when they decide to save a girl who escapes from trafficking. Sometimes you gotta do bad things to bad people.

programme.title: Shelter
programme.desc: 5 survivors wait out nuclear winter in a bomb shelter. Weeks turn into months, & one room proves too small. Social norms break down where privacy is extinct, and things devolve into a fight for survival.

programme.title: Kung Fu Brother
programme.desc: Three cops and a reporter pursue a murderer who's hellbent on acquiring sacred scrolls. As they chase the murderer far and wide, they must find a way to take him down before he gets his hands on the scrolls.
