programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: There Was a Crooked Man
programme.desc: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak.

programme.title: Ben and Charlie
programme.desc: Two likable bandits (George Eastman, Giuliano Gemma) try to make a living in the Old West.

programme.title: The Proud and the Damned
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran (Chuck Connors) and his four buddies take jobs as mercenaries in Colombia.

programme.title: Kate and the Dowager
programme.desc: The gang at the Shady Rest must make sure that socialite, Clara Watkins, has a comfortable stay if Kate is ever to get a loan again from her.

programme.title: Charley Abandons the Cannonball
programme.desc: Charley decides it's time to quit as engineer of the Cannonball when the citizens of Hooterville seem too busy to spend any time with him.

programme.title: Dog Days at Shady Rest
programme.desc: Norman Curtis, the railroad president, sends his basset hound to the Shady Rest to give him a change of scenery.

programme.title: Circle Shorts
programme.desc: A bite-sized taste of country lifestyle, Southern travel, artist interviews and down-home food.

programme.title: Dog Days at Shady Rest
programme.desc: Norman Curtis, the railroad president, sends his basset hound to the Shady Rest to give him a change of scenery.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

programme.title: Escape to the Ponderosa
programme.desc: Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

programme.title: The Avenger
programme.desc: A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

programme.title: The Last Trophy
programme.desc: Two British socialites find that they still have a lot to learn when they visit their friends, the Cartwrights.

programme.title: San Francisco
programme.desc: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

programme.title: Jed Gets the Misery
programme.desc: To humor Granny, Jed fakes illness so that she can resume the doctoring that brought her fame in the hills.

programme.title: Hair Raising Holiday
programme.desc: Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.

programme.title: Granny's Garden
programme.desc: Granny's neighbors try to stop her when she attempts to create a vegetable garden in the front yard of the mansion grounds.

programme.title: Elly Starts to School
programme.desc: Elly sparks a new trend in understated fashion when she enrolls in a finishing school.

programme.title: MacShayne 2: Final Roll of the Dice
programme.desc: Now head of security MacShayne juggles a klepto CEO's grandson, a diva, a threatened senator, and a corpse.

programme.title: Ramblin' Man
programme.desc: Two Montana cowboys (Jerry Reed, Tom Selleck) head for Nashville and help a woman (Morgan Fairchild) find her sister.

programme.title: The Gunmen
programme.desc: Little Joe and Hoss are mistaken for gunmen while in a small Texas town; they find themselves in the middle of a dangerous feud between two families.

programme.title: Bledloe and Son
programme.desc: Homer Bedloe returns to Hooterville with his son Homer Jr., who is a carbon copy of his dad.

programme.title: Local Girl Makes Good
programme.desc: A former resident of Hooterville, Mary Jane Hastings, has returned home as a business executive, impressing everyone with her administrative abilities, and her handling of men.

programme.title: Cave Woman
programme.desc: Kate is missing as a big convention is meeting to decide where to hold their convention, she is stuck in a cave.

programme.title: Kate Flat on Her Back
programme.desc: With Kate injured, Uncle Joe and the daughters must corner the convention.

programme.title: Opry Live
programme.desc: Opry honors Don Williams. Featuring Keith Urban, Trisha Yearwood, John Foster, Rodney Crowell, Brandy Clark, The Isaacs, Jamey Johnson.

programme.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: The Movie
programme.desc: The all-stars of Southern comedy collaborate in this uproarious live stand-up experience. In the summer of 2002, Jeff Foxworthy, Bill Engvall, Ron White and Larry the Cable Guy barnstorm the country with their unique brand of working-class humor. This film documenting the tour captures the highlights of the comedians' hilarious acts, while also going behind the scenes to give viewers a candid look at each of these irrepressible comic personalities.

programme.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour Rides Again
programme.desc: This sequel to "The Blue Collar Comedy Tour" serves up more down-home humor from Southern comedians Jeff Foxworthy, Larry the Cable Guy, Bill Engvall and Ron White. The live stand-up show begins with Engvall giving the lowdown on what men really want. White follows up with his usual acerbic brand of humor. Foxworthy reels the crowd back in with an amusing routine about family and relationships. Finally, Larry the Cable Guy closes the night out on a typically lewd note.

programme.title: Bill Engvall: Just Sell Him for Parts
programme.desc: Original standup comedy special featuring the original material of Bill Engvall.

programme.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
programme.desc: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

programme.title: Betty Jo's First Love
programme.desc: Betty Jo has finally met a man she likes, but he seems more interested in tinkering on cars than he is working on a romance.

programme.title: Behind All Silver, There's a Cloud Lining
programme.desc: Uncle Joe spreads a rumor of a silver strike has been found in the area as a scheme to get more people to stay at the Shady Rest, and dig his drainage ditch for free.

programme.title: The Talent Contest
programme.desc: Uncle Joe tries to rig a talent contest he is promoting, in order to assure that one of his nieces will win.

programme.title: The Mission
programme.desc: Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

programme.title: Badge Without Honor
programme.desc: A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

programme.title: The Mill
programme.desc: Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

programme.title: The Hopefuls
programme.desc: Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

programme.title: Denver McKee
programme.desc: The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

programme.title: Class Reunion
programme.desc: Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

programme.title: Rafe Hollister Sings
programme.desc: Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.

programme.title: Opie and the Spoiled Kid
programme.desc: Opie meets Arnold Winkler, a spoiled kid who teaches him how to manipulate Andy into increasing his allowance by throwing tantrums.

programme.title: The Undefeated
programme.desc: Unaware that the Civil War has ended, Col. John Henry Thomas (John Wayne) successfully attacks a Confederate company led by James Langdon (Rock Hudson). With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them.

programme.title: Django
programme.desc: Stranger Django (Franco Nero) rides into the middle of a border fray between Mexican bandits and the Ku Klux Klan.

programme.title: The Mission
programme.desc: Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

programme.title: The Clampetts Get Psychoanalyzed
programme.desc: The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.

programme.title: The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted
programme.desc: Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but the doctor still wants to see Grannie; her love potion for Pearl misfires, leaving Twombly confused.

programme.title: Elly Becomes a Secretary
programme.desc: Jed takes over Drysdale's job for one afternoon and wins him the Banker of the Year title; Drysdale accidentally uses the wrong speech for his conference, and a new teller makes an impact.

programme.title: Jethro's Friend
programme.desc: One of Jethro's school friends spends a day at the Clampett mansion, and the hillbillies show the over-protected boy how to have fun.

programme.title: Opry Live
programme.desc: Performances from Opry members Darius Rucker, 49 Winchester and Ashley Cooke.

programme.title: The Gambler III: The Legend Continues (Part 1)
programme.desc: Brady Hawkes and Billy Montana join forces once again in this new adventure. This time around their goal is to help the Sioux fight the government and get the supplies they need.

programme.title: The Gambler III: The Legend Continues (Part 2)
programme.desc: Brady Hawkes and Billy Montana join forces, helping the Sioux fight the government.

programme.title: Yes, Virginia, There Is a Santa Claus
programme.desc: Holiday hardship in 1897 prompts an Irish immigrant's (Richard Thomas) daughter to ask the New York Sun a question.

programme.title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
programme.desc: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.

programme.title: The Art Game
programme.desc: After selling a painting, Uncle Joe thinks he's on the road to success.

programme.title: Betty Jo's First Love
programme.desc: Betty Jo has finally met a man she likes, but he seems more interested in tinkering on cars than he is working on a romance.

programme.title: San Francisco
programme.desc: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

programme.title: Bitter Water
programme.desc: When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

programme.title: Feet of Clay
programme.desc: The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

programme.title: Dark Star
programme.desc: Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

programme.title: Death at Dawn
programme.desc: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

programme.title: The Genghis Keane Story
programme.desc: Kate is surprised at her old school teacher's new personality.

programme.title: Spur Line to Shady Rest
programme.desc: A man travels to Hooterville to investigate a line connection.

programme.title: Quick, Hide the Railroad
programme.desc: Kate wants to hide the Hooterville Cannonball to save it from the scrap heap.

programme.title: Stagecoach
programme.desc: John Ford's landmark Western revolves around an assorted group of colorful passengers aboard the Overland stagecoach bound for Lordsburg, New Mexico, in the 1880s. An alcoholic philosophizer (Thomas Mitchell), a lady of ill repute (Claire Trevor) and a timid liquor salesman (Donald Meek) are among the motley crew of travelers who must contend with an escaped outlaw, the Ringo Kid (John Wayne), and the ever-present threat of an Apache attack as they make their way across the Wild West.

programme.title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
programme.desc: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.

programme.title: The People Next Door
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark must help a doctor confront a secret he's kept from everyone, including his own family.

programme.title: I Was a Middle Aged Werewolf
programme.desc: On Halloween, Jonathan helps a little boy get over his fears and in the process get even with his sister!

programme.title: Playing for Keeps
programme.desc: Jonathan casts a retired comic and his movie-star son in a play about a father and son who never got to know each other.

programme.title: Amazing Man
programme.desc: A youngster turns to a fantasy world and a comic-book superhero to cope with the pain of his father's death.

programme.title: All the Colors of the Heart
programme.desc: A counselor at a camp for the blind enlists Jonathan to prevent the suicide of a man losing his sight.

programme.title: Why Punish the Children?
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark clash with a warden over reforms that would unite female inmates with their children.

programme.title: A Dream of Wild Horses
programme.desc: The patriarch of a ranch family feels he's too old to rein in some wild horses.

programme.title: In With the "In" Crowd
programme.desc: A cop is working undercover at a school to put an end to drug use, but faces suspension because of a mistake Mark has made.

programme.title: With Love, The Claus
programme.desc: At Christmastime, Jonathan and Mark try to get a divorced couple to work together for their son's sake. Meanwhile, the holiday may be in jeopardy when a department store Santa is arrested.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Four brothers go on the run to escape a court order that would split them up.

programme.title: Country Doctor
programme.desc: A country doctor's (Roscoe Lee Browne) dedication to his community's medical needs nearly ruins him physically and financially. With Renee Jones.

programme.title: Time in a Bottle
programme.desc: A zealous district attorney tries for a felony conviction of a vagrant accused of stealing a bottle of wine.

programme.title: Back to Oakland
programme.desc: Mark returns to Oakland to become a police officer again, and is reunited with his old partner. However, he discovers his old beat has become a storm of racial hatred.

programme.title: We Have Forever - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his wife when she passes away.

programme.title: We Have Forever - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his former wife when she passes away.

programme.title: The Correspondent
programme.desc: A war correspondent finds himself imprisoned and facing execution. Meanwhile, Jonathan and Mark show him what's he's missed during his life by putting work ahead of family.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark (Michael Landon, Victor French) help a former dancer (Mokihana) overcome her bitterness at being disabled.

programme.title: A Dolphin Song for Lee - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark convince teenager Lee to lobby in the state senate for broader environmental protection.

programme.title: Heaven Nose, Mister Smith
programme.desc: Jonathan must stop an angel who's back on Earth with the intention of breaking up his son's marriage.

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: Jonathan intermediates for a football coach whose attitude about winning-at-all-costs has alienated his son.

programme.title: Whose Trash Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: Mark's friend is running for public office, and he's a very honest man. But things get out of hand when an opponent tries to win by going after his son.

programme.title: Hello and Farewell - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan helps Commander Michaels to deal with flashbacks of Vietnam; he also tries to convince her to go to therapy. Mark deals with his fear of flying.

programme.title: Hello and Farewell - Part 2
programme.desc: A veterans' support group becomes a lifeline for Commander Michaels, who continues to deal with post-traumatic stress disorder. Meanwhile, she discovers that her son David came into the emergency room due to an accident.

programme.title: The Silent Bell
programme.desc: A pastor must follow a council's decision to fire some staff at the school because they're not Christian.

programme.title: The Reunion
programme.desc: Mark attends his high school class reunion and learns that some memories are bittersweet for his old friends.

programme.title: The Source
programme.desc: A teenage girl tells school reporters that a driver came on to her right before the bus got into an accident. She may not be telling the truth. Jonathan tries to teach the news writers the correct way to report a story.

programme.title: The Squeaky Wheel
programme.desc: The problems of the handicapped are addressed when an amputee joins a crusade after a false fire alarm.

programme.title: Goodbye, Mr. Zelinka
programme.desc: Mr. Zelinka is a beloved teacher who is being forced to retire because he's old. Jonathan and Mark know that he would prefer to continue teaching.

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Private detectives Mark and Jonathan help a Vietnamese couple locate their sons that were adopted and raised by an American family.

programme.title: Summer Camp
programme.desc: After having been scarred in a fire, an actress becomes a counselor at a summer camp for blind children.

programme.title: The Inner Limits
programme.desc: A young man decides to institutionalize his brother who has been completely paralyzed for many years.

programme.title: It's a Dog's Life
programme.desc: Mark believes that God has turned Jonathan into a dog. Meanwhile, he must contend with a runaway kid and the kid's scatterbrained mother.

programme.title: Pilot - Part 1
programme.desc: In the series opener, we meet Jonathan Smith, a probationary angel who has been sent to help people on Earth. He befriends residents at a retirement home. The administrator at the home has a brother named Mark who is suspicious of Jonathan.

programme.title: Pilot - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan helps the residents of Havencrest, when they learn that the retirement home is going to be sold.

programme.title: To Touch The Moon
programme.desc: Jonathan helps a terminally ill boy and his mother. Meanwhile, Mark deals with a thief abandoned by his folks.

programme.title: Return of the Masked Rider
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark help aging movie heroes to stand up to a street gang known as Satan's Helpers. They persuade a young boxer not to throw a big fight when the gang tries to bully him.

programme.title: Song of the Wild West
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark assist a young country singer who is hoping to follow in her mother's footsteps. Next, they help a widow mourning her late husband.

programme.title: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan must find a way to help Deke, a college football star whose dreams of reaching the pros are shattered by a tragic motorcycle accident.

programme.title: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan enlists the aid of a gymnast to rehabilitate Deke. Meanwhile, Deke's parents have been deeply affected by the accident.

programme.title: A Divine Madness
programme.desc: A construction tycoon believes he's King Arthur and his estranged son wants him declared incompetent.

programme.title: Catch A Falling Star
programme.desc: Jonathan has been hired to look after the kids of a movie star who never has time to spend with his family.

programme.title: Help Wanted: Angel
programme.desc: Mark has fallen in love with an attractive woman, but Jonathan receives news about her from higher up.

programme.title: Dust Child
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark must help an Amerasian girl facing racial prejudice when she goes to live with her father's family in the United States.

programme.title: Hotel Of Dreams
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are bellhops at a hotel that has been given to an aimless young man by his father. They must deal with an unkind boss, an obnoxious kid and a difficult guest.

programme.title: Death Duel of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Set against a backdrop of Ching/Ming, where two great fighters conflict and end up in a duel. One (Wong Tao) is a nationalist who wants to fight for his country against Manchu oppression and restore the Ming dynasty, whilst the other (John Liu) is a wanderer with expert kicking, who is actually a secret agent for the Ming loyalists. After some double crosses the duel joins forces to fight the mighty Manchu Fighter and stop his forces from reaching the Taiwan straits.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Lady Lallaine Reed
programme.desc: Lady Lallaine Reed's life was a tapestry woven with threads of trauma. Kidnapped as a child, her innocence shattered, she carried the scars of that violation deep within her soul. Fate, cruel and unrelenting, struck again when her own child was abducted, leaving her reeling on the precipice of despair. Yet, from the depths of this abyss, Lady Lallaine Reed rose.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Dave Kovar
programme.desc: Dave Kovar is one of the most notable figures in martial arts history. Founder of the Kovar Business System, he is recognized as one of the pioneers of martial arts business. A tournament karate champion of the 1980s, he opened a successful string of schools across the nation. He is considered one of the first to introduce martial arts instructional videos in the 1980s. He is an author, a public speaker and an advocate for children's self-defense and anti-bullying.

programme.title: Shaolin Invincibles
programme.desc: Chia Ling is out to avenge the massacre of her family by the Emperor's assassins and is assisted by another young woman, played by Lung Chun Erh. The two girls infiltrate the Emperor's court by posing as handmaidens. Carter Wong & Flash Legs Tan play kung fu fighters sent to help Chia Ling at the monastery where she was raised.

programme.title: Mighty Four
programme.desc: During the Ming Dynasty, an honest, upright official is murdered by a greedy, jealous and powerful-hungry official, Ma. His son, Chi Liang, vows to someday get revenge and spends all his youth training in the martial arts. But in order to defeat Ma, Chi must master Magic Kicks technique with the help of the daughter of his father's best friend.

programme.title: Shanghai 13
programme.desc: A patriot finds evidence that the government is collaborating with a foreign power. He gets assistance from a local rebel leader who is in charge of a motley group of fighters called the Shanghai 13.

programme.title: Lady Vengeance and the 47 Ronin
programme.desc: Tsunataro Mumei (Atsuo Nakamura), a former official court janitor, is summoned by Senzaka Hyobu (Takeya Nakamura), a retainer of the Uesugi family. The Uesugi family is about to assassinate Oishi Kuranosuke (Tanba Tetsuro) and a group of ronin who are plotting to avenge the death of their father, Kira Uenosuke, by their lord Tsunanori. The assassination would prove to be the work of the Uesugi family, and the Uesugi family could not be saved from extinction.

programme.title: Duel of the Tough
programme.desc: A buddhist priest and a martial arts student take on the powerful Dai-Kang gang when valuable scriptures containing secret kung fu techniques are stolen. Huang must learn the deadly technique of Magic Kicks from the Shaolin master and retrieve the missing texts at any cost.

programme.title: Sung Dynasty Warriors
programme.desc: Fantastic action packed Mainland China production of the Water Margin, one of the most famous novels in the world. Legend has it that there were 108 knights who were reborn from fighters of thousands of years ago, who fought for justice, beat the wicked and powerful, but they also helped the poor and downtrodden.

programme.title: Buddhist Fist aka Yuen Woo Ping's Buddhist Fist
programme.desc: Two orphans raised by a Shaolin master reunite as adults to search for their godfather and his kidnappers. The fighting has been turned into a true performance art in this film as characters slip in and out and around each other in a way that's pretty outstanding.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 4 - Thunderbolt Angels aka Ninja Powerforce
programme.desc: Two childhood buddies, Albert and Frankie, find themselves on opposite sides of a deadly gang war and end up serving time in prison. Once released, Frankie joins with ninja master and cop extraordinaire Gordon, who is determined to track Lion down, but Lion has his own allies, in the form of the Red Ninja. Can Gordon defeat the Red Ninja and re-establish the supremacy of the Golden Ninja Empire?

programme.title: Raging Masters Tiger Crane
programme.desc: Hwang Jang Lee plays the Silver Fox in this brilliant production from Korea. Li-Siu, a young Shaolin Monk finds the opportunity to practice his kung fu teachings. During his practice he stumbles onto the murder of the Abbot at the Shaolin Temple and the kidnapping of the elder monk Do-Lim. A string of pearls found in the hands of the murdered Abbot is the only clue that leads Li-Siu to the Silver-Fox, the murderer and sinister mastermind of a deadly plot to invade China.

programme.title: Dreaming Fists with Slender Hands
programme.desc: The title characters are a group of abandoned orphans. The kids find a home of sorts when they join a group of street performers. In Dickensian fashion, they're entertainers by day, do-gooders the rest of the time. An interesting combination of styles lifts this one well above the ordinary.

programme.title: Boxers of Loyalty and Righteousness aka Shogun Saints
programme.desc: Warlord Yu Ming gain great power for himself. Anyone he suspects of disloyalty was jailed or murdered. He himself was a notorious killer having personally betrayed his friend General Yip and then slaughtered him and his family. But the General' son escaped and spent a lifetime to learn all the martial arts to take his revenge. He must lure Yu Ming away from his private army of thugs and gangster. Shogun warriors come to the ruler's defense, though a few of them have second thoughts.

programme.title: Soul Brothers of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two illegal immigrants meet a young kid, and the three become best friends until one of them joins the Triads. Now the remaining two must fight the Triads in a battle to the death.

programme.title: Shaolin Heroes
programme.desc: During the declining years of Ming dynasty, Mongolians sent secret agents to intrude central China and tried to obtain "The Light Sword" a mighty sword, which can gather all brave wanderers. The son of Lung Chen Ying master of the Light Sword style learns of the plot and kills the leader of secret mission and temporarily stopped the Mongolian's ambition.

programme.title: Secret of Chinese Kung Fu
programme.desc: Chang Chi (Sze Ma Lung) is saved by two sisters at sea. One of the sisters, Mei Yee Yee (Hsia Ling Ling) takes to liking the young man and gets him a job at the local fish cannery. Chang Chi rises to the top at the cannery and becomes foreman. Chang Chi's promotion is short-lived as the thug, Kang Ho (Lo Lieh), strong arms the cannery ownership from old man Cheng and bounces Chang Chi back to a regular worker. So why does Kang Ho want this fish cannery?

programme.title: Black Invitation
programme.desc: Living large in the Fuhu Shan region, Qiu San (Ma Chi) and his ruthless gang extort money from the local people by sending out black invitations listing how much the gang would like to "borrow". Those who hand over the money even a little late experience the gang's violent wrath. Until one just knight makes a stand...

programme.title: Six Directions Boxing
programme.desc: David Chiang, star of many classic Shaw Brothers films, and the great Yuen Hsiao Tien (Jackie Chan's Drunken Master) star in this kung fu bonanza set in China's warlord period. When a secret team is sent by the police to break up the revolutionaries and their arms movements, it will take more than just guns to annihilate them! Six Directions of Boxing is wall-to-wall, hand-to-hand kung fu mayhem!

programme.title: The Iron Man
programme.desc: Chin (Wang Yu), whose family was killed and his left hand cut off by a brutal Japanese general Fang Woo (Lung Fei) during the occupation of China in World War II. After 12 years of training in kung fu, Chin travels to Japan to seek revenge on those who wronged him and his family. Action packed one armed classic!

programme.title: 52 Masters: BJJ WRESTLING with Efrain Sevilla
programme.desc: Will is thrown by Brazilian Jiu-Jutsu fighter Efrain Sevilla.

programme.title: Return of Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Pai Wu Chin (Bruce Pak) is a stranger in town who is on a mission to find out the whereabouts of his missing brother (Bruce Le), who rumor has it, was murdered by the chief inspector of police. Pei Chiu Ting is the brother of the ex-chief inspector and is now the head samurai who wants Pai Wu killed on site. Non-stop action follows when Pai Wu meets Po Zu Pai, who together faces their common enemy and fights the samurai clan.

programme.title: The Iron Profligate
programme.desc: A detective and self-confessed profligate and martial artists of the highest caliber team up to smash an illegal gambling house and drug smuggling outfit.

programme.title: Masters of Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Experience a Tai Chi Chuan class with Master Cui Zhongsan in Beijing and listen to him explain the history and philosopy of Yang style and how and why it developed as a seperate style from Chen Tai Chi. Visit the small remote Chen village, the birthplace of Tai Chi and learn the history of Tai Chi with the Chen family. It was here that Yang style was born through Chen student Yang Luchan.

programme.title: Don't Panic!
programme.desc: Scott is wasted and belligerent at Kris's birthday; Kim uses spy tactics to solve a theft problem at Dash New York.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: A security breach persuades Kris to step up security; Scott attends to a Lord Disick party in Vegas while Kourtney finds out the baby could come early; Kim and Khloé put on a last-minute baby shower.

programme.title: Buggy Boo
programme.desc: The birth of a third child sends Scott spiraling, and Khloé gets Bruce to help bring Scott back down to earth; Kylie's wish of owning a home comes true faster than she ever thought.

programme.title: Lip Service
programme.desc: The media starts poking into Kylie's beauty secrets, and she realizes she must address her new look; Scott is afraid he made a mistake when he hires Kourtney as an interior designer.

programme.title: Moons Over Montana
programme.desc: Kim attempts to keep traditions alive by planning a family ski trip to Montana, but this year's vacation will have different vibe; On the slopes, Khloé tries to bond with Kylie.

programme.title: In the Blink of an Eye...
programme.desc: The siblings come home from Montana to wish their dad well as Bruce prepares to transition; Kris travels with Kendall to Paris; Kim seeks one last hope of getting pregnant.

programme.title: Mother Armenia
programme.desc: Kim and Khloé go to the land of their ancestors to achieve a long-standing dream of their father's; Kourtney wants to find out why Kylie is being so distant, and the truth is something unexpected.

programme.title: It Feels Good to Be Home
programme.desc: Kanye plays a surprise public concert to say thank you to Armenia; Kim arranges to have North baptized in Israel's oldest Armenian Church; back in LA, everyone responds differently to having Caitlyn in their lives, with Kris taking it the hardest.

programme.title: Vanity Unfair
programme.desc: Caitlyn comes out in her first big magazine interview and states things the family considers hurtful, Kim does her best to pick up the pieces; Khloé has to decide how much emotional support she can afford to give to Lamar.

programme.title: The Last Straw
programme.desc: Kourtney attempts to keep it together as Scott's behavior spins out of control; Khloé decides to meet face to face with Caitlyn to try to salvage their relationship; Kris finally gives Corey boyfriend status.

programme.title: Back in Miami
programme.desc: Kourtney accuses Khloé of being a lousy sister and business partner after Khloé shows up late.

programme.title: Wax on Wax Off
programme.desc: Kourtney learns that times have changed when old friends drop by for a good time.

programme.title: Scotts-o-phrenia
programme.desc: Khloe takes her innuendos about Scott being a sociopath too far.

programme.title: Jealousy Makes the Heart Grow Fonder
programme.desc: Kourtney tries to make Scott jealous; Khloe is annoyed with Rob and Lamar's close relationship.

programme.title: Picture Perfect
programme.desc: Kourtney's post-baby shoot; an argument might change Khloe and Kourtney's relationship forever.

programme.title: Sisterly Love
programme.desc: Kim tries to reconnect with Kourtney to fill the void of Khloe being away.

programme.title: Kourtney's Denial
programme.desc: With the retail business not doing so well, the sisters head back to South Beach.

From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.

programme.title: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Legend Trippers
programme.desc: A Halloween dare leads high school friends Nick, Krystian, and Jon to an old cemetery in Green Lake, Wisconsin. Seeking a rumored haunted mausoleum, they become separated in the darkness. As they sense an eerie presence stalking them, their skepticism turns to terror. They must escape before the vengeful spirits of the graveyard awaken-and ensure they never leave.

programme.title: C.O.R.N: A Field of Screams
programme.desc: Stranded in a rural area, 2 teens make friends with locals on Halloween but soon run into a cult called C.O.R.N. (Collective Order of Recreational Necrophilanthropists) that have chosen this area to perform human taxidermy.

programme.title: Chillingham Castle
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate Chillingham Castle, the most haunted castle in the world, for a Halloween investigation.

programme.title: Sometimes They Come Back... Again
programme.desc: For years, Jon Porter (Michael Gross) has been repressing memories of how his older sister was murdered -- and how he electrocuted her three assailants to death. Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed.

programme.title: Flight 7500
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes airline passengers.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: Tahara
programme.desc: Two best friends attend the funeral of a Hebrew school classmate who died by suicide and accidentally damage their friendship beyond repair.

programme.title: Fierce People
programme.desc: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Lay the Favorite

Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
programme.desc: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf.

programme.desc: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

programme.desc: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions
programme.desc: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños

programme.desc: Todos los hombres desaparecen tras las puertas de la casa de "Las siete Cucas".

programme.title: Verdugo de traidores
programme.desc: Un comandante de policía tiene que eliminar la corrupción que existe en su departamento a causa de los sobornos.

programme.title: El Quelite
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene una sensación extraña cada vez que escucha la música de una canción.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.desc: Por tener acceso a cualquier lugar, un herrero es enviado por el general Villa con un mensaje importante para Zapata.

programme.desc: Poveda, el cacique, se presenta como padre legítimo de un niño y lo rapta. El ex pistolero comienza una intensa lucha con el secuestrador para rescatar al niño.

programme.title: Espejismo de la Ciudad
programme.desc: Una familia campesina vende todas sus posesiones y se muda a la ciudad, donde encuentran grandes dificultades y dolor.

programme.title: Un tipo difícil de matar
programme.desc: El rancho de Tony es blanco de un asalto en Estados Unidos, Ringo el líder de la banda quien también rapta una mujer, sufrirá más de lo que imagina, la persecución será a muerte.

programme.title: Delirio del Poder
programme.desc: Dos hombres crean un plan para terminar con un candidato presidencial y entrenan a una mujer para cumplir su misión.

programme.title: Enemigos a muerte
programme.desc: Dos amigos y una mujer se dedican a hacer trampas y robos como su medio de vida.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas

programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Aventuras de un caballo blanco y un niño
programme.desc: Un niño y un caballo blanco son perseguidos por una banda de bandoleros, quienes quieren apoderarse de su oro escondido.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Matt Smith heads to Cannon Hall Farm where Rob and Dave's latest arrival, a Highland calf, has serious breathing problems. Elsewhere, Rohin Aojula takes his dad on a call to help a horse that has suffered a nasty injury while out riding.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: A special episode focusing on births and babies. Julian heads to a local farm where a cow is struggling in labour. And with bringing new life into the world such a vital part of a vet's job, Julian's also hoping to assist in the birth of a career.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode The Yorkshire Vet, Julian Norton, is called to an emergency down on the farm where semi-retired farmers, The Peckitt's have a cow suffering from an excruciatingly painful and life-threatening condition, bloat. Former Herriot trainee, Peter Wright, treats a hand-reared lamb who is going for the chop (not that sort) because he's causing chaos in the family to which he's been adopted.

programme.title: Urban Babies
programme.desc: A day in the life of the extremely cute baby animals that we encounter in our everyday lives.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Will 3-year old Ollie and his family find a forever friend in staffy puppy Tiger? Can Frankie the pup help Simon overcome a childhood dog attack trauma? And will Jaran be Liz and Scott's first dog?

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: The Yorkshire Vet, Julian Norton has his work cut out in this episode. There's peril in the pig pen as he risks life and limb to inject a ferocious porker and a mystery to solve with stud alpaca Lothario, who's so far failed to live up to his namesake's reputation. Steve and Jeanie Green have spent a lifetime with cows.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: To mark International Dog Day tomorrow, a special episode celebrating the magical relationship between man and dog.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Will Winnie's appetite for destruction get in the way of finding a happy new home? Simba has a chance at love from Jenny. However, his instant bond with her twin brother, John, could be an issue.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: A sheep is rushed into the practice to see Peter, after seriously injuring herself on a piece of metal. Peter thinks he can deal with the wound, but the bigger problem is that the ewe is pregnant with twins. And the lambs' lives are in danger.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Latin America
programme.desc: Latin America is the destination.Tear around the high plains of the Andes with a wild and woolly baby Vicuna, have your world turned upside down by some gravity defying Capuchin babies and hit the waves with an energetic pod of Patagonian Sea Lion pups.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian Norton is called out on an emergency to a heifer that is in agony, with an object stuck in its painful, swollen and infected hoof. Peter removes a large lump from the head of golden retriever, Holly.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: When a complaint comes in about two skinny dogs, Inspector Herchy Boal is straight on the case. Staffie crosses Rocky and Bentley are both extremely underweight and in need of help, but is it just a decent meal these two need or is something else wrong?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Pete and Hernando are smitten with Tibetan spaniel mix Baxter. But will their picky chihuahua Bruno approve? Can doctor Patrick offer chill senior citizen Buster the red cattle dog a retirement home?

programme.title: Special Home Visits
programme.desc: In The Yorkshire Vet - Home Visits, Peter and Julian catch up with old friends and find out how they're getting on. The Greens are one of the practice's favourite farming families and their lives have been full of ups and downs. One of their most difficult times was having to sell their dairy herd. Now there's a worry about another of their animals, Britney the greyhound.

programme.title: More Farm Babies
programme.desc: We revisit the farms to catch the antics of the babies in the country. Miniature horses, baby goats, piglets and lambs are featured among other more exotic farm animals.

programme.title: Water Babies
programme.desc: We meet the water babies that live in the aquatic regions, aquariums and maritime parks of the world. We meet African penguins, baby seals and otter pups.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian Norton is called out to examine an alpaca, new vet Helen Blackburn performs an emergency caesarean on a beagle and Peter tries to save the eyesight of Whisper the lamb.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Following the comings and goings at the World's most famous vets - James Herriot's old practice, Skeldale Veterinary Centre in Thirsk, North Yorkshire now run by former Herriot trainee, Peter Wright and partner, Julian Norton. In this episode Julian goes head to head with Hilda the Highland Cow - battling to remove a large lump from between her horns.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter rushes to help a pregnant cow that is expecting twins, which is uncommon. Julian meets a champion ferret who has an infected foot. Shona heads out to see an old horse that is suffering with sore eyes.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Charlotte is looking for a dog to give her best friend Zeke the pug some love. Will loveable Harley win the Macdonald family over? Could former dance Natasha be the ticket out for husky cross Aislinn?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian Norton tries to save Millie, a much-loved farm dog and an albino wallaby called Albert. Peter Wright has his hands full with a cheeky pygmy goat called Charlie. Other patients include a hedgehog called Monster.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Beach Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place alongside some of the beaches of the world, checking out the non-stop action both on shore and further out to sea.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Favourite stories and unseen footage from the series, following Yorkshire vet Julian Norton, his partner Peter Wright and their team.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: When footage of a dog being beaten by his owner comes to the attention of the RSPCA, inspector Mel Fisher is straight on the case. It doesn't take long for her to rescue the young German Shepherd and bring the owner to justice. In Sunderland, inspector Jaqui Miller has her hands full when three generations of dogs are signed over by their struggling owner, and help has arrived just in time.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Are two dogs too many when the Prestia family meet a bonded pair? Will retired nuns Margaret and Antoinette find their final doggy companion? Can Justin the magician handle large puppy Oreo's tricks?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter rushes to an emergency. Treasured harness racing horse, Magnum, has been involved in an horrendous accident. He's sustained an horrific injury. Can Peter save Magnum or is it the end of the line?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Will it be a love affair when Elaine is paired with fellow single girl Hayley the blue Staffy? Plus, a family have the pick of two dogs, Rusty the kelpie and Lightning the Australian terrier cross.

programme.title: Extreme Cold Babies
programme.desc: We are in the cold parts of the planet. We spend time with playful seal pups, and penguin chicks. Plus out on the pack ice a baby polar bear plays.

programme.title: Grassland Babies
programme.desc: Today's episode takes place in the grasslands of the world. We see Lynx kittens, a wild foal, and baby mongooses among other animals featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian Norton treats a cow with a rare and complex problem. The cow's stomach has become displaced and moved to the wrong side of her body, causing pain and stopping her eating. Meanwhile in Thirsk, a baby roe deer is brought into the practice as it has stopped taking milk, and a dog has a large tumour removed in a tricky operation.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter rushes to save a newborn calf who's going downhill fast. Julian visits Tazmin the huge eagle. Peter's old friend, Bison, the much-loved boxer, has hormone problems. Can Julian get a poorly ewe well enough to have lambs? Zoe's language skills are put to the test. Dexter the Ferret returns. He's known to nip, so will Julian keep his fingers intact?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian races to help a pony with a large gash on her neck and Peter battles to save a sheep. A greedy cat has a stick stuck in his mouth and Julian faces a massive, messy job - pregnancy testing over 50 cows.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Europe
programme.desc: Venturing through Europe, meeting the youngsters that live and play there.There's Brown Bear cubs messing around, a litter of scrappy Red Fox kits doing their best impression of a whirlwind as they play fight, plus a bunch of hungry St Bernard pups.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian helps a pregnant ewe with a tricky birth. Peter must remove a large tumour from a dog's bottom. Julian investigates a mystery llama injury. A female rhea has been injured during mating season. And can Peter save a schoolgirl's precious pony?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Pomeranian Prince is ready to rule his kingdom - will the Acton family be his new loyal subjects' And will Winnie's obsession with chewing squeaky toys be his downfall with the Johnsons'

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Peter heads back to the Teasdales' farm where he recently delivered a healthy calf. But this time the pressure is really on, as the expectant mum belongs to Ian's young son, Alfie.

programme.title: Pet Babies
programme.desc: We spend time hanging about with our favourite pets. Featuring puppies, kittens and baby rabbits among more exotic animals we keep for pets.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a young farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger. Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog Reuben, who's couch bound with arthritis.

programme.title: More Pet Babies
programme.desc: This time we spend the day with some of the world's most beloved pets. Kittens, puppies and baby guinea pigs are some of the babies we have fun with.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Australia and New Zealand
programme.desc: We hang out with the youngsters that live and play in Australia and New Zealand. A baby Koala backpacks around the bush with its mum, join Fur Seal pups for a rocking good time on the rugged shores of New Zealand and bound around with Kangaroo joeys.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Rupert the adored trekking llama is lame and in agony. Can Julian save Rupert's career? Peter pregnancy tests cows. But will all of Arthur's prized herd be in calf? Ruben the lurcher was rescued by elderly local farmers, Jean and Steve Green. But his love of Jean's home cooking might be causing problems. Ellie May, a treasured moggie, is accidentally run over by her devastated owner.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Will Sweetie the sassy staffy hit the sweet spot for Hillary and Jaxson' Can senior snaggletooth George find the perfect retirement home that he has been looking for with ex-pat professional Janice'

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter is struggling to find his feet in his new practice. But when a farmer rushes in with a heavily pregnant sheep who's struggling to give birth, instinct takes over as Peter deals with the emergency.

programme.title: Yorkshire Vet At Christmas Special
programme.desc: Julian Norton and Peter Wright are invited to switch on the Christmas lights at Skeldale and also asked to find a donkey that can be used for the nativity scene.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Two brothers are worried about their cow, who is foaming at the mouth. Peter also has a daunting visit to the Greens' farm. Dusty the cat has an injury, but won't be easy to help. An animal lover finds a pigeon with a deformed leg.

programme.title: Winter Babies
programme.desc: We look at playful youngsters who extract the most fun out of winter. Brown bear babies enjoy this time of the year along with baby snow monkeys enjoying time in hot springs. Tasmanian Devil babies seek out a cosy den.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter tries to save a cow who has suffered a huge prolapse after giving birth. With the newborn calf depending on her mum, the pressure is on.

programme.title: Even More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We return to the zoos to meet up with more babies, wild cat kittens, chimpanzees, and panda cubs are featured.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Kris Walker visits a property and finds Missy, one of the most matted dogs we've ever seen on the show. Inspector Keira Benham is concerned when she finds two dogs living in hazardous conditions. Can Rex and Tyson's owner clean up her act or is it too little too late? And it's d-day for Ted. Find out if the rescue Spaniel has what it takes to become a fully-fledged police sniffer dog.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Matt and David meet equine rock star Jon Bon Pony. Peter treats a farmer's trusty Labrador who's struggling to walk after cutting herself on a nail. Julian operates on a chicken with an infected leg. Robin aids a pregnant ewe.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter desperately tries to deliver thirteen puppies who are drowning in their own fluid. Saving a sick school guinea pig is a big test for Julian. And on the Greens' farm, Jean throws a surprise party for Steve's 90th.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Is Lane the dachshund pup the perfect match for Arnav and his parents? Can lovebirds James and Melissa win over aloof Aspen, the Japanese Spitz? Finally, will scruffy sweet Caroline find good times with Jay and Christine?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In Staffordshire, Inspector Charlotte Melvin comes to the aid of two Border Collies living in hazardous conditions. And that's not the only thing troubling her; because their owner is struggling to cope...

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter meets his most tricky client yet, Possum the uber-angry pussycat. Nykee the alpaca may have a life-threatening and excruciatingly painful condition. Can Julian save both mum and baby? Peter meets much-loved ram, Diamond, who has eye problems. Working sheep dog, Flynn, has a suspected broken leg. Will Julian be able to get him back to running with his flock?

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter Wright needs to act fast to save a cow with heart failure, only to find something unexpected in its stomach. A beagle goes through a difficult birth and a hamster arrives for a simple procedure that ends up proving tricky. Ethel the vulture gets territorial when Peter arrives with a microchip.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A farmer fears his sheep has been shot. But has it suffered an attack by a dog or a fox? Peter's worried about a tawny owl whose eye he removed 18 months ago. Flynn now has a serious problem with his remaining eye, which means his life is in danger.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: It's Sunday morning, but it's no day of rest for Julian as he heads to the Taylors' farm. One of their sheep has prolapsed a few days after he delivered her lamb, and Julian has his work cut out to receive another reward of freshly laid eggs.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A labrador needs surgery after eating the sock her puppies were playing with, and Peter must find another way to feed a foal that is unable to ingest its mother's milk. A cockatoo fights back when the vets attempt to file down its overgrown beak, two emergencies occur at the same farm in the middle of lambing season, and a newborn calf is running a fever, leaving the owners fearful of pneumonia.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter faces a difficult calving at Ed McDonald's farm. The cow is an experienced mum and Ed is an experienced farmer, so Peter senses it's a serious problem.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Will Australian Shepherd Alfie and the Holmes Family find their new mate? Will 'stage-5-clinger' Missy be too much for a first time owner? Will shy shaggy Doug be the right fit for the Billich family?

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Julian rushes over to see worried and confused farmer Joe Holmes. He found one of his cows with afterbirth hanging out, so he thought she'd already calved. But there's no sign of a new arrival, so he suspects she's struggling to give birth.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Can a father and son duo look past Cara the beagle's anxiety and give her a shot? The Ford family look for a new canine companion for their nervous therapy dog Lucy. Plus, Parmigiana's second chance.

programme.title: More Urban Babies
programme.desc: We are back in the towns and cities to visit babies who brighten our lives, some more unusual than you might imagine... Kangaroo joey, raccoon kits and fruit-bat babies.

programme.title: Summer Babies
