programme.title: Frankie's Day Out
programme.desc: Frankie shows you how to make a week's worth of meals on a single trip to the grocery store, and then shows you three options for struggle meals on the go.

programme.title: Jane Lopes & Andrey Tolmachyov
programme.desc: Two Wine Directors from across the globe meet for a blind tasting in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Pasta Pasta Pasta
programme.desc: Piled with pasta love: pork bolognese tortellini with cheese rose, soft ricotta gnudi in tomato sauce, creamy gorgonzola pasta with pancetta and charred veggies.

programme.title: Street Food Comfort
programme.desc: From a Korean fried chicken "dog" with dual ketchups to buttermilkoniondipped drumsticks and popcornshrimp in wafflecone tacos - street eats done cozy.

programme.title: Magical Beans
programme.desc: All about beans: Spencer slow-bakes black bean and kabocha squash soup with Swiss chard and chili pesto, plus Mediterranean-style broad beans in savory sauce.

programme.title: Summertime Delights
programme.desc: Scallop salad; seared sesame chicken breast; mint granita.

programme.title: Heart Healthy & Heavenly
programme.desc: Potatoes baked with tomatoes; salmon with mustard sauce; angel cake with fresh berries.

programme.title: Deflate Your Mate
programme.desc: Nadia G's 3 low-fat meals will slim your lover fast: Tuna with Wasabi Potatoes, zesty Chickpea Stew, and rich dark Pot au Chocolat-dessert best eaten solo!

programme.title: Onion Odyssey
programme.desc: Chef Dev prepares some of his favorite street food dishes from around the world that feature onions, including Seeni Sambol Buns from Sri Lanka, a Blooming Onion from the USA, and Scallion Pancakes from South Korea.

programme.title: The Rochester
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - The Rochester Garbage Plate! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Lusk / Sydney, NSW, Australia
programme.desc: Our contributors are Mother and Daughter, Kate and Sarah Swetman. Sarah has been living in Sydney for 2 years now with her partner Aaron. We meet parents Noel and Kate in Lusk at the round tower, Dad Noel was born and raised in Lusk and he shows Catherine the old family home and farm and describes his early life in Lusk.

programme.title: 50 Cent and Naturi Naughton
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites Grammy winner Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson over for some fresh and delicious comfort food. Dancing up a storm in the kitchen, they prepare a menu of Slow-Cooked Brisket, Smashed Potatoes and Patti's Southern-Style Fried Corn. Later, actress Naturi Naughton stops by for Patti's famous Succulent Scallops in Garlic Butter Sauce, and Miss Patti gives Naturi a cooking lesson that is "Over the Rainbow."

programme.title: Ta'Rhonda Jones and Lance Gross
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle has star power in her kitchen today. First, Ta'Rhonda Jones drops by to learn Patti's delicious Pork Chops with Sauteed Cabbage. Then, Patti refreshes her palate with actress Kaitlin Doubleday over a vegan lunch of Sauteed Portobello Mushrooms with Garlic and Butter. Finally, Patti is joined by actor Lance Gross, to help her prepare Pan-Seared Salmon served with Sauteed Green Beans "A La Bella."

programme.title: Carrie Ann Inaba and Cedric the Entertainer
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites comedian Cedric the Entertainer over for a hearty meal. They laugh out loud in the kitchen as Patti cooks up juicy and tender lamb chops served with candied sweet potatoes and fresh sauteed spinach. Then, Dancing with the Stars judge Carrie Ann Inaba stops by for a sweet treat, and Patti makes it a family affair when she prepares Aunt Hattie Mae's Raspberry Pie -- a simple and delicious dessert that's a perfect 10.

programme.title: The Salmon Show
programme.desc: Julia Child hopes to catch salmon for her main course. Guest chef Douglas Grech makes an unusual chocolate and raspberry dessert. Zelma Long of the Simi Winery in Healdsburg, California is guest winemaker.

programme.title: Deviled Rabbit
programme.desc: For a dinner honoring James Beard, the menu includes Kentucky Ham Puffs and Orange Souffle with Apricot Sauce. With chef Jean-Pierre Goyenvalle of Le Lion D'or in Washington, DC and Richard Maher of Beringer Vineyards in St. Helena, CA.

programme.title: Thailand
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay concludes his gastronomic journey around South-East Asia's most jaw-dropping locations in Thailand.

programme.title: Scallops & Pork
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the more tantalizing dish! The catch? Each of their plates must prominently feature both scallops and pork tenderloin!

programme.title: Scorpio
programme.desc: Chef Siobhan is all in for Scorpio! She kicks off with fiery scorpion pepper-marinated Cornish Hen, cooked under a brick so it's extra quick! The next dish may seem familiar, but it's got a twist: creamy Potato and Egg Salad with lobster! After that, some Scorpio alchemy - namely turning butter into gold with saffron for a rich Golden Beurre Blanc to drizzle over crisp-skinned autumn Pickerel. Finally some dark and mysterious Scorpio hued Black Licorice cupcakes with midnight black frosting!

programme.title: Vietnamese Egg Rolls with the Martinelli Family
programme.desc: Sandra is mixing things up by infusing Italian flare into her mother's traditional Vietnamese egg rolls. Will this cultural fusion win over the judges, or has this challenger bitten off more than she can chew?

programme.title: Dominica
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Tonight's brigade of amateur cooks are all four amateur cooks from the Kent Fire Brigade, pan-roasted foie gras with rhubarb, butter-roasted rib eye of beef and summer berry soup with floating islands

programme.title: The Taste
programme.desc: Food preferences are influenced by dozens of factors, including genetics, environment and habit, but the taste is also about perception; the color, texture and weight of food are as important as the flavor.

programme.title: Terrines And Pates
programme.desc: According to Julia Child, if you can make a meat loaf you can make a French pate; it's as simple as ground meat flavored with herbs and wine, then baked in a mold. Wonderful to have on hand for special events, gifts, snacks, first courses, lunches and suppers.

programme.title: Scipione Castle
programme.desc: Over the Po Plain, near Parma, lies the "Castello di Scipione". It is home to Count René, Countess Stefania von Holstein and their daughter Elisabeth.

programme.title: Riegersburg Castle
programme.desc: Riegersburg Castle is one of the largest castles in Austria and in the ownership of Prince Emanuel von und zu Liechtenstein.

programme.title: The Sweet Life In Vidalia
programme.desc: Take a tour around Vidalia, GA to find southern comfort food, outrageous sandwiches, and homemade donuts. Skye uses local pecans in a family recipe.

programme.title: Diner Delights
programme.desc: Food's Greatest Hits gets its diner on, serving up three quintessentially American dishes. Found on diner menus far and wide, we look at juicy burgers, sky-high club sandwiches and we're washing it all down with a thick, creamy milkshake.

programme.title: Life Tastes Better On the Road
programme.desc: Damaris Phillips and NASCAR's Rutledge Wood discover that, at LUNCHBOXeats in Memphis, Southern food gets schooled and transformed into over-the-top, delectable eats. They indulge in a super-sized fried chicken and waffle sandwich at this hip, nostalgia-inspired spot. Next, the road leads to one of Charleston, South Carolina's best eateries, Hominy Grill, for a savory beignet fried up with shrimp and okra.

programme.title: The Big Cheese
programme.desc: Kimberly visits a slice of Southern paradise tucked away in the hills of Tennessee where she learns the art of making sheep cheese before joining some friends for some skeet shooting. Then, she takes the cheese back to the kitchen to whip up a creamy dairy delight as her bandmates Karen Fairchild, Jimi Westbrook and Phillip Sweet drop by!

programme.title: Taco Tuesdays
programme.desc: Pull up a seat and enjoy Taco Tuesdays on Xumo Free Food TV, featuring mouth-watering Mexican cooking shows.

programme.title: Trio of Heartwarming Pasta
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest- a Spaghettini with Olive Oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Metaballs and eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta - Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.

programme.title: Lemony Chicken- A Family Favorite
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: The Invention of Cooking
programme.desc: After humans harness fire as a tool, it ignites a culinary and cerebral revolution.

programme.title: Albert Elkerson
programme.desc: Chef Cisse Elhadji welcomes us to Renaissance Harlem, a restaurant reflective of Harlem's myriad cultures, while Kevin and Kim share the joys of operating a craft brewery. We will also meet with Albert Elkerson, a man of many talents.

programme.title: Laid Back Turkey
programme.desc: Julia learns about dates for her Cheese Stuffed dates. Also prepared -- Kentucky Ham Mousse and Laid Back Turkey with Mushroom stuffing. With Jim Cohen and Richard G. Peterson.

programme.title: episode 3
programme.desc: Green vegetable soup. Roast leg of lamb and mint relish. Chickpea and coriander puree. Carrots with lemon. A 'plain cake' served with strawberries, crème anglaise and cream.

programme.title: episode 8
programme.desc: In this final episode of the series, Rory prepares a starter of potato aioli with quail eggs, radishes, cherry tomatoes, spring onions, avocado, coriander and cumin. He follows this with roasted aubergine with ricotta, honey, mint, fennel and chilli. And his chocolate souffle cake with chocolate sauce and raspberries is a chocolate lover's delight!

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Taco Night
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a taco night menu with a table to match! There's chicken taquitos, pulled pork tacos, pico di gallo, guacamole, homemade taco sauce, and so much more!

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: Lazy Salmon and Sides
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Lazy Salmon and Sides! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: The Rochester
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - The Rochester Garbage Plate! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: The French Laundry Experience
programme.desc: Napa, CA - Marooned in San Francisco, Tony tastes local shellfish and durian ice cream before embarking on a pilgrimage to experience the genius of Thomas Keller, chef and owner of The French Laundry.

programme.title: Traditional Tastes
programme.desc: Morocco (Cities) - Tony is invited to experience the culinary heart and distinct walled medinas (districts) of the Moroccan city Fes.

programme.title: Dining with Geishas
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: AJ McLean
programme.desc: Former Backstreet Boy, AJ McLean, holds nothing back as he dishes on his love life, sobriety, boyband days, and beyond.

programme.title: Bonapartes Revisited
programme.desc: Bonaparte's was losing money fast. Ramsay soon established that what the people of Silsden really want to eat is Beef and Ale Pie and Treacle Tart. Ramsay soon had the restaurant packed but what state is it in now?

programme.title: Food for Friends
programme.desc: Cooking for friends should not be time-consuming and should be a big hit with your friends. So, how do you accomplish this? Think: Sunday roast and a slow cooker, or mussels in ale. What about a hearty chorizo and chickpea stew?

programme.title: Outdoor Food
programme.desc: We all enjoy eating outdoors in a beer garden, and Tom wants to show us how to create outdoor food properly. Chicken in a basket with a twist, a tasty fish burger, a delicious maple cake, extra special barbecued beef ribs... it is chow time.

programme.title: Pizza
programme.desc: Of all the foods featured on Food Pop, pizza...may just be the most popular of them all. Almost everyone has a favorite slice...A favorite topping....And a favorite pizza place...The world is passionate about pizza. I mean, who hasn't been to a pizza party? While the word "pizza" dates back to the year 997 A.D, it's amazing to think that pizza-as we know it-has only been around since the18thcentury. .Like pasta...pizza is a signature of Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Carp
programme.desc: Chen's challenger is a man who masters Chaozhou-style Chinese cuisine, an exacting style that is actually able to please the sensitive tastes of customers in Kyoto.

programme.title: Squid
programme.desc: Sakai battles the "conjurer of garlic," a chef who embraces the pungent ingredient as real Italians do. Sakai is further challenged to use live squids in the dishes.

programme.title: Chocolate Ruffle Cake with Alice Medrich
programme.desc: Alice Medrich, author, pastry chef and teacher from Berkeley, California, prepares chocolate ruffle cake.

programme.title: Puff Pastry with Michel Richard
programme.desc: Michel Richard, author of Michel Richard's Home Cooking With a French Accent, prepares puff pastry, apricot pastries and torte Milanese.

programme.title: Chef Eric's Culinary Classroom
programme.desc: Join world-renowned Chef Eric Crowley for his first Masterclass video series inspiring you to feel confident in the kitchen with several spectacular dishes that are easy to create.

programme.title: Artstetten Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale has been invited to Artstetten Castle by the ancestors of the Habsburg Royal Family in Austria.

programme.title: Chillingham Castle
programme.desc: Will the spirits in the haunted castle enjoy the roast pheasant with rowanberry jelly and chips?

programme.title: Bamboo Shoots
programme.desc: The challenger is a stubborn chef descended from a long line of Tokyo dwellers. The Iron Chef will have his hands full facing such a strong tradition.

programme.title: Mango
programme.desc: The challenger is one of the few Mexican food specialists in Tokyo. This is a Latin duel at Kitchen Stadium.

programme.title: Edinburgh
programme.desc: Michelin starred Chef, Tom Kerridge takes Fred to Edinburgh for a fine dining experience at Kitchin, the Michelin starred restaurant of Chef Tom Kitchin. Kitchin specialises in showcasing Scottish ingredients, sourced from a network of suppliers to ensure that the menu really captures a taste of Scotland.

programme.title: Malaysia
programme.desc: Gordon is in Malaysia where he quickly learns it's the women and not the chefs that rule the kitchens.

programme.title: Smoke
programme.desc: Chang profiles regional BBQ in North Carolina, Texas, and Kansas City plus the other-worldly smoky bacon from Allen Benton in Tennessee.

programme.title: Restaurateur
programme.desc: Follow April Bloomfield as she wrestles with the questions every chef must confront.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Sugar craft specialist Eloise Durrant has a commission like no other - a gravity defying five-tier cake that will hang upside down like a chandelier.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: For one lucky little birthday girl, Extreme Cake Maker Michelle Wibowo is creating a five-foot edible Wizard of Oz mural out of Genoese sponge and covered in painted icing and sweets.

programme.title: Rule 5: Watch What You Feed Your Kids
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: Rule 8: Three's A Crowd
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: Garden of Goodness
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: A Light Summery Meal
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Friday Final Number One
programme.desc: The home cooks pair up with Paul Ainsworth, Bryn Williams, Luke Tipping and Nathan Outlaw for head-to-heads.

programme.title: Chattanooga Chew
programme.desc: Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood shift their food tour into high gear exploring stunning Chattanooga, Tennessee -- a city full of transformation yet steeped in history. First, they check out Main Street Meats where expert butchery skills and love of quality food is reflected in the delectable Fried Bologna Sandwich and mouthwatering Strawberry Hand Pie.

programme.title: Comfort Kissed by Fire
programme.desc: Outdoors, Spencer grills campfire steaks with nori butter, crafts a smoky Montreal smoked-meat rosti, and indulges in chocolate-cherry liqueur fondue with dipping treats.

programme.title: Comfort With a Kick
programme.desc: Spencer turns up the heat with Cajun shrimp cakes and creole étouffée, spicy Mexican beef pupusas, and Brazilian halibut and shrimp moqueca.

programme.title: Street Food Comfort
programme.desc: From a Korean fried chicken "dog" with dual ketchups to buttermilkoniondipped drumsticks and popcornshrimp in wafflecone tacos - street eats done cozy.

programme.title: Warm My Belly Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer fills the cabin with the aroma of hearty cornedbeef stew with horseradish mash, plus a fragrant Thai garlicshrimp curry over rice.

programme.title: Party Favorites
programme.desc: Antipasti, cured vegetables, anchovy frittata with zucchini, onion tart and marinated meatballs.

programme.title: Chicken Three Ways
programme.desc: Poached chicken breast salad; shells with courgette and chicken; chicken breasts with orange and Gaeta olives.

programme.title: Fan-tastic Foods
programme.desc: G serves fan faves with flair: Sloppy Gino burgers, crispy Tsaketa wings, and Blueberry Pie Eggrolls with burnt honey ice cream. Chaos, laughs, and surprises ensue-balloons pop, debates flare, and backstories spill!

programme.title: Popular
programme.desc: Chef Dev shares straightforward recipes for street foods that have gained popularity around the world.

programme.title: Budae Jjigae
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Budae Jjigae! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Kildare to South Korea
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet Grainne Hill at the Irish National Stud, a very special place for both her and Peter, as this is where they first met! We chat to her about their love for horses which is what ultimately what brought Peter all the way to live and work in Jeju Island, South Korea.

programme.title: Kym Whitley and Ledisi
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites funny girl Kym Whitley over for a family-style meal including roasted Cornish hens stuffed with her famous "Don't Block the Blessing" Dressing served with an oven-roasted vegetable medley. It's all about food, family and fun as these two eat a little and laugh a lot. Patti takes singer-songwriter Ledisi back to her New Orleans roots with a slamming shrimp creole dish -- a meal so good they both have to sing about it.

programme.title: Estelle and Joe Zee
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites her friend, fashion guru Joe Zee, over for a simple Shrimp Scampi served over Angel Hair Pasta. She tops off the meal with Apple-Peach Compote and Vanilla Ice Cream. Then, British Grammy Award-winning singer Estelle comes by and Patti makes her feel right at home with her very own version of Fish and Chips with Tartar Sauce.

programme.title: Designer Duck
programme.desc: Julia's main course is an original duck dish, followed by a dessert of "Lemon Souffle Crepes," created by guest chef Yves Labbe.

programme.title: Pork Wellington
programme.desc: Julia Child tours a California vineyard to learn about fine wines. At dinner, her first course is Loin of Pork, Wellington, while her guest chef prepares Salmon Souffles. With Brooks Firestone and Rene Verdon.

programme.title: Cambodia
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay leaves his hectic professional life behind him as he embarks on a pilgrimage for fresh flavors in Cambodia.

programme.title: Land, Sea & Air
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik put their heads together to design a three-course menu, where each course must be based around either land, sea, or air! You have to "sea" it to believe it!

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Huw grows native citrus fruits and collects industrial objects. Could ex-flight attendant Marianne or art lover Julie create a delicious dish to win his heart?

programme.title: Turkey Dumplings with the Kernell Family
programme.desc: Our challenger competes to see whether she can outdo her mother's Thanksgiving leftover turkey and dumplings.

programme.title: Burkina Faso
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Tonight's brigade of amateur cooks are all four amateur cooks from the Kent Fire Brigade, pan-roasted foie gras with rhubarb, butter-roasted rib eye of beef and summer berry soup with floating islands

programme.title: The Future
programme.desc: Climate change, a global pandemic, and a booming world population mark an opportune time to be in the food business, not unlike the first wave of the industrial food revolution that gave people the first globally mass-produced, processed foods.

programme.title: Main Course Sit Down Dinner
programme.desc: Julia Child prepares meat and vegetables for very special company. Whether or not you can afford it now, when the great day comes, you will want to know all about choosing and trimming a whole beef tenderloin, how to roast it rosy rare, and how and with what to serve it, including the care and feeding of the wines to accompany it.

programme.title: Tranekær Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale invites us to share the dining secrets of nobility. Count and Countess Ahlefeld-Laurvig live on the Danish island of Langeland.

programme.title: Chillingham Castle
programme.desc: Will the spirits in the haunted castle enjoy the roast pheasant with rowanberry jelly and chips?

programme.title: The A-Z Of Alpharetta
programme.desc: Learn what it takes to make the best shrimp & grits, red velvet cake, and deviled eggs in Alpharetta. Skye takes a creative spin on a favourite blueberry recipe with some help from a local.

programme.title: Snack Attack
programme.desc: The snack attack is real. And today on Food's Greatest Hits, we're all about it! So come spoil your dinner with us as we attack some of food's greatest snacks...deep-fried bites, chips and dip and everyone's fave, popcorn!

programme.title: A Whole Beast of Flavor
programme.desc: Damaris Phillips and NASCAR personality Rutledge Wood sop up the sauce in Charleston, SC, as they discover the pleasures of whole-hog barbecue with legendary pitmaster, Rodney Scott. Then they are on to one of the best burgers in America, where the meats are butchered in house at the Neon Pig in Oxford, MS. Finally, it's a feel good lesson in down-home cooking with fall-off-the-bone oxtail at Addielee's Restaurant in Moncks Corner, SC.

programme.title: Caviar
programme.desc: The old and new of French cuisine battle each other. Challenger Isao Yanagidate opens the door to a long-term battle between Club Mistral and Club des Trentes.

programme.title: What I Did For Love
programme.desc: Un abogado citadino (Jeremy London) enfrenta al jurado más difícil cuando acompaña a su campirana novia (Dorie Barton) a casa de sus padres en Navidad.

programme.title: A Christmas Visitor
programme.desc: Una familia, afligida por la muerte de su hijo menor en la guerra del golfo, estan determinados a traer de nuevo la alegria a su hogar esta navidad. Occure en formas que ninguno de ellos anticipa despues de invitar a un misterioso extraño a su hogar.

programme.title: Twist Of Fate
programme.desc: Mientras se encuentra atrapada en su auto después de un accidente, una joven hace una llamada de emergencia.

programme.title: Shadow On The Mesa
programme.desc: Después del asesinato de su madre, un mercenario sospecha del padre que nunca conoció.

programme.title: It Had To Be You
programme.desc: La agencia publicitaria de Darby es absorbida por la empresa de su padre y es forzada a asociarse con Derrick.

programme.title: Mechanics of Love
programme.desc: Mattie, experta en autos y alta tecnología, queda impactada al ver que el taller de su padre está en negativo.

programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: Una acaudalada viuda de Beverly Hills (Doris Roberts) ayuda a una mujer carente de hogar (Judy Reyes) que le salvó la vida.

programme.title: The Nanny Express
programme.desc: Una joven estudiante, que lucha por graduarse como maestra, toma un trabajo de niñera en la casa de un viudo.

programme.title: A Taste Of Romance
programme.desc: Dos dueños de restaurantes vecinos, con estilos diferentes, compiten y comprueban que polos opuestos se atraen.

programme.title: North by Northpole: A Dial "S" Mystery
programme.desc: Santa Claus regresa para ayudar a una pareja a resolver un misterio y encontrar el amor. El deseo de Zoey de organizar el Festival de Navidad perfecto se ve comprometido cuando choca con su compañero Dalton, mientras ocurren cosas sospechosas que podrían detener el festival.

programme.title: Ordinary Miracles
programme.desc: Un juez se apiada de una niña adoptiva delinquente y la deja libre bajo su propia cutodia para las festividades, y finalmente encuentra al padre biologico de la niña a tiempo para una reunion familiar navideña.

programme.title: Love's Christmas Journey Part 1
programme.desc: Viuda recientemente, Ellie visita a su hermano Aaron durante Navidad. Pero las festividades son amenazadas cuando Aaron desaparece.

programme.title: Our First Christmas
programme.desc: Un coronel debe tomar una decisión, entre su familia y su carrera, mientras maneja la pastelería de su esposa.

programme.title: Backyard Wedding
programme.desc: Mientras hace planes para su segunda boda, descubre que el verdadero amor de su vida es su exposo.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Una apasionada e infeliz abogada descubre que tiene una media hermana desconocida que vive en un rancho pobre.

programme.title: Back To You and Me
programme.desc: Una doctora asiste a la 20ª reunión de su secundaria en su pueblo y enfrenta viejas amistades y enemigos.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: La muerte de un infante y una severa sequía ponen a prueba la fe de los pioneros cristianos Missy y Willie LaHaye en su intento de ganarse la vida como ganaderos. Willie acepta de mala gana el empleo de comisario, luego descubre que debe lanzar a la calle a sus amigos y vecinos porque se atrasaron en sus pagos con el cacique Samuel Doros.

programme.title: Romantically Speaking
programme.desc: Ariel, experta en relaciones, encuentra su vida hecha un desastre y su mejor amigo Nathan la ayuda.

programme.title: Christmas In Canaan
programme.desc: Una amistad imposible florece entre dos niños de 10 años de diferentes antecedentes culturas durante los tiempos racistas de Texas rural en 1964.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: Un padre e hija tienen que sanar viejas heridas y reunirse para salvar el rancho ganadero de la familia.

programme.title: You've Got A Friend
programme.desc: Un niño que acaba de quedar huérfano entabla una inusual amistad con un recluso mientras vive con sus tíos.

programme.title: Santa Jr.
programme.desc: El hijo de Santa Claus, de mala gana toma el cargo del negocio familiar, pero las cosas van mal cuando lo confunden con el conocido "Bandido Navideño" y es arrestado.

programme.title: Relative Stranger
programme.desc: Después de la muerte de su padre, una ex-estrella del fútbol americano se reúne con la familia que abandonó años atrás.

programme.title: A Boyfriend For Christmas
programme.desc: Un hombre cuyo aspecto le es familiar puede ser la respuesta a un antiguo deseo navideño de una mujer de 33 años.

programme.title: A Carol Christmas
programme.desc: Una ejecutiva insensible es revelada los errores de sus acciones por cuatro fastamas, cambiando asi su actitude a tiempo para Navidad.

programme.title: Meet The Santas
programme.desc: En esta secuela de Single Santa busca a Mrs. Claus, Nick viaja con Beth a su ciudad natal en el sur, a conocer a su aristrocratica madre, cuando los padres de Nick aparecen, las familias chocan hasta que la magia de Navidad.

programme.title: Farewell Mr. Kringle
programme.desc: Una periodista, quien hace tiempo perdió su espíritu navideño, es designada a escribir en el pueblo Mistletoe.

programme.title: Letter Never Sent
programme.desc: De visita en casa, Henry encuentra una carta de amor que escribió en la secundaria para su mejor amiga Claire.

programme.title: Our First Christmas
programme.desc: Un coronel debe tomar una decisión, entre su familia y su carrera, mientras maneja la pastelería de su esposa.

programme.title: Single Santa Seeks Mrs. Claus
programme.desc: Viuda hermosa y solitaria y su hijo son los beneficiarios cuando el guapo hijo primogenito y heredero del verdadero Santa Claus deja el polo norte para encontrar una esposa a tiempo para Navidad.

programme.title: A Grandpa For Christmas
programme.desc: Bert O'Reiley es un actor retirado el cual se convierte en un instanste en abuelo de una nieta que no sabia de su existensia hasta que se va a vivir con el.

programme.title: Love Throws A Curve
programme.desc: Una lesión pone a prueba el sueño de Early de ser jugador de béisbol y encuentra la felicidad inesperada.

programme.title: A Carol Christmas
programme.desc: Una ejecutiva insensible es revelada los errores de sus acciones por cuatro fastamas, cambiando asi su actitude a tiempo para Navidad.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: Una talentosa chef de pasteles del Bronx encuentra el amor con un chef de alta sociedad de Connecticut.

programme.title: Foxfire
programme.desc: Annie y su esposo Hector amaban su vida en las montañas, pero cuando Hector muere, Annie debe vivir sola.

programme.title: Accidentally in Love
programme.desc: Un accidente automovilístico cambia las vidas de una madre (Jennie Garth) soltera y del actor (Ethan Erickson) de un programa infantil.

programme.title: Mistletoe Connection
programme.desc: Es Navidad y Kate dirige una nostálgica tienda de regalos en un vecindario que acaba de ser remodelado. Un encuentro casual en el autobús con Mark hace saltar chispas para ambos.

programme.title: Santa Switch
programme.desc: Un hombre se hace cargo de las labores de Santa Claus durante la Navidad con la esperanza de reencontrarse con su familia.

programme.title: A Christmas Visitor
programme.desc: Una familia, afligida por la muerte de su hijo menor en la guerra del golfo, estan determinados a traer de nuevo la alegria a su hogar esta navidad. Occure en formas que ninguno de ellos anticipa despues de invitar a un misterioso extraño a su hogar.

programme.desc: Claire is taking the loss of Peter and Tess badly. She can't raise enthusiasm for anything, and things reach a crisis point when she decides to sell Drovers Run.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Becky's troublesome older brother Mark returns, determined to drag Sean into his life of illegality. Mark assaults Nick in a remote paddock and while everyone is busy searching for him, Mark talks a reluctant Sean into helping him steal Alex's prize horse.

programme.title: Hounded
programme.desc: Frank Da Costa, the new cop in town, has it in for Terry. When Terry unwittingly sells Tess a pair of stolen alpacas, he sets up an explosive confrontation that will unearth the dark secret at the heart of Frank's animosity.

programme.title: Steer Trek
programme.desc: With the drought continuing and no money to truck in water, Claire, Tess, and Nick join forces. Meg is delighted when the Ryans send Terry along to help and she sees a chance to win him back. The attraction between Nick and Tess grows.

programme.title: Brave J
programme.desc: Tess motivates Claire into rekindling her dreams of becoming a stock horse trainer and breeder. Drovers Run needs the money, and with Peter safely out of the way, there is a slim chance of crossing paths with him again.

programme.title: You Can Leave Your Hat On
programme.desc: When Jodi's cooking gives five young men food poisoning, the women of Drovers must convince the Killarney men to put on a strip show.

programme.title: Stripped Bare
programme.desc: Drovers Run is cleared out by thieves while Jodi and Craig take advantage of everybody else's absence from the ranch to enjoy a secret rendezvous in the spa.

programme.title: Blame it on the Moonlight
programme.desc: Claire is irritated over Tess's three homestay guests: they're starting to shear today, and the last thing she needs is tourists getting in the way.

programme.title: Made to be Broken
programme.desc: Claire and Alex's potential clients are being put off by rumours circulated by Peter that, ten years ago, Alex was responsible for crippling a boy, Stefan Van Amstel when he deliberately ran his car off the road.

programme.title: Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Tess meets Sandra Kinsela at the cattle sale yards and likes her instantly, only to discover Claire dislikes her intensely. Their childhood dispute is renewed when a herd of calves is stolen from Drovers Run and Claire is convinced that Sandra is responsible.

programme.title: Wind Change
programme.desc: Tess is on the brink of committing to Nick but she is struggling with the intensity of her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Jodi and Alberto are forced to move back to Drovers Run when they are kicked out of their apartment in town after being unable to pay the rent.

programme.title: No More Mr Nice Guy
programme.desc: On the eve of the Gungellan Show, Claire is presented with repossession papers for Drovers Run. Nick and Tess become estranged after Tess walked out on him, but she tries to explain her actions of the previous night.

programme.title: Future Perfect
programme.desc: Peter offers to stop the repossession of Drovers Run if Claire marries him, but she rejects his proposal. She is injured in a fall during the Stockman's Challenge and the accident reveals her pregnancy. In order to help Claire, Alex steps forward to claim paternity.

programme.title: Fairy Tale, Ending
programme.desc: Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital, but she must deal with the lie she told that Alex is the father of her child when he isn't.

programme.title: Better The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted. Jodi returns from her holiday and Alberto proposes to her. With Becky's blessing, a date for the wedding is set, but three weeks is a bit sudden for Meg.

programme.title: The Road Home
programme.desc: Jodi is busy making plans for a huge wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances. When Alberto informs Jodi that her mother is intending to sell her jewels to pay for the event; Jodi decides a simple, traditional wedding may be better.

programme.title: An Affair to Forget
programme.desc: Tess believes Sally is cheating on Nick when she sees her in town with another man. Jodi's wedding plans go down the drain when Alberto learns about the affair she had while overseas, and Jake tries to help Becky cope with her feelings following Brett's death.

programme.title: Put to the Test
programme.desc: As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and a couple of his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere. When Jodi finds out, she goes ballistic and searches for Alberto with Craig.

programme.title: The Wedding
programme.desc: With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly, which creates tensions in the family.

programme.title: Gone to the Dogs
programme.desc: Becky senses the mystery surrounding Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves. Sally accidentally leaves a gate open and a herd of sheep damages Tess and Nick's wheat crop.

programme.title: The Ghost of Things to Come
programme.desc: Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother and unleashes a fear that she will also die in childbirth. Tess organises a fake séance to try to ease Claire's fears and there are some surprising results.

programme.title: A House of Cards
programme.desc: The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary is shattered when Harry's nagging suspicions about Alex not being the father of Claire's baby explodes into a fit of rage after an innocent remark leads to Liz confessing a long-held secret.

programme.title: Three Little Words
programme.desc: Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse when Alex discovers he has been cut off financially. Nick tries to play peacemaker but both sides are stubborn and his efforts go unappreciated.

programme.title: Repeat Offenders
programme.desc: Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run to write a feature magazine article about life on the land. However, tensions between her and Tess begin to rise as old wounds are reopened and long-forgotten feelings are revisited.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions. Jodi discovers the real reason Kylie left home when she goes through Kylie's mail. A pending court date for a shoplifting charge is rapidly approaching but Kylie seems willing to ignore it.

programme.title: Jokers to the Right
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: Chain Reaction
programme.desc: When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately. The scattered pieces of the letter have barely hit the compost when Becky announces that the cattle are sick. Further misfortune soon strikes Drovers Run, with Terry falling ill and the discovery of a dead sheep.

programme.title: The Awful Truth
programme.desc: Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend while they argue over Harry's proposal for a stock route through Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Tess stubbornly refuses to ask for outside help to shear her alpacas, insisting on doing the job herself.

programme.title: Seeing the Light
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run. Tess is determined to believe they are a good omen, but Claire, restless and uneasy in the last stages of pregnancy, insists that trouble awaits.

programme.title: A Slight Interruption
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: Old Beginnings
programme.desc: Claire is having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends and family when Peter arrives. Claire has written to him after the birth, telling him he is a father. Peter is justifiably angry.

programme.title: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: Perfect Match
programme.desc: Becky and Jake join in a business partnership with Claire and Tess; Claire has issues with some of Jake's clients.

programme.title: Let the Best Man Win
programme.desc: Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down on a country road. Almost instantly they're pitched into a competition to woo her.

programme.title: Majority Rules
programme.desc: When Drovers Run is quarantined and the future of the stock placed under a cloud, true friends seem few and far between as Claire finally goes head-to-head with her old enemy Sandra Kinsella. Meg and Terry have their eye on a piece of land but are unable to come up with the deposit, until an offer of help comes from an unlikely person.

programme.title: The Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne. Alex is insistent that he come along to look after them while also pursuing some Wilgul matters, but the real reason is that he wants to meet his biological father.

programme.title: One Step at a Time
programme.desc: Claire and Alex are still in Melbourne, blissfully in love. At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day. When Tess, in the shower, discovers a lump in her breast, she fears she will share her mother's fate and quickly goes into denial, telling no-one.

programme.title: Time Frames
programme.desc: Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife. Meanwhile, prompted by Becky, Claire asks Harry if she can use King Harold in a new breeding program on Drovers.

programme.title: Body Language (aka The Bottom Line)
programme.desc: Drovers Run hosts the Regional Young Farmer of the Year Contest, and Becky is surprised to learn that Jake has entered. He tells her he's going to win her back. They compete neck and neck and slowly Becky is won over by his persistence and charm, and the old spark between them returns.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: Tess's upcoming operation has thoughts of mortality creeping in, so she begins to write a letter to Charlotte so that her niece can know her, should Tess no longer be around. Meanwhile, Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.

programme.title: My Noon, My Midnight
programme.desc: Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests, convinced that her time is up, while Alex and Claire decide to move in together.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work. She wants to assure Charlotte's future, as well as remain faithful to Claire's dream for Drovers. Bushfires sweep through the area and Tess has to face it alone until Stevie turns up to fight by her side.

programme.title: Double Dealing
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: Jack of All Shades
programme.desc: Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake who knocks at the door looking for Jack McLeod... his father. Tess's mind is spinning with the possibility of a new member of the family - something she is lacking after Claire's death.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run, but things quickly go downhill from there. Sandra has a surprising solution when Alex and Nick face a heart-wrenching decision

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Game of Chance
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: When Sparks Fly
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: Show of Love
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: Father's Day
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: Fool For Love
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: Make or Break
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: Second Chance
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: Call Me Kate
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Desperate and Dateless
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: Saturn Returns
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: Where There's Fire
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: Trembling on the Brink
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: This Moment Forward
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: Something to Prove
programme.desc: Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run. While Tess and Nick enjoy their honeymoon in Fiji, Stevie becomes intent on proving that she can run the property on her own.

programme.title: My House is Your House
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: A McLeod Daughter
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: The Maine Event
programme.desc: The captains must decide whether to go where the fish are biting or take their chances fishing inshore.

programme.title: Battle At Midway
programme.desc: It's the midway point of fishing where crews either knuckle down and push hard, or crumble from the grind.

programme.title: Wicked Pissed
programme.desc: Paul Hebert struggles to prove his worth as a captain after catching only three tuna in the first two months.

programme.title: When Push Comes to Shove
programme.desc: With only six weeks of fishing left, the competition is heating up.

programme.title: Three's a Charm
programme.desc: It's week 11 of the season, and bad luck, bait problems and big egos plague the Gloucester fleet.

programme.title: Triple Crossed
programme.desc: It's week 12 of the season, and one captain's decision to withhold information fractures ties with an ally.

programme.title: Tuna Trifecta
programme.desc: With only three weeks left, and the top position on the line, every captain is desperate to stack the deck.

programme.title: Knock Out Punch
programme.desc: With less than two weeks left, the top four crews are locked in a tight race to be New England's best boat.

programme.title: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: It's the final week of the season and Hard Merchandise holds a narrow lead over the fleet.

programme.title: Too Close to Call
programme.desc: There are less than five days left, and the competition will come down to the very last day of fishing.

programme.title: It All Comes Down To This
programme.desc: It's the final week of the season and the competition is so close, it will come down to the very last day.

programme.title: Something to Prove
programme.desc: The best fishermen from Gloucester set out on the first day of the North Atlantic Bluefin Tuna season.

programme.title: Tuna and Tequila
programme.desc: Erin & Sarah, the father/daughter fishing operation, try to keep their lead over the Gloucester fleet.

programme.title: May the Fish Be with You
programme.desc: It's week three of the season, and one captain is forced to choose between two friends on the water.

programme.title: Pissed Off on Pissah
programme.desc: It's week four and tensions start to boil for Wicked Pissah's new crew, while two rival harpoon boats face off

programme.title: Big Hauls and Downfalls
programme.desc: It's week five of the tuna season and teamwork is the name of the game for Gloucester fleet.

programme.title: Help Wanted
programme.desc: Sharks, shorts and crew problems plague the fleet, but two captains get blessed with new mates.

programme.title: Snitches Get Fishes
programme.desc: Midway through the fishing season, a long-__running feud lands one captain in hot water.

programme.title: Opposites Distract
programme.desc: At the halfway mark of the tuna season, some teams are working well together while others are floundering.

programme.title: Take It to the Bank
programme.desc: The captains face a familiar decision: whether or not to take the long, high_risk journey to Georges Bank.

programme.title: Doubling Down
programme.desc: After a massive haul at Georges Bank, two captains decide to double down and make the long trip again.

programme.title: Riders in the Storm
programme.desc: When a violent storm rolls in, the captains face a tough decision at a critical time: do they fish... or flee?

programme.title: Comeback Kid
programme.desc: With four weeks left in the season, Hard Merchandise and FV_Tuna.Com struggle to stay at the top of the fleet.

programme.title: Tuna Invaders
programme.desc: With only three weeks left, the captains face even more competition as boats from all over head to Gloucester.

programme.title: The Thin Bluefin Line
programme.desc: There is a narrow margin separating the top four boats and only two weeks left in the season.

programme.title: The Final Fishdown
programme.desc: In the last week of the season, the closest race in Wicked Tuna history is a tossup among four top contenders.

programme.title: The First Fish is the Hardest
programme.desc: Atlantic bluefin tuna have arrived off the coast of Gloucester, signaling the start of another summer season.

programme.title: Trails & Tunalations
programme.desc: After every boat, except the Wicked Pissah, caught fish during the first week, all eyes are on Paul Hebert.

programme.title: Bluefin Brotherhood
programme.desc: There's a belief that practicing good karma on the ocean brings good in return...but not all play by the rules.

programme.title: Who Needs a Captain?
programme.desc: The mates of the bluefin tuna fleet prove their worth and one boat makes a historic haul of five fish.

programme.title: The Ego Has Landed
programme.desc: Paul doubles down on his efforts to train his rookie mate, but his methods might be too much for Rick.

programme.title: Doldrums and Dog Days
programme.desc: It's the mid-point of the season, leaving captains eager to grind through days on the water.

programme.title: Captain Money Bags
programme.desc: As the competition between the top boats heats up, so does the pressure on the rest of the Gloucester captains

programme.title: Hickory Dickory Docked
programme.desc: The rivalry between captains Dave Carraro and Tyler McLaughlin intensifies.

programme.title: Hissy Fit
programme.desc: One mate could destroy his boat's chances for glory while the two worst boats can gain back their pride.

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: With just three weeks left, the fleet learns they will be facing major storm fronts over the next few days.

programme.title: The End is Nigh
programme.desc: There's only two weeks left of this season, and time is running out.

programme.title: The Time is Now
programme.desc: With only days left to fish, the Captains battle it out in one of the closest finishes in Wicked Tuna history.

programme.title: Join the Crew
programme.desc: Get a behind-the-scenes look at the fishermen who put everything on the line to chase bluefin tuna.

programme.title: Worst to First
programme.desc: It's opening day of the bluefin tuna season, and the first fish can bring big money.

programme.title: Fish or Famine
programme.desc: As defending champ Dave Carraro struggles, the rest of the fleet seizes the opportunity to get ahead.

programme.title: Merch Madness
programme.desc: The Hard Merchandise is the only boat that has yet to land a fish, and Captain Dave is feeling the pressure.

programme.title: Don't Quit Your Day Job
programme.desc: When inexperienced fishermen crowd the water, the fleet has to fight through additional obstacles.

programme.title: Smoke on the Water
programme.desc: The captains team up to double their chances, but forming an alliance with a competitor proves to be risky.

programme.title: Two for the Money
programme.desc: The alliance between two captains is in jeopardy after the Hard Merchandise suffers a breakdown at sea.

programme.title: The Fleet Strikes Back
programme.desc: Defending champion Dave Carraro and his crew of the FV-Tuna.com take the lead for the first time this season.

programme.title: Ride the Lightning
programme.desc: As a massive storm front slams the fishing grounds, the fleet takes big risks to catch the elusive bluefin.

programme.title: Fishin' Friction
programme.desc: The weeks of fishing take their toll on the fleet. Paul takes his anger out on Rick.

programme.title: Mutiny on the Water
programme.desc: Paul's negative attitude sours his relationship with his mate, Rick. And Tyler is forced to fish solo.

programme.title: Road to Redemption
programme.desc: Captain Brad Krasowski of the Fish Hawk is on a hot streak and is ready to go from "worst to first."

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: On the Hard Merchandise, the past few weeks of few fish push Dave Marciano to his breaking point.

programme.title: A Fin and a Prayer
programme.desc: With three weeks left in the season, the competition intensifies. Dave Marciano tries to turn his luck around.

programme.title: Shock and Awe
programme.desc: Captain Brad Krasowski is just one big catch away from completing his "worst to first" comeback.

programme.title: Changing the Tide
programme.desc: With only one week left in the season, the fleet competes for final paychecks, and it's anyone's game.

programme.title: Fight to the Finnish
programme.desc: With less than four days left in the season, the fleet races to claim the title of top-earning boat.

programme.title: Battle Cry
programme.desc: It's opening day of the season, and every captain wants to be the one to bring in the lucrative first fish.

programme.title: Game of Fins
programme.desc: The second week of fishing shines a light on the mates in the fleet as a familiar boat enters the competition.

programme.title: Wreck It Ralph
programme.desc: When a familiar face returns to Gloucester, the fleet isn't very welcoming.

programme.title: Gods and Monstahs
programme.desc: Bad luck strikes the fleet as Captain Tyler McLaughlin is forced to fight a giant bluefin in the dark.

programme.title: Relative Madness
programme.desc: Captain Dave Marciano's nephew and first mate Jay brings a shot of new energy to the Falcon.

programme.title: Attack of the Pack
programme.desc: The captains are challenged by an unexpected crowd of boats, and the fleet is forced to make tough decisions.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: With the pressure mounting, the captains form alliances to better their chances of putting meat on deck.

programme.title: Wicked Waves
programme.desc: Stormy weather hits Gloucester, and the captains must fight the elements if they want to catch a bluefin tuna.

programme.title: One For the Money
programme.desc: As the season reaches a turning point, a change in the quota forces boats to push their limits.

programme.title: Blood in the Water
programme.desc: The smaller quota of one tuna per day adds mounting pressure, as the captains must put meat on deck each day.

programme.title: Thick As Thieves
programme.desc: Captain Tyler McLaughlin is feeling pressure to take the lead. A new boat of friendly faces joins the fleet.

programme.title: The Sherman Tank
programme.desc: During week 12, the captains weigh the decision to hunt bluefin over 170 miles away from their home base.

programme.title: Coming For the Crown
programme.desc: Captain Dave Carraro's boat has been the top earner for four of the past seven seasons. Can it be defeated?

programme.title: Pulling Out the Stops
programme.desc: The competition heats up as the season nears its end, compelling captains to change their strategies.

programme.title: The Final Tail
programme.desc: Time is up! The pressure explodes as the battle for the championship turns into a three-horse race.

programme.title: The Enemy Among Us

programme.title: Band of Brothers

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: The team restore a model ship made of matchsticks crafted by a woman's late father, a retro machinist's chair and a papier-mâché black and white dog.

programme.desc: Toy restorers Amanda and Julie have their work cut out reviving a sad dog that has been badly burned; metal expert Dominic and Mark Stuckey join forces to fix a retro kitchen mixer; Silversmith Brenton works his magic on a nurse's belt buckle.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Toy restorers Julie and Amanda welcome a stuffed monkey into the barn; metal expert Dominic faces the heavy-duty task of unseizing a metal vice; wood wizard Will Kirk puts his carving skills to the test as he tackles a Scandinavian folk figurine.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea takes on a toy carriage which originally belonged to a boy born in 1911; silversmith Brenton West carefully restores two platinum framed records; mechanical expert Steve Fletcher takes on an ornate but broken clock.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The team takes on the challenge of restoring a set of unglazed clay sculptures that reminds its owner of her beloved late brother, a vintage lawnmower, and a handmade leather horse from the Second World War.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Jay Blades invites new expert Kaviraj Singh to the barn to tackle the fix of a broken Indian stringed instrument; Suzie Fletcher gets to grips with an iconic flying jacket; Steve Fletcher works his magic on a damaged mechanical toy bird.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: The team repair a water-damaged pastel portrait, a 1950s tinplate clockwork toy rocket and a lucky leather purse.

programme.desc: The team repair a much loved chandelier, a mother-of-pearl table and a broken toy airplane from a lost childhood in Iraq.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: First up is a pinball penny slot machine; art conservator Lucia Scalisi's expertise is called upon to repair a 1960s hand painted drag cone; silversmith Brenton West undertakes the repair of two art deco style silver ladies holding mirrors aloft.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: The team tackles an oil painting by a miner, a delicate wedding tiara, and a chiming mantelpiece clock that was a lifeline for a man losing his sight.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Sonnaz and Dominic join forces to revive a Victorian iron rocking chair; David takes on the fix of a quirky mechanical bear ornament; leather expert Suzie takes receipt of a broken and burned leather collar attached to an alpine cowbell.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: The team restore a ride-on toy shaped like a snail, a ballroom dancing trophy and a vintage bike linking its owner to the father she lost as a teenager.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: The team repair a musical table, a World War II Land Army doll and a pair of leather driving gloves used by a transport driver from Barnsley.

programme.title: Episode 14

programme.title: Spare Bedroom Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the spare bedroom room challenge. The design duo's rush around adding their finishing touches. One team in particular seems to be in complete chaos. Who will be crowned as the winners of the first challenge?

programme.title: Meet & Greet
programme.desc: In the season Premiere of My Design Rules season 2, we meet our three design duos, their magazine editor mentors, and the show's esteemed judges. The teams also get to explore the white box houses that they will design.

programme.title: Spare Room Challenge
programme.desc: For the second challenge, the design duos must decorate a second spare room, but it may not be a bedroom. Host Danilo checks in to see the progress.

programme.title: Spare Bedroom Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their first challenge, decorating the spare bedroom within two weeks. They meet with their mentors and collaborate with some local design talent. Host Danilo pops in at the halfway mark to see their progress

programme.title: New York City
programme.desc: Through up close and personal stories Africa Everywhere: New York follows the journeys of people from the African/Caribbean Diaspora as they navigate through the rhythm and pace of the largest city in the US.

programme.title: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Welcome to the West Coast, city of Los Angeles in this episode we explore the idea of "the dream" for the African immigrant. From a traditional Ethiopian tea ceremony to performing the Kizomba dance from Angola, welcome to the left coast!

programme.title: When Two World's Collide: The Brett Goldin & Richard Bloom Story
programme.desc: Crimes Uncovered retells one of South Africa's most publicized and painful murder cases. The series tells the tragic story of the brutal and senseless murder of actor Brett Goldin and aspiring designer Richard Bloom.

programme.title: The Ultimate Betrayal: The Taliep Petersen Story
programme.desc: The terrible tale of the murder of successful musical theatre Legend Taliep Petersen. A mere house robbery on the surface turns out to be a treacherous betrayal at the hands of a supposed loved one.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Case 1: Mrs. Jane is suing Mr. Timothy for the balance owed on a motorcycle he purchased which was stolen shortly after delivery. Case 2: Ms. Abdul is suing Ms. Benson for unpaid phone repair costs, after she only paid for part of the repairs.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Case 1: Kingsley Emeka has dragged his former girlfriend before the judge in a bid to recover Valentines gifts. Case 2: Mr. Zaccheus has brought Mr. Leonard, his friend and 1st time business partner to court for a debt obtained under false pretenses

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Case 1: Kingsley Emeka has dragged his former girlfriend before the judge in a bid to recover Valentines gifts. Case 2: Mr. Zaccheus has brought Mr. Leonard, his friend and 1st time business partner to court for a debt obtained under false pretenses

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Case 1: Esther Asuquor has dragged her rental agent James Ado before the judge in a bid to recover her paid fees for finding her apartment which was already occupied by another tenant.

programme.title: Jason's Letter
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy is still grieving from the loss of his best friend, the most recent of many unarmed shooting victims in his small community. After realizing the marches and protests have done nothing, he decides to take matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Janet Jackson: In Control
programme.desc: She may have been the youngest of 10 of the Jackson children, but that did not stop Janet Jackson from embracing her own identity. Her unquestioned talent has built an empire of success as Ms. Janet remains In Control.

programme.title: Miss Earth South Africa
programme.desc: It's back to Boracay with the gorgeous girls of Miss Earth SA,Janez faces off against radio presenter and potential body double Alex Caige in a Pizza Delivery Challenge, and Illusionist Bryan Miles deceives our eyes.

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a bloodthirsty, flesh-eating breed of monsters who are ravaging the East Coast of the United States.

programme.title: Bridget's Bungee Jump
programme.desc: Will Bridget pluck up the courage to bungee jump off the Bloukrans Bridge?

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Bridget and Dene land up in dangerous waters in Knysna, both literally and physically.

programme.title: Judge Sleepover
programme.desc: The design duos get a chance to fix problems or snags in the whole house. Then it is time for the judges to spend the night in the homes for the final judging process.

programme.title: Meet & Greet
programme.desc: In the season Premiere of My Design Rules season 2, we meet our three design duos, their magazine editor mentors, and the show's esteemed judges. The teams also get to explore the white box houses that they will design.

programme.title: Who's Design Rules?
programme.desc: In the grand finale of My Design Rules, we recap the journey with our three duos and the judges. Then it is the big moment, the winner of My design Rules is announced. Who will it be?

programme.title: Who's Design Rules?
programme.desc: In the grand finale of My Design Rules, we recap the journey with our three duos and the judges. Then it is the big moment, the winner of My design Rules is announced. Who will it be?

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Philadelphia. An East Coast city rooted in the foundation of revolution and brotherhood. With a population of over a million and a half residents, immigrants have shaped Philadelphia through common bonds of family and freedom.

programme.title: Boston
programme.desc: Boston, thrives on a culture of winning. From cheers at Fenway to the blue collar workers planning for the long haul. For West Indian and African immigrants, progress is often steeped in the idea that one must contribute for change to take place.

programme.title: The Ultimate Sin: The Father Lionel Sham Story
programme.desc: Father Lionel Sham was a man known for his kindness and compassion. He was a much-loved priest in the community of Mohlakeng. Crimes Uncovered follows the story of the heartless and brutal murder of this man of God.

programme.title: Lost Innocence: The Fanwell Khumalo Story
programme.desc: Fanwell Khumalo, a celebrated chef, led a double life. Crimes Uncovered follows the treacherous story of a man who wore many masks and one that finally earned him the title of one of South Africa's worst serial rapists.

programme.title: The Rise
programme.desc: The first chapter analyses the origins of Afrobeat and its musical evolution. We dig into the history of its creation with Fela Kuti but also with the other music genres related to recent Afrobeats, such as the Nigerian Highlife of the 70s and 80s.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: Afrobeats continues to grow whilst having a huge influence on pop culture. African superstars now regularly sell out concerts overseas and receive airplay on platforms around the world.

programme.title: Italian Cuisine
programme.desc: Di italiani sono famosi per il loro cibo. And while that may have you lost in translation, it doesn't take a linguist to enjoy linguine, as we dine on some irresistible Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Dancing & Dishes
programme.desc: Janez may not be the greatest dancer, but these Latin American dishes are sure to get your hips moving!

programme.title: Asian Food In Jozi
programme.desc: This week Janez and Amanda traverse through Jozi looking for the spots with the best Asian food.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Along the banks of the Mighty Zambezi River, lies The Lower Zambezi National Park. A poignant tale emerges, as ecologist David Ngwenyama goes on a mission to preserve this wild haven from the biggest threat in its history.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: A riveting episode of how Lower Zambezi, came into being, and a relentless quest to protect this unique and fragile ecosystem.

programme.title: Eno Inwek
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. See Eno Inwek represent Nigerian humor like never before!

programme.title: Edwin Okong'o
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. Check out a day in the life of Kenya funny man Edwin Okong'o.

programme.title: Married to a Baller
programme.desc: In this captivating urban faith stage play, a woman is married to a pro football player who is suddenly injured. Broken in both body and spirit, he hits rock bottom, but his nurse tries to bring him back to the man he was.

programme.title: Kevin Hart: Standing Tall
programme.desc: Laughter is the best medicine. Just ask Kevin Hart. Comedy would rule as antidote to a troubled childhood. Hart's work ethic has no limits with 8 comedy specials, 54 films, 90 TV shows and a global media company.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 12
programme.desc: On the twelfth episode of Pastor Wants A Wife, we recap on the first season of Pastor Wants a Wife with a presenter Lerato Mvelase.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 13
programme.desc: On the last episode of Pastor Wants A Wife, the two pastors get the opportunity to choose who they would like to spend their lives with.
